items.verbatim_section_rubric: *CANON OF THE CROSS*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Копіемъ ти корецъ оугасися, и падеся: падши же Адам, къ жизни возвращает ся: вопія тебѣ, коліею заклавшемуся Хе: благословля тя и славля, Бже всесилне. Мунк.
items.english_cohort_translation: "By Thy lance the fiery sword was quenched and fell; and fallen Adam returns unto life, crying unto Thee Who wast slain with a lance, O Christ: 'I bless and glorify Thee, O Almighty God!' "

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Миръ просвѣщается коренми вашим, и мужествомъ страдалци, неисчетными чудесы: тмы болѣзней избавляете: вѣрно вопіа: блгвите вся дѣла Гдна, Гда, пойте и превозносите его во вѣки. М:
items.english_cohort_translation: "The world is enlightened by your wounds and courage, O sufferers, by countless wonders; ye deliver from the darkness of diseases, faithfully crying: 'Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and exalt Him above all forever!' "*

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *CANON OF THE CROSS*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Смѣхъ зрятся, лежа подъ ногама вашими Стіи: и́же первѣе хваляяся землю потребити и море, Хе же, живоносною оустрашаетъ десницею, и не оувядающими вѣнцы, бл приневоланніи. Б[го]:
items.english_cohort_translation: "A laughing-stock is seen, lying beneath your feet, O Saints, he who formerly boasted to destroy earth and sea; but Christ terrified him with His life-bearing right hand, and crowned you with unfading crowns, O glorious ones."

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Подъ лѣты породила еси, и́же лѣтъ вышшаго: раздрѣшающаго лѣтныа союзы, оузами своими Пречтая, Адама первозданнаго: и связующа его оузами сладки своея любве.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Stavrotheotokion:* "Under time thou didst bear Him Who is above the times, Who looses the temporal bonds of Adam the first-formed by His bonds, O all-pure one, and binds him with the sweet bonds of His love."

items.english_cohort_translation: "Unceasingly pray for those who honor thee in compunction, that they may be delivered from the snares of the devil, crying unto thy Son: 'Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and exalt Him above all forever!' "

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Непрестанно тя молящи, и́же въ оумиленіи тебе чтущихъ: избавитися сѣтей діаволихъ, Сну твоему вопіющимъ: блгвите вся дѣла Гна, Гда, пойте и превозносите его въвѣки.
items.english_cohort_translation: "When by God's command my soul is about to depart from life: snatch me from the snares of the hunters, O Theotokos, who sing: 'Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and exalt Him above all forever!' "

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *CANON OF THE CROSS*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Егда Бжіимъ повеленіем, хоще душа моа ѡ житіа изыити: ѡ сѣтей ловящихъ исхити Бце, поюща: блгвите вся дѣла Гдна, Гда, пойте и превозносите его во вѣки.
items.english_cohort_translation: "The dark night holds me, for I am enslaved by dark deeds; but do thou thyself, who art the door of the Light, illuminate me with thy light, who sing: 'Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and exalt Him above all forever!' "

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *CANON OF THE CROSS*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Нощь мя некстлаа содержит: дѣлы ко темными поработи ся: но сама мя свѣтомъ си, я́же свѣту двери, ѡзари, поюща: блгвите вся дѣла Гна, Га, пойте и превозносите его: подаждь свою милость Влчце міру, твоему рабу моли та: и чаемаго прещеніа, люди твоя исхити всенечтая: да тебѣ зовемъ, благодаряще: слава тебѣ всѣхъ Црице.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Grant thy mercy, O Lady, unto the world; pray for thy servant, and deliver thy people from the expected punishment, O all-pure one, that we may cry unto thee, giving thanks: 'Glory to thee, O Queen of all!' "

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *CANON OF THE CROSS*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Иже Купиною и́ огнемъ прописаную въ Синаи, законоположнику Мѵсусію: и Бжтвенный огнь въ чревѣ заченши неѡпално, всесвѣтлую и не оугасимую свѣщу: вѣрою, купу, въ пѣснехъ чтемъ, величающе.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *CANON OF THE CROSS*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Да ѡбрящеши драхму, юже погубилъ еси Хе: возжегъ на Крестѣ свою плоть блаже: и ѡбщники твориши радости, Силы твоя бышная жизнодавче, сними же якѡ блгодателя въ пѣснехъ чтуще тя величаемъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: "That Thou mightest find the lost drachma, O Christ, Thou didst kindle Thy flesh upon the Cross, O Good One, and makest Thy heavenly hosts partakers of joy, O Giver of life; with them, as unto our Benefactor, honoring Thee in songs, we magnify Thee."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *CANON OF THE CROSS*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Яко воздвиже, Хе, свои руцѣ на Кртѣ: ѡслабленныя мои прежде руцѣ страстьми многими: и колѣнѣ къ теченію Бжтвенному, воистинну ѡслабленныя оукрѣпилъ еси силою своею, тѣмже благодарно тя величамъ. Мчнк.
items.english_cohort_translation: "As Thou didst lift up Thy hands upon the Cross, O Christ: my hands that were formerly weakened by many passions, and my knees truly weakened for the divine race, hast Thou strengthened by Thy power; therefore thankfully we magnify Thee."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *CANON OF THE CROSS*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сзгаряюще пламенемъ, безмѣрными ранами: росу тя ѡбрѣтоша, Хе, прохладною, твои крѣпціи и чудныи страдалци, тѣмже, радующеся проидоша теченіе желаніемъ почестей: пѣсньми непрестанно тя величающе, многомлтиве. М.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Burning with the flame of immeasurable wounds, Thy valiant and marvelous sufferers found Thee, O Christ, as cooling dew; therefore rejoicing, they finished the race through desire of honors, unceasingly magnifying Thee in hymns, O Most Merciful One."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *CANON OF THE CROSS*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Множество страдалцевъ, стыхъ ликъ, молитъ тя, Хе, за соборъ людій, многѡ прогнѣвающигъ, множеством твои щедре милостей, оучисти множество беззаконіи нашихъ, якѡ члколюбецъ. Б[го]:
items.english_cohort_translation: "The multitude of sufferers, the choir of Saints, prays Thee, O Christ, for the assembly of the people who have provoked Thee much: through the multitude of Thy compassions, O Bountiful One, cleanse the multitude of our iniquities, as Thou art the Lover of mankind."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *CANON OF THE CROSS*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Новыи члѣчіи зракъ, зарѣ ѿ тѣ Дво родила еси, егоже воздвиженна на Кртѣ, Слнце нетерпя зрѣти ѡмрачашеся: и мракъ ухождаше Ідолобѣсіа, тѣмже пѣньмъ тя величаемъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Stavrotheotokion:* "A new human likeness didst thou bear from thy blood, O Virgin; Whom, when He was lifted up upon the Cross, the sun could not bear to behold and was darkened, and the darkness of idolatry departed; therefore in hymns we magnify thee."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *CANON OF THE CROSS*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Инъ. Ірмосъ. Въ законѣ сѣниемъ и Писаніи, ѡбразъ видим вѣрніи, всяко бо отроча, ложесна разверзая, сто Бви, тѣмъ перворожденное Слово, ѡ Оца безначальна Сна, перворожденна матерью: неискусомужиѣ величаемъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 9. items.verbatim_section_rubric: *CANON OF THE CROSS*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Приближается дше конецъ, приближися судъ, ѡтряси оудѣла студныхъ, и имися за блгую жизнь, имаши бо способощницу, Бцу: избавляющую тя ѡ великихъ ѡзлобленій.
items.english_cohort_translation: "The end draws near, O soul; the judgment is at hand; shake off the deeds of shame, and lay hold of the good life, for thou hast a helper, the Theotokos, who delivers thee from great afflictions."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *CANON OF THE CROSS*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Къ разбоиники мысленыя взпадохъ ѡкаянный: и тѣхъ козньми, и ризы моея добродѣтелей, оумовреднѣ совлекохся: и душетилѣнныхъ страстеи исполненъ, вопію ти: Блгуе всенепорочнаа, непрезри мене.
items.english_cohort_translation: "I, the wretched one, have fallen among spiritual thieves, and by their wiles I was harmfully stripped of the robe of my virtues; and filled with soul-destroying passions, I cry unto thee: 'O good, all-immaculate one, despise me not!' "

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *CANON OF THE CROSS*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Жизнь моа вся, Пречтая, оуныніемъ скончавается: и приближися адъ мнѣ ѡчаленіем: но исправленіе ми даждь чтая, и не ѡстави мене внемъ ѡзлобитися, прибѣгающаго къ покрову твоему.
items.english_cohort_translation: "My whole life, O all-pure one, is spent in despondency, and Hades draws near unto me through despair; but grant me correction, O pure one, and leave me not to be afflicted therein, who flee unto thy shelter."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *CANON OF THE CROSS*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ты неможеніе вѣси смиреннаго ми телесе, язвы дша моея, срца моего стенаніе, и оума моего заблужденіе, и прелесть, тѣмже твоимъ млрдіемъ, ѡбоихъ даждь исцѣленіе.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Thou knowest the weakness of my humble body, the wounds of my soul, the groaning of my heart, and the wandering and delusion of my mind; therefore in thy tender compassion, grant healing unto both."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 3:*
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Древо преслушаніа, мірови смерть прозябе: древоже Кртное, животъ и нетлѣніе, ботъ и нетлѣніе, тѣмже тебе молимъ: распеншагося Гда: да знаменается нанасъ свѣтъ лица твоего.
items.english_cohort_translation: "The tree of disobedience budded forth death unto the world; but the Tree of the Cross brought forth life and incorruption; therefore we pray Thee, the crucified Lord: let the light of Thy countenance be signed upon us."

items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Забветію пищи изгнанъ бысть, паденіемъ падся лютым: но непрезрѣ Влко, воспріемъ мене спасаеши мя, и въ славу взводиши: избавителю мои, слава тебѣ. Муниченъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Through the forgetfulness of food was man cast out, having fallen by a grievous fall; but Thou, O Master, didst not despise him, but taking me up, Thou savest me and leadest me up into glory: O my Deliverer, glory to Thee!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 3:*
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Силы стыхъ Агглъ оудивишася, муническим страданіамъ, яко плотію ѡбложени, w мукахъ нерадиша: подобници бывше Стратемъ Спса ХА: и молат ся ѡ душахъ нашихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: "The hosts of holy Angels marvelled at the sufferings of the martyrs, how, being clothed in the flesh, they disregarded torments, having become emulators of the passions of Christ the Savior; and they pray for our souls."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 3:*
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera of the Cross, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: На Кртѣ тя воздвиженна, Хе мои, яко оузрѣ Агница многопѣтая, и Дѣва Мти твоя, рыдающи, съ плачемъ вопіяше: Сне мои и Бже мои, невезьчадну мя яви, и́же сохранналъ еси чисту, и по рождествѣ.
items.english_cohort_translation: "When the much-hymned Ewe-lamb, even the Virgin Thy Mother, beheld Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O my Christ, she cried aloud with weeping: 'O my Son and my God, childless hast Thou shown me to be, Who didst preserve me pure even after childbearing!' "

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *ON WEDNESDAY, THE BEATITUDES*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Отвергшаго Хе заповѣдь твою, праѡтца Адама, из Рая изгналъ еси, разбоинника же, щедре, исповѣдавша тя на Кртѣ: вонъ ввелилъ еси, зовуща: Помяни мя Спсе, въ цртвіи си.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Adam our forefather, who rejected Thy commandment, O Christ, didst Thou cast out of Paradise; but the Thief, O Bountiful One, who confessed Thee upon the Cross, didst Thou settle therein, who cried: 'Remember me, O Savior, in Thy Kingdom!' "

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *ON WEDNESDAY, THE BEATITUDES*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Распятъ бысть мене ради: и копіемъ прободенъ, Ісе мои, въ ребро, два источьника источи ми еси спасенія, сточи ми еси спасенія, тѣм же спасен бывъ страстію ти Хе, воспѣваю и славлю млрдіе твое: Помяни мя Спсе въ цртвіи си.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Thou wast crucified for my sake, and pierced in the rib with a lance, O my Jesus; two fountains of salvation didst Thou pour forth for me; therefore, being saved by Thy passion, O Christ, I sing and glorify Thy tender mercy: 'Remember me, O Savior, in Thy Kingdom!' "

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *ON WEDNESDAY, THE BEATITUDES*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Съ законоинннкома вмѣнився, беззаконіа всѣхъ взялъ еси Ісе: и терніемъ вѣнчанъ яко Црь всѣхъ: грѣховное терніе праѡтца, искорене, Хе, посѣкуеши, тѣмже вѣрою твою страти ннѣ славимъ. М:
items.english_cohort_translation: "Counted with the transgressors, Thou didst take away the transgressions of all, O Jesus, and wast crowned with thorns as King of all; the sinful thorns of our forefather dost Thou root out and cut down, O Christ; therefore with faith we now glorify Thy passions: 'Remember me, O Savior, in Thy Kingdom!' "

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *ON WEDNESDAY, THE BEATITUDES*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Иже стратемъ Хвымъ оуподобившеся, доблественніи страдалци, всеславніи муници, вражію прелесть низложисте силою Хвою, и неную славу получисте, ѡ всѣхъ насъ стіи молитеся.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Having emulated the passions of Christ, O valiant sufferers, all-glorious Martyrs, ye cast down the enemy's delusion by the power of Christ, and obtained heavenly glory; pray for all of us, O Saints."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *ON WEDNESDAY, THE BEATITUDES*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тріѵпоставнаа Единице, и нераздѣлнаа Трце вседѣтелнаа, существо едино и сила, пѣвца своя покрый w великаго вреда вражіа: и Цртвію сподоби, егоже получиша и́же добрѣ пожившіи.
items.english_cohort_translation: "O Trinity in three Persons, and undivided, all-creating Trinity, one essence and power: shelter Thy singers from the great harm of the enemy, and count them worthy of the Kingdom, which they who have lived well have obtained."

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Зрящи на Кртѣ, егоже ѡкровеи воплотила еси чтыхъ, плачущи возываше: Бгородителнице Дво, что сіа чадо, сонмъ лукавый воздаде тебѣ: оумертвивыи тя живота вѣрныхъ, всѣхъ воскрніе.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Beholding upon the Cross Him Whom she had incarnate of her pure blood, weeping she cried aloud: 'O Virgin Theotokos, what is this, O Child, that the wicked assembly hath rendered unto thee, putting thee to death Who art the life of the faithful and the resurrection of all?' "

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *On "Lord, I have cried", Stichera to the Holy Apostles, Tone 3. Podoben: Great is the power of Thy Martyrs:*[^121]

internal_coordinates.podoben_label_raw: Great is the power of Thy Martyrs:

items.section: On "Lord, I have cried", Stichera to the Holy Apostles, Tone 3. Podoben: Great is the power of Thy Martyrs
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Молитвами честныхъ и бжтвенныхъ Аплъ твоихъ, члколюбче щедрыи, едине млтиве: миръ твои подаждь людемъ твоимъ, и ѡ лютыхъ избави воспѣвающихъ тя, и вѣрно покланяющихтися.
items.english_cohort_translation: "By the prayers of Thine honorable and divine Apostles, O Lover of mankind, Bountiful One, only Merciful One: grant Thy peace unto Thy people, and deliver from fierce evils those who sing of Thee and faithfully bow down before Thee."

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Егда на прѣтолѣхъ ѡкончадеся сѣсти сядете: съвсѣхъ сідіен, судити всякои твари, не ѡсужденна мя покажите, и тмы и всякаго томленія избавите, блгодателе мои, Божественніи Апли.

items.section: On "Lord, I have cried", Stichera to the Holy Apostles, Tone 3. Podoben: Great is the power of Thy Martyrs
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Острѣлъ мя нечестиваго избавите, якѡ Бжіи самовидци, оугашающе того коварства: и ѡросите мя духвною росою, васъ молю мудріи блгодетели мои, Бжтвенніи Апли.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Deliver me, O eyewitnesses of God, from the arrows of the ungodly one, quenching his wiles, and bedew me with spiritual dew, I pray you, my wise benefactors, divine Apostles."

items.verbatim_book_heading: TONE 3 :: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT VESPERS
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Other Stichera to Saint Nicholas, Tone 3. Podoben: The same:*
items.section: Other Stichera to Saint Nicholas, Tone 3. Podoben: The same
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оураненъ быхъ ѡкалянныи, зміинымъ огрызеніемъ, и лежу поверженъ, мертвъ бездыханіа, содѣеною си млитвою възстави мя вскорѣ, всеблженне стлю: да славлю твою скоропослушливую блгодать.
items.english_cohort_translation: "I, the wretched one, have been wounded by the bite of the serpent, and lie cast down, dead and breathless; by thine active prayer raise me up speedily, O all-blessed Hierarch, that I may glorify thy swift-to-hear grace."

items.verbatim_book_heading: TONE 3 :: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT VESPERS
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Other Stichera to Saint Nicholas, Tone 3. Podoben: The same:*
items.section: Other Stichera to Saint Nicholas, Tone 3. Podoben: The same
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ума моего помрачившася злыми помышленми, и лежаща превидла, непрестаетъ никакоже ловляеми нама лестивомъ дрьно, но якѡ Бгъ оущедри и спаси мя, Николаа млтвами.
items.english_cohort_translation: "My mind having been darkened by evil thoughts, and lying uncared for, never ceases to be trapped by the deceitful enemy; but as God, have compassion and save me, through the prayers of Nicholas."

items.verbatim_book_heading: TONE 3 :: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT VESPERS
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Other Stichera to Saint Nicholas, Tone 3. Podoben: The same:*
items.section: Other Stichera to Saint Nicholas, Tone 3. Podoben: The same
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Веліе спасеніе всѣмъ намъ, явился еси Ніколае преблженне: избавляеши бо всяческіа бѣдъ, и напастей рабы своя и недушеніи, и недуговъ и ѡбстояніи, и враговъ невидимыхъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: "A great salvation hast thou appeared unto all of us, O all-blessed Nicholas; for thou deliverest thy servants from all kinds of afflictions and temptations, from diseases, illnesses, and circumstances, and from invisible enemies."

items.verbatim_book_heading: TONE 3 :: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT VESPERS
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Other Stichera to Saint Nicholas, Tone 3. Podoben: The same:*
items.section: Other Stichera to Saint Nicholas, Tone 3. Podoben: The same
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Веліа чудеса твоихъ чтая сила: избавляеши бо ѡ бѣдъ, и спасаеши ѡ смерти, и восхищаеши ѡ напастей неначяемыхъ, и скорен разрѣшаеши, и согрѣшеніа чакѡм ѡемлеши.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Great is the power of thy wonders, O pure one; for thou deliverest from afflictions, and savest from death, and snatchest away from unexpected temptations, and quickly loosest sorrows, and takest away sins from men."

items.verbatim_book_heading: TONE 3 :: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, AT VESPERS
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Apostles, Tone 3:*
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Apostles, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Во всю землю изыйде вѣщаніе ваше, Стіи Апли:
items.english_cohort_translation: "Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth, O holy Apostles; ye destroyed the delusion of idols and preached the knowledge of God; this is your good fight, O blessed ones; therefore we sing and glorify your memory."
items.slavonic_text: Во всю землю изыйде вѣщаніе ваше, Стіи Апли:
items.english_text: "Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth, O holy Apostles; ye destroyed the delusion of idols and preached the knowledge of God; this is your good fight, O blessed ones; therefore we sing and glorify your memory."

slavonic_provenance.verbatim_source: Во всю землю изыйде вѣщаніе ваше, Стіи Апли: Ідолскую прелесть разористе, бгоразуміе проповѣдавше: се добрыи подвигъ вашъ ест блаженніи, тѣмже поемъ, и славословимъ память ваша.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Apostles, Tone 3:*
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Apostles, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ідолскую прелесть разористе, бгоразуміе проповѣдавше: се добрыи подвигъ вашъ ест блаженніи, тѣмже поемъ, и славословимъ память ваша.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Being branches of the life-bearing vine, O glorious Apostles, ye brought yourselves as fruit of piety unto Christ; therefore, having boldness, pray that peace and great mercy may be granted unto our souls."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Apostles, Tone 3:*
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Apostles, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Живоноснаго винограда суще лозіе, славніи Апли, плодъ блгочестіа, сами ся Хву принесосте, тѣмже дерзновеніе имѣюще качемъ: просите даровати миръ, и велію милость душамъ нашимъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: "The soldiers of the Martyrs, O Lord, established by faith and strengthened by hope, being spiritually united in the love of Thy Cross,"

items.english_cohort_translation: "destroyed the enemy's tyranny and obtained crowns; with the Bodiless Powers they pray for our souls."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Apostles, Tone 3:*
items.section: At the Aposticha, Stichera to the Apostles, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Велми согрѣшающа мя Отроковице, исхити великои си молитвою, пламене нужднаго, и исправи, чтая твоими молбами, къ спасеннымъ стез[ам] наставляющи мя, матерними си молитвами.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Snatch me, who have sinned exceedingly, O Maiden, by thy great prayer, from the distressing flame; and guide me, O pure one, by thy supplications, unto saving paths, directing me by thy maternal prayers."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the First Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Apostles, Tone 3:*[^122]
items.section: After the First Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Apostles, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пріидѣте вси, Аплы восхвалимъ якѡ кормчіа, Ідольскою волесть оупразниша, и ко свѣту жизни возведоша, и къ Трцѣ вѣровати научиша, тѣмже днесь память ихъ чтно совершающе, вѣрныи, славимъ Ха Бга нашего.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Come, let us all praise the Apostles as helmsmen who abolished the delusion of idols, and led us unto the light of life, and taught us to believe in the Trinity; therefore today, honorably celebrating their memory, we the faithful glorify Christ our God."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the First Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Apostles, Tone 3:*[^122]
items.section: After the First Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Apostles, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Аплъ твоихъ память Гй, оуяснилъ еси якѡ всесиленъ, якѡ оукрѣпилъ еси тѣхъ, Стратемъ твоим подражати, побѣдиша бо мужески вражію силу, тѣмже, и пріяша исцѣленій дарованіа, тѣхъ молитвами члколюбче, миръ подаждь людемъ твоимъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Thou hast made the memory of Thine Apostles bright, O Lord, as Almighty, for Thou didst strengthen them to emulate Thy passions; for manfully they conquered the power of the enemy; therefore also they received gifts of healings; by their prayers, O Lover of mankind, grant peace unto Thy people."

items.english_text: "Thou hast made the memory of Thine Apostles bright, O Lord, as Almighty, for Thou didst strengthen them to emulate Thy passions; for manfully they conquered the power of the enemy; therefore also they received gifts of healings; by their prayers, O Lover of mankind, grant peace unto Thy people."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the First Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Apostles, Tone 3:*[^122]
items.section: After the First Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Apostles, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Милосердіа твоего богатство безмѣрное: и могоутробіа коего державу неисповѣдно пріемъ въ оумѣ: притекохъ къ покрову твоему, печалію содержимъ, и лютѣ недовѣквався, зову: из глубины срца моего моего со слезами: Дво Бце вопію ти: Спаси мя спаси, недостойнаго.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Pondering in mind the boundless wealth of thy tender mercy and the unutterable dominion of thy compassion: I flee unto thy protection, held fast by sorrow, and grievously despairing, I cry from the depth of my heart with tears: 'O Virgin Theotokos, save me, save me, the unworthy one!' "

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Second Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Apostles, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the Second Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Apostles, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Всю напоиша землю словомъ Апли, бжтвенною цѣлницею: и возрастиша класъ вѣры: и коньца вселеннѣи наполниша благости твоея Гй: и плевелы вся посѣкоша, тѣмже всѣхъ Хрту Бгу приведоша: крещающе ихъ, въ Трцу несозданную. Мунк.
items.english_cohort_translation: "The Apostles watered all the earth with the word as with divine medicine, and brought forth the ear of faith, and filled the ends of the universe with Thy goodness, O Lord, and cut down all the tares; therefore they brought all unto Christ God, baptizing them into the uncreated Trinity."

items.section: After the Second Kathisma, Sessional Hymns to the Apostles, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пррци проповѣдаша: Апли научиша: Мунци исповѣдаша: и мы вѣровахомъ: Бцу тя воистинну сущую, тѣмже и величае ржтво твое Прчтая.
items.english_cohort_translation: "The Prophets foretold, the Apostles taught, the Martyrs confessed, and we have believed that thou art truly the Theotokos; therefore also we magnify thy childbearing, O all-pure one."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Аплы твоя Хе, въ концы земны послалъ еси якѡ милосердъ: аки изѡщренны силне стрѣлы: закалающе всяко нечестіе и злосвѣтствіе: и насаждающе спасенал оученія, тѣхъ молбами щедре, миръ поддаждь душам нашимъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: "As merciful, O Christ, Thou didst send Thine Apostles unto the ends of the earth, as sharpened, mighty arrows, slaying all ungodliness and evil teaching, and planting saving teachings; by their prayers, O Bountiful One, grant peace unto our souls."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тебе проповѣдника истинны, и пресвѣтлаго свѣтилника міру, хваляще воспѣваемъ Николае: и вопіемъ вѣрою молящеся, якоже неповинныхъ ѡ смерти исхитилъ еси: тако Сті, и насъ ѡ бѣдъ и скорбеи, и всякаго избави лютаго ѡзлоблені.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Praising thee as a preacher of truth and an all-bright luminary unto the world, we hymn thee, O Nicholas, and cry out praying with faith: as thou didst snatch the innocent from death, even so, O holy one, deliver us also from afflictions, sorrows, and every cruel oppression."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оумертвившуюся душ мою согрѣшенми многими, всенепорочная Влчце, ѡживи, якѡ дерзновеніе матерне къ Сну своему имѣщи, ты бо единна родила еси паче оума и смысла, Слово собезначалное Оцу и Духу: животъ и нетлѣніе міру дарующа присно, и велію млть.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Quicken my soul, slain by many transgressions, O all-immaculate Lady, as thou hast maternal boldness toward thy Son; for thou alone, beyond mind and understanding, didst give birth unto the Word, co-unoriginate with the Father and the Spirit, Who ever grants life and incorruption unto the world, and great mercy."

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Црковныа столпы, основаніа вѣры: блгочестное оутвержденіе, и вѣрным вся оутверждающая: пріидѣте оублажимъ сщенныя Аплы: якѡ да молбами ихъ спасемъ ся.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Pillars of the Church, foundations of the faith, pious confirmation, and they that establish all things for the faithful: come, let us bless the sacred Apostles, that by their prayers we may be saved."

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Недвижмыи столпи блгочестіа: прелщеніем мл вражіимъ препятаго, и на земли лежащаго и бѣдствующаго, и недоумѣющагося, исправите: якѡ да ѡбрящу ѡставленіе, ѡнихже согрѣшихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Immovable pillars of piety: set me upright who have been tripped up by the enemy's deceit, and lie upon the earth in distress and helplessness, that I may find remission of the things wherein I have sinned."

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Самаго себе прежде суда, блудный оубояся, ѡсуждаю, злая бо дѣла безчисленнаа стяжахъ, тѣмже молютися праведный Содіе: ѡчаяннаго мя спаси, Бжтвенными молбами Аплъ твоихъ. Б[го]:
items.english_cohort_translation: "Before the judgment, I, the prodigal, fear and condemn myself, for I have acquired countless evil deeds; therefore I pray Thee, O righteous Judge: save me who am in despair, through the divine prayers of Thine Apostles."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Съ стыми Пррки, съ Аплы, и Мунки, и́же ис тебе воплощшагося, прилежно чтая Гда моли: якѡ да вся плотскіа наша страсти оумертвитъ, и животъ вѣчный нам даруе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* "With the holy Prophets, with the Apostles and Martyrs, earnestly pray the Lord Who was incarnate of thee, O pure one, that He may put to death all our carnal passions, and grant us eternal life."

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Поемъ Гви, сотворшему дивнаа чудеса, въ чермнѣмъ мори, понтомъ бо покры сопроти́вныя, и спасе Іила, того единаго воспое, яко прославися.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 1, Tone 3. The Heirmos:*[^125] *"Let us sing unto the Lord, Who wrought marvelous wonders in the Red Sea; for with the deep He covered the adversaries, and saved Israel; unto Him alone let us sing, for He hath been glorified."*

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пресвѣтлаго свѣтилника не оугасимаго, на земли сущаго столпа: и къ пристаннищу сожитѣнному призывающа, и́же волнами житейскими присно потопляемыа, Николаа вси почтим, и любовію оублажи.
items.english_cohort_translation: "As an all-bright, unquenchable luminary, a pillar upon the earth, and one who calls unto the heavenly harbor those who are ever drowned by the waves of life: let us all honor Nicholas, and bless him with love."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Силою Бжіею всеблаженне оукрѣпляемъ, ревностъ блгочестіа по разум оутяжалъ еси, тѣмже имѣщихъ смерти неправднѣ преданномъ быти, избави еси, сегоради тя молимъ, всякаго неправеднаго ѡзлобленія, избави на Николае.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Strengthened by the power of God, O all-blessed one, thou didst acquire zeal for piety according to knowledge; therefore thou didst deliver those who were unjustly about to be given over to death; for this cause we pray thee: deliver us from all unjust affliction, O Nicholas."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Моленіа Гдни оуче, неискусно принеси: якѡ да грѣховъ, и пламене муки вѣчнующія: и напастей и скорбеи, на избави, якѡ единъ преблагіи. Б[го]:
items.english_cohort_translation: "Offer prayers unto the Lord, O holy father, without ceasing: that He may deliver us from sins, and from the flame of eternal torment, and from afflictions and sorrows, as He is the only All-good One."

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ковчегъ Бжтвеный, взмѣстившіи законодателя: наша беззаконіа вся ѡемлющаго, ради млрдіа Бжтвеннаго несказанныя пучины: Мрте Пречтдо, согласно воспоемъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* "The divine Ark that contained the Lawgiver Who takes away all our iniquities for the sake of the unutterable deep of divine mercy: O all-pure Mother, let us sing in concord."

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Иже ѡ небылыхъ вся приведый, и́же міръ конца, оученія Божественнаго исполнивше: ду́шу мою исполнисте добродѣтельныхъ дѣяніи, и помышленій благихъ, Хвы самовидци.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 3. The Heirmos:* *"O Most High Ruler of all, Who from non-existence didst bring all things by the Word, which are built and perfected by the Spirit: establish me in Thy love."*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Соблазнъ многи мнози лукаваго: и всякіа скорби, и ѡбстоянія, тѣсноты, и великаго ѡбстояніа, яко оученици Хвы избавите мя.
items.english_cohort_translation: "From the many snares of the evil one, and from every sorrow, and constraint, and great tribulation: as disciples of Christ, deliver me."

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Выйми, душе моя ѡкаянная, и смиренная, часто согрѣшающи, и Бга, прогнѣвающи: како просиши прощеніа, ѡставитися ѡ злыхъ нехотящи;
items.english_cohort_translation: "Understand, O my wretched and humble soul, that often sinnest and provokest God: how dost thou, a sinner, ask forgiveness, being unwilling to cease from evil?"

items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* "O divine ladder which Jacob saw, since God descended thereon, raising us up: earnestly pray with the Apostles to have compassion on us."

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Инъ. Ірмосъ. Неплоднаа дше и безчаднаа, стяжи плодъ ѡ Ба, вѣселящися возопій, оутвердихся тобою Бже, нѣсть стъ, и нѣсть праведна паче тебе Гди.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 3. The Heirmos:* *"O barren and childless soul, acquire fruit from God, and becoming joyful, cry aloud: 'I have been established by Thee, O God; there is none holy, and there is none righteous beside Thee, O Lord!' "*

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Изѡщренъ мечъ духовный, явися еси мудре: лукавыа плевелы еретичествующыхъ посѣкуа, и стезю спасенную вѣрнымъ оуглаждая, ѡтче Николае.
items.english_cohort_translation: "A sharpened spiritual sword wast thou shown to be, O wise one, cutting down the evil tares of heretics, and smoothing the saving path for the faithful, O father Nicholas."

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тече источни и поганяющій, и оукаленія по очи, молимъся Спсе, сквер и страстей всѣхъ насъ, моли вами си ѡмыи.
items.english_cohort_translation: "A flowing and cleansing fountain, washing away the defilement: we pray Thee, O Savior, wash away the filth and passions of all of us by his prayers."

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бѣдъ и скорбей избавляя, крѣпкими си млтвами низлагая врага: и ннѣ намъ оукрѣпи недугующаа помышленіа наша, страстными понологи, стче млтвами ти ѡтче, Николае.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Delivering from afflictions and sorrows, casting down the enemy by thy mighty prayers: strengthen now our ailing thoughts against the assaults of passions, by thy prayers, O father Nicholas."

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оумъ разумѣти неможет, и́же паче оума рожденіе, чуднаго рождества твоего, Бгородительнице, Мти Дво, тѣмже молю тя: оума мои ѡблгодати, еже прно славити тя.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: заходимаго Слнца, Апли проповѣдницы, взмирскаа слове коуца: всѣхъ просвѣтиша, и безбожіа мракъ ѡгнала еси.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Heralds of the Sun that knows no setting, the Apostles enlightened all by the words of cosmic knowledge, and drove away the darkness of godlessness."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Море лютаго грѣха слове ѡбдерживаетъ мя, и волненіа безумныхъ помышленіи, смиренную душу мою смущаютъ, ѡкормителю Гдн, оученикъ твоихъ мольбами спаси мя.
items.english_cohort_translation: "A sea of fierce sin holds me fast, O Word, and the surges of foolish thoughts trouble my humble soul; O Helmsman and Lord, save me by the prayers of Thy disciples."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ужаснаа, помышляа страшнаго ти Влко пришествіа, имамъ бо прежде суда, мою ѡсуждающую мя внутрь совѣстъ, и́прежде муки мучащую нечувствіе моє.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Pondering the terrible things of Thy dread coming, O Master: I have before the judgment my conscience within me convicting me, and before the torment tormenting mine insensibility."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Слове Бжіи, рожденся ѡ Двы Бгоѡтроковица, тоя ходотайствы сщенными, и премдрыи Аплъ твоихъ Спсе, всякаго ѡбстояніа, и всякіа нужды избави рабы твоя.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* "O Word of God, Who wast born of the Virgin, the Maiden of God: by her sacred intercessions and those of Thy wise Apostles, O Savior, deliver Thy servants from every tribulation and every distress."

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Инъ. Ірмосъ. Присѣнную гору, Аввакумъ призря, Пречтаго ти чрева чтая, тѣмъ и вопіяше, ѡ юга прійдетъ Бгъ: и Стый изъ горы присѣнныя чащи.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Къ Бгу тя ходотая всякъ вѣрный, всегда Николае предлагаетъ, тѣмже тя молимъ, ѡ напастей лютыхъ, и паденіи грѣховны насъ избави ѡтче.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Every believer ever presents thee as an intercessor before God, O Nicholas; therefore we pray thee: deliver us from cruel temptations and sinful falls, O father."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Воду живу въ срци имѣи, блгодать Гдню: ѡрошаеши присно, мудре, иже зноемъ скорбеи, и душею грѣховъ сгарающии, ѡкаяннѣ погибнути имѣщи всеблаженне.
items.english_cohort_translation: "Having living water in thy heart, even the grace of the Lord: thou ever bedewest, O wise one, those who burn with the heat of sorrows and whose souls are consumed with sins, who are about to perish wretchedly, O all-blessed one."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вопло́щшее сѧ Сло́во, премно́жество бл҃гоутро́біѧ: неизрече́нно роди́ла еси́: того́ моли́ Пречт҃аѧ, пло́тскихъ всѣ́хъ страсте́й, и скве́рнъ изба́вити сѧ, и всѣ́хъ скорбе́й житіѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou hast ineffably given birth unto the incarnate Word, the plenitude of tender-compassion: pray Thou unto Him, O Most-pure One, that we be delivered from all carnal passions and defilements, and from all tribulations of this life.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, є҃. Ірмо́съ. На земли́ неви́димый ꙗви́сѧ, и съ чл҃в̑ки во́лею поживе́, непостижи́мый: тѣ́мже к тебѣ̀ ѹ́тренююще, воспѣва́емъ тѧ̀ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 5. Heirmos.* The Invisible One was seen upon earth, and being incomprehensible, He voluntarily lived among men; therefore, rising early at the dawn unto Thee, we praise Thee, O Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: На земли́ вопло́щсѧ, содѣ́лалъ еси́ ѹч҃нки нб҃са̀, вѣща́ющыхъ сла́ву твою̀, тѣ́хъ ра́ди ѹ́бо Гдⷭ҇и, дш҃а на́ша поми́луй.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оувы̀ мнѣ̀ дш҃е всестра́стнаѧ, ка́кѡ хо́щеши стра́шномꙋ сꙋди́щꙋ предста́ти, безпло́дна сꙋ́щи; по́тщисѧ пока́ѧтисѧ, добродѣ́телей пло́ды возраща́ющи.
items.english_cohort_translation: Woe is me, O my all-passionate soul! How wilt thou appear before the dread judgment seat, being destitute of fruit? Hasten to repent, bringing forth the fruits of virtues.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: На земли́ ꙗвльшагосѧ неизрече́нно, съ пло́тію, ѿ чтⷭ҇ыхъ крове́й твои́хъ, Чт҃аѧ: моли́ ꙗ́кѡ Сн҃а своего̀ всегда̀, ѡчище́ніе на́мъ дарова́ти.
items.english_cohort_translation: Unto Him Who ineffably appeared upon earth in the flesh from thy pure blood, O Pure One, pray thou ever as unto thine own Son, that He may grant us cleansing.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Инъ: Ірмо́съ. Свѣ́томъ твои́мъ невече́рнимъ Хе, ѡзари́ Бж҃е смире́нную мою̀ дш҃ꙋ, и наста́ви на стезю̀ твою̀, зане́ свѣ́тъ, повелѣ́ніа твоѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Another [Canon]. Heirmos.* With Thine unwaning light, O Christ, illumine, O God, my humble soul, and guide it into Thy path; for Thy commandments are light.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Свѣ́тъ чи́стомꙋ престо́лꙋ, и чтⷭ҇ныхъ при́снѡ исхожда́щими за́рами просвѣща́емъ, ѿче́: испроси́ всѣ́мъ ѡчище́ніе и мл҃ть.
items.english_cohort_translation: O father, illuminated by the pure throne and by the beams ever proceeding from the venerable [mysteries], entreat cleansing and mercy for all.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мене́ и́же па́че всѣ́хъ чл҃къ тебѐ прогнѣ́вавшаго, ѹмо́мъ неразꙋ́мнымъ, пребл҃гіи ѡꙋщедри́, Никола́а те́плыми мл҃твами.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́кѡ еди́на А́гг҃лѡмъ ра́дость, ра́дости мою̀ испо́лни Бгора́дованнаѧ мы́сль, сѣ́тꙋющꙋю, и лѣ́ностію погружа́емꙋю.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бе́здна премꙋ́дрости дх҃овныѧ, неисточи́ши Ап҃льское сосло́віе, мірскаго ꙗзы́къ мудрова́ніѧ тече́ніе, и напои́ бл҃гочести́ваѧ собра́ніа.
items.english_cohort_translation: O apostolic choir, thou unfailing abyss of spiritual wisdom, dry up the stream of the worldly wisdom of the nations, and water the assemblies of the pious.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Воздхни́ и прослези́сѧ смире́ннаѧ дш҃е моѧ̀, и возопі́й къ Гдⷭ҇у, глаго́лющи: согрѣши́хъ ти Ꙗ́кѡ: ѡчи́сти мѧ̀ бл҃гоѹтро́бне, мольба́ми премꙋ́дрыхъ А́пѡлъ твои́хъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Sigh and weep, O my humble soul, and cry aloud unto the Lord, saying: I have sinned against Thee; cleanse me, O Tender-hearted One, by the intercessions of Thine all-wise Apostles.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Собо́ръ тѧ̀ А́пѡлѡвъ Хѐ мо́литъ, съ ро́жшею тѧ̀, ѡчище́ніе на́мъ посли́, и ми́ръ рабо́мъ твои́мъ: ꙗ́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ, и Бг҃ъ бл҃гопремѣни́тель.
items.english_cohort_translation: The assembly of the Apostles, O Christ, together with Her that bare Thee, entreats Thee: send down cleansing unto us, and peace unto Thy servants, as Thou art the Lover of mankind and God Who art easily reconciled.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Инъ: Ірмо́съ. Газе́нна страсте́й воста̀ на́ма, и бꙋ́рѧ сопроти́вныѧ ми вѣ́трѡвъ, но предва́ривъ мѧ̀ ты̀, спаси́ Сп҃се: и изба́ви ѿ нетлѣ́ніѧ, ꙗ́коже спа́слъ еси́ ѿ ѕвѣ́рѧ Прр́ка.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Another [Canon]. Heirmos.* The depth of passions hath risen against me, and the tempest of contrary winds; but preventing me, save me, O Savior, and deliver me from corruption, as Thou didst save the Prophet from the beast.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оумертви́ воздержа́ніемъ ѹ́ды, стѧжа́лъ еси́ жи́знь нестарѣ́емꙋю, е́йже и на́съ ѡбщ́нники твои́ми твои́ми моли́твами содѣ́лай мꙋ́дре: и́збѣжа́ніемъ лю́калаго дѣѧ́ніа.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having mortified thy members through abstinence, thou hast acquired ageless life; make us also partakers thereof by thy prayers, O wise one, by fleeing from evil deeds.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вѣтри́ломъ сщ҃енныхъ твои́хъ моли́твъ, пꙋчи́ны напа́стей многоѡбра́зныхъ, и грѣхо́вныѧ глꙋбины̀ извле́цы на́съ: къ приста́нищꙋ же живота̀ приводи́ мꙋ́дре ст҃лю́.
items.english_cohort_translation: By the sail of thy sacred prayers, draw us forth from the deep abyss of manifold temptations and from the gulf of sins; and guide us unto the haven of life, O wise hierarch.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Всели́сѧ въ ѹтро́бꙋ твою̀ Сло́во, Мт҃и Чтⷭ҇аѧ: дре́вле въ чл҃цѣхъ всели́выйсѧ, ѡ преступле́ніа тли́, ꙗ́кѡ Бг҃ъ еди́нъ внѣ̀ изгна́лъ е, за бл҃гоѹтро́біѧ мл҃ть.
items.english_cohort_translation: The Word took up His abode within Thy womb, O Pure Mother; He Who of old dwelt among men cast out corruption through transgression, as He alone is God, through the mercy of His tender-compassion.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, з҃. Ірмо́съ. Пе́рвѣе ѡ́бразꙋ зла́томꙋ, Пе́рсском че́сти, дѣ́ти непоклони́шасѧ трі́е, пою́ще посредѣ̀ пе́щи: ѡ́тцъ на́шихъ Бж҃е, бл҃гвнъ еси́.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́же свѣ́тъ мі́рꙋ, Хс҃: свѣ́тъ вт҃ры́й показа̀ свѣтоно́сныѧ А́плн: разганѧ́ющыхъ тмꙋ̀ прельще́ніа, и просвѣща́ющы вѣ́рны мы́сли.
items.english_cohort_translation: Christ, Who is the Light of the world, hath shown forth the light-bearing Apostles as a second light, dispersing the darkness of deception and enlightening the minds of the faithful.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́же на́ны вражíа сѣ́ти сокрꙋши́те, бл҃гогла́сніи А́пли, и стезѧ̀ на́мъ покаѧ́ніа, ѹгла́дѣте, къ ва́мъ прибѣга́ющій.
items.english_cohort_translation: Break in pieces the snares of the enemy set against us, O sweet-voiced Apostles, and smooth for us the path of repentance, who flee unto you.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Добро́то Іа́кѡвлѧ, добры́хъ мѧ̀ зра́ки просвѣти́, молю́сѧ: моли́сѧ мнѣ̀ съ А́плы, ро́жшемꙋ тѧ̀ ѿ твои́хъ чтⷭ҇ныхъ крове́й.
items.english_cohort_translation: O beauty of Jacob, enlighten, I pray Thee, the eyes of my heart with goodly form; pray for me together with the Apostles unto Him Who was born of Thy pure blood.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Гла́дщаго дре́вле, Гдⷭ҇на лю́ди, безꙋ́мнаго Арíа, ѹдави́лъ еси́ жи́лами слове́съ твои́хъ: ꙗ́кѡ па́стыремъ нача́лникъ и́стинный, ѡ́тче Никола́е.
items.english_cohort_translation: Arius, who of old raged against the Lord's people, thou hast strangled with the sinews of thy words, O father Nicholas, as a true prince of pastors.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сщ҃но преше́ престо́е житіѐ твоѐ, съ ст҃ы́ми живе́ши ѡ́тче Никола́е, ѡсщ҃еніе посыла́ѧ и просвѣще́ніе, и́же бл҃гоче́стно тѧ̀ блажа́щій.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having holily passed thy venerable life, thou dwellest with the saints, O father Nicholas, sending down sanctification and enlightenment unto those who piously call thee blessed.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мене́, и́же небреже́ніемъ дш҃ꙋ ѡмрачи́вшаго, просвѣти́ Чтⷭ҇аѧ, ꙗ́же свѣ́тъ ро́жшаѧ, Ср́дца моего̀ возжи́гающи свѣти́лникъ, ꙗ́кѡ да ѹсе́рдіемъ бл҃ги сла́влю тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Unto me who through negligence have darkened my soul, do thou grant light, O Pure One, who hast given birth unto the Light, kindling the lamp of my heart, that with zeal I may praise thee, O Good One.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Звѣздя́хся страсте́й ѡрꙋ́жіемъ, и ѡстренꙋ́хъ ср́це безꙋ́міемъ, зловѣ́ Содѣ́телемъ, А́пли сла́вніи, исцѣли́те мѧ̀ всего́ невреди́мѧща, дꙋша́мъ и тѣ́лѡ враче́ве сꙋ́ще.
items.english_cohort_translation: I have been wounded by the weapon of passions, and have pierced my heart with folly, acting wickedly against the Creator; O glorious Apostles, heal me entirely unharmed, being physicians of souls and bodies.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Во всю̀ зе́млю проповѣ́дникѡвъ изы́йде вѣща́ніе Бж҃твенное, ѹча́щее правосла́внѡ ѡ еди́нственнѣмъ Сщ҃ентвѣ: и еди́но Ес҃тво почита́ти ст҃ыѧ Тр҃ца: и еди́но вои́стинну Гдⷭ҇тво, еди́но црⷭ҇тво вовѣ́ки вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: The divine proclamation of the preachers hath gone forth into all the earth, teaching orthodoxly concerning the singular Priesthood, and to honor the singular Essence of the Holy Trinity, and the one true Lordship, one Kingdom, unto ages of ages.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Менѐ мно́го согрѣши́вшаго, и долготерпѣ́ніе твоѐ бж҃твенное ѡжида́вшаго, ко пребыва́ніи прегрѣше́ній: ѡбрати́ Влчⷪ҇ко, и нѣ́даждь мою̀ не́мощь, Сло́ве, въ лѣ́ность и злосмѣ́діе. Б[го]:
items.english_cohort_translation: Turn me back, O Master, who have sinned much and have awaited Thy divine long-suffering in the persistence of transgressions, and let not my weakness, O Word, turn into negligence and scorn. Theotokion:

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бж҃твеннаѧ клѣщѐ, ꙗ́же бж҃твенны ѹ́гль неизрече́ннѣ пріе́мши, Кц҃е: страсте́й мои́хъ раждеже́нное ѹ́гліе, ѹгаси́ Прчⷭ҇таѧ, росо́ю твои́хъ моли́твъ: и всѣхъ сла́вныхъ и бж҃твенный А́плъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: O divine tongs, who ineffably received the divine coal, O Mother of God: quench the burning coal of my passions, O Most-pure One, with the dew of thy prayers, and of all the glorious and divine Apostles.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Инъ. Ірмо́съ. И́же ѡ А́гг҃лъ немо́лчно, вовы́шнихъ сла́вимаго Кг҃а, нб҃са̀, землѧ́же, го́ры, и хо́лми, и глубина̀: и ве́сь ро́дъ чл҃чкій: пѣ́сньми его̀, ꙗ́кѡ зижди́телѧ, и тво́рца бл҃гвте.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Another [Canon]. Heirmos.* Bless the Lord, Who is unceasingly glorified in the highest by the Angels: the heavens, the earth, the mountains, the hills, the deep, and all the race of mankind, with hymns bless Him as Creator and Maker.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Зе́млю кро́ткихъ наслѣ́довалъ еси́, кро́тока прпⷣбне бы́въ, тѣ́мжетѧ молю̀ вѣ́рно: ѹкроти́ мл҃твами си, подвиза́ющаѧсѧ на́ма при́снѡ лꙋка́ваго треволне́ніа.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou hast inherited the land of the meek, having become meek, O venerable one; therefore I pray thee faithfully: by thy prayers assuage the tempest of the crafty one that is ever stirred up against us.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́коже изба́вилъ еси́ Воево́ды, непра́веднѣ ѹмрѣ́ти имѣ́вшаѧ: та́кѡ ѡ чл҃къ лꙋка́выхъ ѡзлобле́ніа, на́съ изба́ви: и ѡ всѧ́каго бѣ́совскаго навѣ́та, Никола́е, моли́ Сп҃са.
items.english_cohort_translation: Even as thou didst deliver the generals who were about to die unjustly, so deliver us from the affliction of wicked men, and from every demonic assault, O Nicholas, praying unto the Savior.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Крѣ́пость и пѣ́ніе моѐ е́сть, и́же ис тебѐ рожде́йсе пренепоро́чнаѧ, его́же приле́жнѡ моли́, разсла́бленнаго мѧ̀ стра́стьми, Дв҃о, ѹкрѣпи́ти, твори́ти спасе́ннаѧ его̀ повелѣ́ніа.
items.english_cohort_translation: My strength and my song is He Who was born of thee, O All-immaculate One; entreat Him earnestly, O Virgin, to strengthen me who am weakened by passions, to perform His saving commandments.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. Ірмо́съ. Въ зако́нѣ сѣ́ниемъ и писа́ніи, ѡ́бразъ ви́дим вѣ́рныи, всѧ́ко бо ѻтроча̀, ложесна̀ разверза́ѧ, ст҃о Бг҃ови, тѣ́мъ перворожде́нное Сло́во, ѿ О́ц҃а безнача́лна Сн҃а, перворожде́нна ма́терію: неискꙋсому́жнѣ велича́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 9. Heirmos.* In the shadow and letter of the Law, we the faithful perceive a figure: every male that opens the womb is holy unto God; therefore the Firstborn Word of the unoriginate Father, the Son Who is the firstborn of a Mother that knew not man, do we magnify.[^128]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́же словесы̀ твои́хъ ѹчени́къ, ѹтверди́лъ еси́ земны́ѧ концы̀ О́ц҃а безнача́лнаго Сло́ве: тѣ́хъ молба́ми, и мене́ и́же къ страсте́мъ безслове́снымъ попо́лзшагосѧ: и къ бѣ́совскимъ прельсти́всѧ седе́ніа бы́вша, ѹще́дри.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Word of the unoriginate Father, Who by the words of Thy disciples hast established the ends of the earth: through their supplications show mercy also unto me, who have slipped into irrational passions and have fallen into demonic delusions.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дꙋшѐ моѧ̀, страсте́й работа́ющаѧ ѹстремле́ніамъ: пострада́вшемꙋ на ра́ди принеси́ мольбы: ꙗ́кѡ да изба́витъ тѧ̀ люты́хъ, молѧ́щимсѧ просла́вленѣ сщ҃еннымъ ѹч҃никѡмъ: подража́вши того̀, пло́тію его̀ страда́ніа.
items.english_cohort_translation: O my soul, enslaved to the impulses of passions, offer supplications unto Him Who suffered for our sake, that He may deliver thee from tribulations, when the glorious and sacred disciples pray, having in their flesh imitated His sufferings.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́кѡ ѡгражде́ніе бж҃твенное и ѹтверже́ніе, и добро́ пренесѣ́нное: земны́й ми́ръ стѧжа́ тѧ, ходота́йствы ко твои́ми, при́снѡ избавлѧ́етсѧ ѡ всѧ́кій напа́стей, и тѣсноты̀ ѡ́тче Никола́е. Тѣ́мже во хвале́ніи вѣ́рно ѹблажа́е тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: As a divine bulwark and confirmation and pre-eminent excellence, the earthly world hath acquired thee; by thine intercessions, O father Nicholas, it is ever delivered from every temptation and distress; therefore in praise we faithfully call thee blessed.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ст҃и́телемъ бы́въ мно́гими ѡтяготи́и, ко простра́нствꙋ прибѣга́ю всеблаже́нне, те́плыхъ мл҃твъ твои́хъ: претво́ри дш҃ѧ моеѧ̀, вопію́ ти, болѣ́зни, во́лны ѹкроти́ ѡчаѧ́ніа, и ѹ́мную моего̀ ѹ́ма смꙋще́ніе.
items.english_cohort_translation: Being weighed down by many tribulations, I flee unto the breadth of thy fervent prayers, O all-blessed hierarch; transform the afflictions of my soul, I cry unto thee, calm the waves of despair, and quiet the agitation of my mind.

provenance.verbatim_source: Being weighed down by many tribulations, I flee unto the breadth of thy fervent prayers, O all-blessed hierarch; transform the afflictions of my soul, I cry unto thee, calm the waves of despair, and quiet the agitation of my mind.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тво́рца настои́тъ прише́ствіе, сꙋди́ти все́й земли́: и негото́въ сы́й ѡка́ѧнный, кѣ́мъ ѹѹстраша́юсѧ, помышлѧ́ю зо́лъ мои́хъ мно́жество. Гдⷭ҇и, долготерпѣли́ве, ѹще́дри и спаси́ мѧ, бж҃твенными Никола́а моли́твами, прпⷣбнаго твоего̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: The advent of the Creator is at hand to judge the whole earth; and being unprepared, wretch that I am, I am terrified, contemplating the multitude of mine evils. O Lord, Long-suffering One, show tender mercy and save me, through the divine prayers of Nicholas, Thy venerable servant.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Просвѣще́ніе ми спасе́ное на́нса, ꙗ́же ро́жшаѧ свѣ́тъ, дш҃а моѧ̀ ѡ́блаки разгоня́ющи, мно́гла и лю́таѧ, ꙗ́кѡ да Сн҃а днѐ, мл҃твами ти бꙋ́дꙋ, содѣ́ваа при́снѡ, ꙗ́ко да пѣсносло́вленіи прно, ѹблажа́ю тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Thou who hast given birth unto the Light, cause saving enlightenment to dawn upon me, dispersing the many and dark clouds of my soul, that by Thy prayers I may become a child of the day, ever performing what is good, so that in hymns I may ever call Thee blessed.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Во всю̀ зе́млю изы́йде вѣща́ніе ва́ше, Ст҃íи А́пли: І́дольскую ле́сть разори́сте, бг҃оразꙋ́міе проповѣ́давше: се́ добры́й по́двигъ ва́шъ е́сть бл҃же́нніи, тѣ́мже пое́мъ, и славосло́вимъ па́мѧти ва́ша.
items.english_cohort_translation: Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth, O holy Apostles; ye abolished the deception of idols, having proclaimed the knowledge of God; behold, this is your goodly contest, O blessed ones; therefore we sing and glorify your memory.[^129]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Хвы̀ заповѣ́ди непоро́чнѣ сохран́ше, Ст҃íи А́пли: то́го прія́сте, тѣ́мже подава́ете: исцѣлѧ́юще стра́сти дꙋ́шъ и теле́съ на́шихъ. Тѣ́мже, имѣ́юще дерзнове́ніе, то́го моли́те, поми́ловати сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шимъ. М:
items.english_cohort_translation: Having kept the commandments of Christ blamelessly, O holy Apostles, ye received from Him, and therefore ye distribute, healing the passions of our souls and bodies; therefore, having boldness, pray unto Him that He may have mercy upon our souls. Martyrion:

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́кѡ свѣти́ла въ мі́рѣ сíѧете, и по сме́рти ст҃и́и мꙋ́ннци: по́двигомъ двигомъ до́брымъ подви́гшесѧ, имѣ́юще дерзнове́ніе, Ха̀ ѹмоли́те, поми́ловатися душа́мъ на́ши[мъ].
items.english_cohort_translation: As luminaries ye shine in the world, and after death, O holy martyrs, having fought the good fight, having boldness, pray unto Christ that He may have mercy upon our souls.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Безсѣ́меннѣ зачала̀ еси́ ѿ Дх҃а ст҃а́: и славосло́вѧще воспѣва́ем тѧ: Ра́дꙋйсѧ Пречт҃аѧ Дв҃о.
items.english_cohort_translation: Without seed hast Thou conceived by the Holy Spirit; and glorifying Thee, we sing: Rejoice, O Most-pure Virgin.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Отвергшаго Хѐ, за́повѣдь твою̀, пра́ѡтца Ада́ма, из Раѧ̀ изгна́лъ еси́: разбо́инника же ще́дре, исповѣ́давша тѧ на Кр́тѣ, во́нь ввели́лъ еси́, зовꙋ́ща: Помѧни́ мѧ Сп҃се, въ црⷭ҇твіи си.
items.english_cohort_translation: The forefather Adam, who rejected Thy commandment, O Christ, didst Thou cast out of Paradise; but the thief, O Tender-hearted One, who confessed Thee upon the Cross, didst Thou lead therein, crying: Remember me, O Savior, in Thy Kingdom.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́же тро́стію Кр́тною ѡглавле́нны невѣ́деніа, лю́ди изъе́мше А́панли: и е́ллинскую пре́лесть ѡ́гнасте ѿ землѧ̀: неле́стніи спаси́теліе бы́сте вѣ́рнымъ кои́стиннꙋ, тѣ́мже, блажи́ми естѐ.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Apostles, who with the rod of the Cross drew forth people ensnared by ignorance, and drove away the Hellenic deception from the earth: ye have truly become sincere deliverers unto the faithful; therefore ye are called blessed.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́кѡ лꙋ́чы та́йныѧ, и свѣти́ла Сл҃нца пра́вды бы́вше, сла́вніи А́пли, зловѣ́стіа тмꙋ̀ ѡгна́сте, и къ свѣ́тꙋ бг҃оразꙋ́міа наста́висте всѧ лю́ди: тѣ́мже ва́съ почита́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having become mystical rays and luminaries of the Sun of righteousness, O glorious Apostles, ye drove away the darkness of impiety, and guided all people unto the light of the knowledge of God; therefore we honor you.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́камъ ражже́ніа претерпѣ́вше, бы́вше страда́льцы бл҃года́ти ро́сꙋ прія́сте, и чл҃ческая стра́сти ꙗ́кѡ Хв҃ы ѹго́дници, при́снѡ бл҃гоче́стно мꙋ́дріи исцѣлѧ́ете: тѣ́мже, вѣ́рнѡ ва́съ Ст҃íи почита́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having endured the burning of tortures, ye suffered and received the dew of grace, and as servants of Christ, O wise martyrs, ye ever piously heal human passions; therefore we faithfully honor you, O holy ones.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: А́плѡмъ добро́та: и Ст҃ы́хъ стратоте́рпецъ радова́ніе, бг҃обл҃года́тнѣйшаѧ Влчⷪ҇це, ѡ на́съ моли́ всѣ́хъ, Сп҃са и Бг҃а, ꙗ́кѡ да прегрѣше́ніи пріи́мемъ ѡставле́ніе: и Бж҃твенныѧ жи́зни вси прича́стници бꙋ́демъ.

items.section: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Гдⷭ҇и, безстра́стенъ сы́й Бж҃тве́нымъ естество́мъ свои́мъ, стра́сть па́ки претерпѣ́лъ еси́: по естествꙋ̀ тѣле́сномꙋ своемꙋ̀, на Кр́тѣ ѹ́бѡ пригвожда́емъ, ко́піемъ же непоколе́блемо ребро̀, источи́ла ми двѣ̀ рѣцѣ̀ ѿ него̀, та́инствахъ неизрече́нныхъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Lord, being passionless in Thy divine nature, Thou didst endure suffering according to Thy bodily nature, being nailed unto the Cross; and Thy lance-pierced side, immovably steadfast, poured forth two rivers for me in ineffable mysteries.[^131]

items.section: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вѣнце́мъ ѿте́рніа неплетеннымъ, ѹ́вѧзлсѧ порфѵ́рою Цр҃ь всѣ́хъ, запрꙋще́ніе, Сп҃се, терно́внаго грѣха̀ нетѐрзаѧ, рꙋка́маже свою̀, имѧ̀ твое́стъ пріе́мъ: въ го́рней кни́зѣ, написа́лъ еси́ всѣ́хъ на́съ, и́же Бг҃а вѣ́ровавшій.
items.english_cohort_translation: Crowned with an unwoven crown of thorns, the King of all was clad in a purple robe; not tearing the barrier of thorny sin, O Savior, but receiving Thy name with Thy hands, Thou hast written all of us who have believed in God in the heavenly book.

items.section: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Преста̀ ника́ко же Евре́ѡмъ за́висть непра́веднаѧ: нижѐ распе́ншымъ тѧ̀ неѕло́биве: нижѐ ѹме́ршꙋ ти, Хѐ: но и та́кѡ ѡклевета́хꙋ, ꙗ́коже ле́стьца, ѹ Пила́та лю́тыи проси́ша стрещи́ гро́бъ тво́й, ѡ гнѣ́ва неисцѣ́льнаго.
items.english_cohort_translation: In no wise did the unjust envy of the Hebrews cease, neither against Thee Who wast crucified, O Guileless One, nor when Thou wast dead, O Christ; but even so they slandered Thee as a deceiver, and the cruel ones asked Pilate to guard Thy tomb, because of their incurable wrath.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Влчⷪ҇це, ро́жшіѧ грѧдꙋ́щаго жи́выѧже и ме́ртвымъ сꙋди́ти, ѡумерщвле́ннꙋ ми дш҃ꙋ болѣ́знію, покаѧ́ніемъ ѡживи́: и Бж҃твенною Кро́вію, и́же и́зре́бръ Сн҃а твоего̀ и́стекшем: и кне́мꙋ его̀ за́повѣдемъ, дѣ́лателѧ мнѝ мѧ̀.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Егда̀ тѧ̀ ча́до безболѣ́зни роди́хъ, А́гница и Мт҃и гла́ше: ско́рби избѣжа́хъ, и печа́лей мгла̀: но нн҃ѣ тѧ̀ воздвиже́на на Кр́тѣ зрѧ́щи: ѹтро́бо моѧ̀, го́ркими стрѣла́ми ср́це ѡбла́гаю: и печа́лію безмѣ́рною погружа́юсѧ, Влчⷪ҇ко.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Lady, who gavest birth unto Him Who is to judge the living and the dead: quicken my soul which is deadened through illness by repentance, and by the divine Blood that flowed from the side of thy Son, make me a doer of His commandments.

items.section: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дала̀ есѝ ро́жшисѧ изъ тебѐ лю́демъ твои́мъ Хрⷭ҇тіаномъ, тмы̀ вели́кую побо́рницꙋ, и держа́вное прибѣ́жище, несмѣ́ніе бо мт҃и тѧ Хѐ, ра́ди мно́гихъ грѣхѡ́въ, въ мл҃твꙋ сію̀ ти преложи́хомъ: и пречтⷭ҇ыѧ твоѧ̑ стра̑сти.
items.english_cohort_translation: When I bare Thee without travail, O Child, said the Ewe-lamb and Mother, I escaped affliction and the mist of sorrows; but now, beholding Thee lifted up upon the Cross, O my Womb, my heart is encompassed by bitter arrows, and I am submerged in boundless sorrow, O Master.

items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.english_cohort_translation: To Thy Christian people Thou hast given Him Who was born of Thee, as a great champion against darkness and a mighty refuge; for having no boldness toward Thee, O Christ, because of our many sins, we offer this prayer unto Thee through His Mother, and Thy most-pure sufferings.

items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кр́тꙋ твое́му покланѧ́емсѧ, Хѐ, чтⷭ҇но́му, со храни́телю мірови, сп҃се́нію на́ грѣ́шникѡ, вели́комꙋ ѡчище́нію, цр҃кви побѣ́дѣ, и похва́лѣ всеѧ̀ вселе́нныѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: We venerate Thy Cross, O Christ, the precious guardian of the world, the salvation of us sinners, the great cleansing, the victory of the Church, and the praise of the whole universe.

items.section: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кр́тоѡбра́знѡ Мѡѷсе́й на горѣ̀, рꙋ́цѣ воздви́гъ къ высотѣ̀: Амали́ка побѣжда́ше: ты́же Сп҃се, дла́ни распросте́ръ на Кр́тѣ чтⷭ҇нѣмъ, ѡбъе́мъ мѧ̀, спа́слъ есѝ ѿ рабо́ты вра́жїѧ: и да́лъ ми есѝ зна́меніе живота̀: бѣжа́ти ѿ лꙋ́ка проти́вныхъ мнѝ. его́ ра́ди, Сло́ве, покланѧ́емсѧ Кр́тꙋ твое́му чтⷭ҇ному.
items.english_cohort_translation: Moses upon the mountain, lifting up his hands toward the height in the figure of the Cross, overcame Amalek; and Thou, O Savior, stretching out Thy palms upon the precious Cross, embracing me, hast saved me from the bondage of the enemy, and hast given me the sign of life, to flee from the bow of those who oppose me; therefore, O Word, we venerate Thy precious Cross.[^132]

items.section: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Си́ла Кр́та твоего́ Гдⷭ҇и си́ла: водрузи́босѧ на мѣ́стѣ, и дѣ́йствꙋетъ въ мі́рѣ, и показа̀ ѡ рыбаре́й А́плы, и ѡ ꙗ́зыкъ мꙋ́ченики: да мо́лѧтсѧ ѡ дꋋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Great is the power of Thy Cross, O Lord: for it was planted in one place, and works throughout the world, and made Apostles out of fishermen, and martyrs out of the nations, that they may pray for our souls.

items.day_or_date: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Зрѧ́щи тѧ̀ всенепоро́чнаѧ воздви́женна на дре́во, Хѐ мо́й, прибл҃гіи: пла́чꙋщи вопіѧ́ше ма́терски: Сн҃е мо́й вселюбе́зный: ка́кѡ со́нмъ беззако́нный, на Кр́тѣ тѧ̀ воздви́же;
items.english_cohort_translation: Beholding Thee, O my Christ, the All-good One, lifted up upon the tree, the All-immaculate One cried aloud, weeping maternally: O my most-beloved Son, how hath the lawless assembly lifted Thee up upon the Cross?

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кр́тъ и сме́рть пострада́ти изво́ливый: посредѣ̀ тва́ри сл҃ца претерпѣ́лъ есѝ, егда̀ бл҃гоизво́лилъ Сп҃се, чл҃къ своѐ пригвозди́ти, тогда́: и сл҃нце лꙋ́ча съкрыва́ѧ: и разбо́йникъ зрѧ̀, на Кр́тѣ тѧ̀ воспѣ́тъ, копіа́ ти бл҃гоговѣ́йно: Помѧни́ мѧ Гдⷭ҇и, и въ кро́вахъ прія́тъ Гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Savior, to crucify Thy flesh; then the sun hid its rays, and the thief beholding Thee upon the Cross cried out reverently: Remember me, O Lord, and was received into the heavenly mansions, O Lord.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: ON THURSDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Нескве́рнаѧ А́гница сло́ву: нетлѣ́ннаѧ Дв҃а Мт҃и: на Кр́тѣ зрѧ́щи ѡвѣше́нна, и́же изнеѧ̀ безболѣ́зни прозѧ́бшаго: мт҃роподо́бнѣ рыда́ющи, взпіѧ́ше: ѹвы́ мнѣ̀ ча́до моѐ: ка́кѡ стра́ждеши во́лею; хотѧ̀ изба́вити ѡ страсте́й безче́стіа чл҃ка.
items.english_cohort_translation: The spotless Ewe-lamb of the Word, the incorrupt Virgin Mother, seeing Him Who sprouted from Her without travail suspended upon the Cross, weeping maternally, cried aloud: Woe is me, my Child! How dost Thou suffer voluntarily, wishing to deliver mankind from the dishonor of passions?

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́з Кѵпари́ссѣ и Пе́ѵкѣ и Ке́дрѣ, возне́слсѧ еси́ А́гньче Бж҃ій: да спасе́ши и́же Кр́томъ покланѧ́ющихсѧ, во́лномꙋ ти распѧ́тію, Хѐ Бж҃е, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: From the cypress, the pine, and the cedar, Thou didst ascend, O Lamb of God, that Thou mightest save those who venerate Thy voluntary crucifixion with the Cross; O Christ God, glory be to Thee.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Неисче́тнѣи вла́сти твое́й, и во́льномꙋ ти распѧ́тію: А́гг҃льскаѧ во́инства дивлѧ́хꙋсѧ зрѧ́ще: ка́кѡ неви́димый, пло́тію ра́ны подя́тъ, хотѧ̀ изба́вити ѡ нетлѣ́ніа чл҃чество: тѣ́мже ꙗ́кѡ бл҃года́телю вопіе́мъ ти: сла́ва Хѐ, бл҃гоѹтро́бію твое́му. М[унк]:

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бл҃году́шне терпѣ́ніа ва́шего: побѣди́ ко́зни злонача́лнаго врага̀, мꙋ́нци прехва́лніи, сего̀ ра́ди, вѣ́чномꙋ сподо́бистесѧ бл҃же́нствꙋ: но моли́тесѧ Гдⷭ҇н, Хр́тоимени́тыхъ люде́й спасти́ ста́до, свидѣ́теліе сꙋ́ще и́стинны.
items.english_cohort_translation: The noble endurance of your patience overcame the snares of the evil-originating enemy, O all-praised martyrs; therefore ye have been accounted worthy of eternal blessedness; but pray ye unto the Lord to save the flock of the people named after Christ, being witnesses of the truth.

items.section: After the Second Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Поноше́нію ще́дре сме́рть, въ ра́спѧтіи во́лею претерпѣ́лъ есѝ, е́же ро́ждшіѧ тѧ̀ Хѐ зрѧ́щи ѹѧзвла́- ѹѧзвла́шесѧ, е́же мольба́ми, за мл҃рдіе мт҃ри твоеѧ̀: еди́не пребл҃гíи чл҃колю́бче Гдⷭ҇и: ѹще́дри и спаси́ мі́ръ: вземлѧ́й мі́рꙋ грѣхѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Unto death with reproach, O Tender-hearted One, didst Thou voluntarily submit in Thy crucifixion; seeing which, She that bare Thee, O Christ, was wounded in heart, was wounded, by whose prayers, for the sake of Thy Mother's tender-compassion, O only Most-good Lover of mankind, O Lord: show mercy and save the world, Thou Who takest away the sins of the world.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кр́тъ претерпѣ́лъ еси́ безгрѣ́шне, клѧ́твы сосꙋ́дъ, за мл҃рдіе не изрече́нное: и первозда́ннаго, пе́рвыѧ клѧ́твы свободи́лъ еси́. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ вѣ́рнымъ поклана́емъсѧ стра́стемъ, смотре́ніе твоѐ Сп҃се, сла́вѧще: е́же еди́нъ за мл҃рдіе мт҃и испо́лнилъ : созда́ніе своѐ, спа́слъ еси́.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst endure the Cross, O Sinless One, as a vessel of the curse, through ineffable tender-compassion; and the first-formed man hast Thou delivered from the original curse; therefore we the faithful venerate Thy passions, glorifying Thy dispensation, O Savior, which Thou alone hast accomplished through the tender-compassion of Thy Mother: Thou hast saved Thine own creation.

items.section: After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ лани́тꙋ ѹда́ренъ бы́въ за ро́дъ чл҃ческій, и не разгнѣ́валсѧ, свободи́ азъ нетлѣ́ніа живо́тъ на́шъ Гдⷭ҇и: и поми́лꙋй на́съ, ꙗ́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Struck on the cheek for the sake of the human race, and not being angered, deliver our life from corruption, O Lord, and have mercy upon us, as the Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, а҃. Гл, г҃. Ірмо́съ. Сꙋ́шу глубороди́телную зе́млю, сл҃нце наши́ствова иногда̀: ꙗ́ко стѣна̀ бо ѡгꙋстѣ̀ ѡ́баполы вода̀, лю́демъ пѣ́шнымъ глуби́нꙋ проходѧ́щымъ: и бг҃оѹго́дно пою́щим: Пое́мъ Гдⷭ҇ви, сла́вно бо просла́висѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 1. Tone 3. Heirmos.* The sun once traversed the dry, deep-rooted earth; for the water solidified on both sides like a wall for the people traversing the deep on foot, and singing in a manner pleasing unto God: Let us sing unto the Lord, for He is gloriously glorified.[^134]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Во́лны морскíѧ жезло́мъ ѡугꙋсти́: и просѣ́клъ еси́ лю́ди, прошѐдъ звѣ́ Кр́тъ тво́й, и́мѧже вкла́лъ еси́ во́дꙋ лю́тнꙋю: и къ земли́ ще́дре бг҃оразꙋ́міа, спа́слъ еси́ всѣ́хъ, и́же вѣ́рою пою́щихъ твою̀ си́лꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst congeal the sea waves with a rod, and didst divide them for the people, prefiguring Thy Cross, through which Thou hast swallowed the bitter water, and hast brought them unto the land of divine knowledge, O Tender-hearted One, saving all who sing with faith of Thy power.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бе́зднꙋ сотвори́ повелѣ́ніемъ, ꙗ́же вода́ми превоспрѧ́знаѧ си́лне, покрыва́ѧ, и́же наводѧ̀ зе́млю повѣ́сивый: ви́нши на дре́вѣ, и коле́блеши всю̀ тва́рь мані́емъ, всѣ́хъ же дш҃а ѹтвержда́еши, въ стра́сѣ твое́й. М:

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Рꙋка́мъ ѡсѣче́ніе и нога́мъ пода́сте мꙋ́нци, вострꙋже́ни лю́тѣ: и ѡгню̀ примѣша́ющесѧ, не ѿверго́стесѧ ѿню́дъ Ха̀, Бг҃а всѣ́хъ всѣ́хъ: но те́плѣ вопія́сте: Пое́мъ Гдⷭ҇ви, сла́вно бо просла́висѧ. Бгоро:
items.english_cohort_translation: Ye gave your hands and feet to be cut off, O martyrs, being cruelly scraped; and mingling with the fire, ye in no wise denied Christ, the God of all, but fervently cried aloud: Let us sing unto the Lord, for He is gloriously glorified! Theotokion:

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Предобразѡ Дв҃о Клꙋ́че: его́же родила̀ еси́ Сн҃а: ѹ́зрѣвавши на дре́во кр́тъ дви́женна во́лею, пла́чꙋщи восклица́ше: бл҃гоѹтро́бне: Гдⷭ҇ь, сы́й сла́вы, ка́кѡ сїа̀ стра́ждеши Влчⷪ҇ко;

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Очище́ніе мѝ пода́ждь прегрѣше́ній, бж҃твенными си мольба́ми, Дв҃о: си́лнꙋ бо и́маши мл҃твꙋ, Прчⷭ҇таѧ: и тебѣ̀ ѹч҃ницъ, и́збавлѧ́еши ѡ́тогрѣше́ній, и страсте́й, и скорбе́й, и ѡбстоѧ́ній.
items.english_cohort_translation: Grant me cleansing of transgressions by thy divine supplications, O Virgin; for thou hast mighty prayer, O Most-pure One; and being a disciple of thy prayers, deliver me from sins, from passions, from tribulations, and from distresses.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вода́ми мл҃твъ твои́хъ, Дв҃о, иста́ѧвшꙋ зно́емъ безмѣ́рныхъ мѝ согрѣше́ній, и страсте́й, ѡ́роси дш҃ꙋ мою̀ ѹмиле́нно: ꙗ́ко да прохладꙋ Бж҃твенною ѹлучи́вше: пѣ́сньми тѧ̀ велича́е: ꙗ́ко предста́телницꙋ те́плꙋю.
items.english_cohort_translation: With the waters of thy prayers, O Virgin, refresh my soul in compunction, melted by the drought of my measureless sins and passions, that having attained divine refreshment, we may magnify Thee in hymns as our fervent protector.
items.slavonic_text: Вода́ми мл҃твъ твои́хъ, Дв҃о, иста́ѧвшꙋ зно́емъ безмѣ́рныхъ мѝ согрѣше́ній, и страсте́й, ѡ́роси дш҃ꙋ мою̀ ѹмиле́нно: ꙗ́ко да прохладꙋ Бж҃твенною ѹлучи́вше: пѣ́сньми тѧ̀ велича́е: ꙗ́ко предста́телницꙋ те́плꙋю.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Всего́ погружа́емъ грѣхми́: нѣ́кого ѹча́ѧнна мѧ̀ сꙋ́ща: ты̀ Влчⷪ҇це чт҃аѧ, мл҃рдіа своего̀ рꙋ́кꙋ просте́рши, къ покаѧ́нію мѧ̀ бы́стро привлекцѝ: пода́ющи мѝ исто́чникъ слеза́мъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Being entirely submerged in sins, and having no one, wretch that I am: do thou, O Pure Lady, stretching forth the hand of thy tender-compassion, swiftly draw me unto repentance, granting me a fountain of tears.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Раздери́ Прчⷭ҇таѧ, грѣхо́вное рꙋкописа́ніе мои́хъ прегрѣше́ній, твои́ми моли́твами, ꙗ́кѡ и́мꙋщи къ Сн҃у своемꙋ̀ дерзнове́ніе, за́ни моли́ти прилѣ́жно, тѧ̀ бо еди́нꙋ и́мамы Хрⷭ҇тїа́не застꙋ́пницꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Tear asunder, O Most-pure One, the handwriting of my sins through Thy prayers, as Thou hast boldness toward Thine own Son to pray earnestly for us; for Thee alone do we Christians have as our protectress.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, г҃. Ірмо́съ. Оутвержде́ніе на́ тѧ надѣ́ющійсѧ, ѹтверди́, Гдⷭ҇и, Цр҃ковь свою̀, ю́же стѧжа̀, чтⷭ҇ного си кро́вію.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оди́нъ сложе́нъ носа̀ соста́въ, Сло́ве: претерпѣ́лъ еси́ распѧ́тіе безче́стнѣйшее: чту́щихъ тѧ̀ че́сти сꙋ́щее ѹгото́ванетлѣ́нное.
items.english_cohort_translation: Bearing a single compound hypostasis, O Word, Thou didst endure the most dishonorable crucifixion, preparing incorruptible honor for those who honor Thee.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тѧ̀ соблюде́н и по рождествѣ̀ Дв҃ою, ꙗ́же Бг҃а, чт҃аѧ ро́жши воплоще́нна, и́же на Кр́тѣ пригвожде́ншаго хотѣ́ніемъ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Изба́ви мѧ̀ ѡ всѧ́кіѧ содержа́щїѧ лю́тыѧ грѣхо́вныѧ бꙋ́рѧ, раба̀ своего̀ Прчⷭ҇таѧ: и къ спасе́нномꙋ мѧ̀ приста́нищꙋ напра́ви моли́твами си.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Спє́йма Мт҃и Дв҃о чт҃аѧ ѿстрасте́й мои́, мꙋ́тныхъ слія́ній, ѡсхожда́щихъ на́ мѧ смире́ннꙋю ми дш҃ꙋ, и ѡскорблѧ́ющихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Restrain, O Pure Virgin Mother, the turbid floods of my passions that assault my humble soul and grieve it.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Слеза́мъ то́къ пода́ждь мѝ бл҃гаѧ, и́сими ѹгаси́ стра́стей мои́хъ пе́щь, и всѧ́кіѧ мѧ̀ ѡмы́й дꙋше́вныѧ скве́рны, Бц҃е.
items.english_cohort_translation: Grant me a stream of tears, O Good One, and therewith quench the furnace of my passions, and wash me clean from all spiritual defilement, O Mother of God.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, д҃. Ірмо́съ. Покры́ла е́сть нб҃са̀, добродѣ́тѣ твоѧ̀ Хѐ, не Киво́та бо проше́дъ сщ҃енныѧ твоеѧ̀ нетлѣ́нныѧ Мт҃ре, въ Цр҃кви сла́вы твоеѧ̀ ꙗви́лъ сѧ еси́, ꙗ́кѡ мла́дъ на рꙋкꙋ но́симъ, и напо́лнишасѧ всѧ̀, твое́го хвале́ніа.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 4. Heirmos.* Thy virtue, O Christ, hath covered the heavens; for proceeding from the Ark of Thy sanctification, Thine incorrupt Mother, Thou didst appear in the temple of Thy glory as an infant borne in arms, and all things were filled with Thy praise.[^135]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́же паде́ніе Ада́мово еди́нъ воздви́глъ еси́ Хѐ, но́въ бы́й Ад̑а̀, на Кр́тѣ рꙋцѣ̀ пригвози́, прест҃ію же віе́мъ хотѧ̀, и ѻ́цта и же́лчи вкꙋша́лъ, превозноша́емаѧ высото́ю црⷭ҇твіа твое́го.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou Who alone didst raise up the fall of Adam, O Christ, being the new Adam, didst nail Thy hands unto the Cross, and being struck on the cheek of Thine own will, Thou didst taste vinegar and gall, being exalted by the height of Thy kingdom.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́кѡ ѻ́вца на заколе́ніе тѧ̀ Прр́къ пре́зритъ: и ꙗ́кѡ А́гнца Сло́ве Бж҃ій, не проти́вѧщасѧ ѿню́дъ, ни́же вопію́ща, е́го хотѣ́ніем претерпѣ́лъ еси́ распѧ́тисѧ, ꙗ́ко да и́же во́лею согрѣши́вши изба́виши, и спасе́ши, милосе́рде Гдⷭ҇и. Мунк:
items.english_cohort_translation: As a sheep led to the slaughter did the Prophet foresee Thee, and as a Lamb, O Word of God, not resisting at all, nor crying aloud, Thou didst endure to be crucified of Thine own will, that Thou mightest deliver and save those who have sinned voluntarily, O Merciful Lord.
