items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: О́бновльше дш҃а ра́ломъ вѣ́ры, Мꙋ́нцы Хв҃ы: сѣ́ма терпѣ́ніе мꙋ́къ взсѣ́ѧша: и кла́съ мꙋче́ніа гобзꙋ́ющій ѡбѧ́ша, вѣ́рныѧ соста́вленіа пита́ющій, тѣ́мже, при́снѡ сла́вими е́стѐ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having renewed their souls with the plow of faith, the martyrs of Christ sowed the seed of patient endurance of tortures, and reaped the abundant ear of martyrdom, nourishing the assemblies of the faithful; therefore ye are ever glorified.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѿ бѣ́зныѧ стꙋже́ніемъ невѣ́рный лю́тыхъ, ча́ѧніемъ кра́сныхъ: къ простра́нствꙋ вы́шняго црⷭ҇твіа, ст҃íи Мꙋ́нцы достиго́ша, ꙗ́кѡ да разширѧ́тъ на́ша ѹста̀, тѣ́хъ непреста́нно пѣ́ти борѐніе.
items.english_cohort_translation: From the abyssal oppression of cruel unbelievers, through the expectation of good things, the holy martyrs attained unto the expanse of the kingdom on high, that our mouths might be enlarged unceasingly to hymn their struggle.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу́гль Бж҃твенный пріе́мши, ꙗ́коже клѣща̀, неѡпала́ющъ ѿню́дъ: ѡроша́ющъ же па́че, Мт҃и Дв҃о, изъ тебѐ бы́вшꙋю и боже́ственнꙋю ѹ́тробꙋ твою̀, его́же ви́дѧщи пло́тію повѣ́шенна во́лею на дре́вѣ, пѣ́сньми сла́вѧще.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having received the divine coal, as with tongs, which was in no wise burning, but rather dewing, O Virgin Mother, within thy divine womb, seeing Him voluntarily suspended in the flesh upon the tree, we glorify Him in hymns.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Всю̀ на́тѧ надѣ́ждꙋ возложи́хъ, Бц҃е: молю́сѧ припада́ѧ ти дш҃а, смертоно́сныхъ изба́ви болѣ́зни: къ жи́зни сп҃се́ніа возводѧ́щи мѧ̀: ꙗ́же жи́знь ро́ждшаѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: All my hope have I placed upon thee, O Mother of God; falling down before thee, my soul prays: deliver me from deadly diseases, raising me up unto the life of salvation, O thou who gavest birth unto Life.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Влчⷪ҇це чт҃аѧ, крѣ́пкаѧ мі́рꙋ помо́щнице, не ѿве́рзи менѐ ѿ себѐ: ни́же посрамле́нна ѿслеши мѧ̀ ѿ лица̀ твое́го: ни́же вѣ́кѡ покажи́ мѧ ѡ́брадованіе.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Pure Lady, mighty helper of the world, cast me not away from thy presence, nor send me away ashamed from thy countenance, nor show me as a mockery unto the ages.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ве́сь ѡ́бнаже́нъ бы́хъ ѡка́ѧнный, ѿ бж҃твенныхъ дѣ́лъ: и ѹ́ѧзвихсѧ сла́стей ѡстры́ми стрѣла́ми, и ѡстрꙋ́пленъ бы́хъ, тѣ́мже вопію́ ти, Клчⷪ҇це: спаси́ мѧ Прчⷭ҇таѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Entirely naked have I become, wretch that I am, of divine deeds, and I have been wounded by the sharp arrows of pleasures, and covered with sores; therefore I cry unto thee, O Lady: save me, O Most-pure One.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, є҃. Ірмо́съ. Ꙗ́кѡ ви́дѣ Ис́аіа, ѡ́бразно на престо́лѣ превы́соцѣ, Кг҃а: ѿ А́гг҃лъ сла́вы дорѵноси́ма, ѡ ѡкаѧ́нный вопіѧ́ше а́зъ: прови́дѣхъ воплоща́ема Бг҃а, свѣ́томъ невече́рнимъ, и ми́ромъ ѡблада́юща.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 5. Heirmos.* When Isaiah saw God symbolically upon a throne high and lifted up, escorted by the Angels of glory, he cried: Woe is me, wretched one! For I have foreseen God becoming incarnate, possessing unwaning light and peace.[^136]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оупоко́йхъ мѧ̀ еси́ Сло́ве, претрꙋжде́ннаго трудо́мъ прегрѣше́ній, препочи́лъ на дре́вѣ Влчⷪ҇ко: и взѧ́тъ поноше́ніе моѐ, и́мѧже пострада́лъ еси́ Хѐ поноше́ньми, пѣ́ю твою̀ держа́вꙋ, и бж҃твеннаѧ страда́ніа.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst give me rest, O Word, who was overburdened by the labor of transgressions, having rested upon the tree, O Master; and Thou didst take away my reproach, whereby Thou didst suffer reproaches, O Christ; I hymn Thy dominion and divine sufferings.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Возже́гъ, ꙗ́коже свѣ́щникъ на Кр́тѣ пло́ть свою̀: и поиска́лъ еси́ поги́бшꙋю дра́хмꙋ чл҃колю́бче: и всѧ̀ призыва́еши дꙋ́хѡвскыѧ Си́лы, на сл҃ѡбре́теніе, побѣ́ждаѧсѧ лѣ́ностію, под нога́ми нечести́выхъ страстоте́рпецъ Хв҃ыхъ, ме́ртвъ зри́мъ е́стъ и недѣ́йственъ, са́ми же небе́стными сопричтле́ми сꙋ́тъ со А́гг҃лы, неизрече́нныѧ ра́дости исполнѧ́ющесѧ. М:
items.english_cohort_translation: Having kindled Thy flesh upon the Cross as a lamp, Thou didst seek the lost coin, O Lover of mankind; and Thou dost summon all the spiritual powers to the finding; being overcome by slothfulness, beneath the feet of the impious passion-bearers of Christ, the enemy is seen dead and inactive; while they themselves are numbered with the heavenly Angels, filled with ineffable joy. Martyrion:

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Инъ: Ірмо́съ то́йже. Виногра́де Бж҃твенный, ꙗ́же кра́сный гро́здъ прозѧ́бшіа, и дш҃а пода́ющ пи́тіе бж҃твенное Дв҃о, напое́ніа го́рькаго, и пїѧ́нства стра́стей, и сласте́й изба́ви дш҃ꙋ мою̀, и ѡгнѧ̀ вѣ́чнаго.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Гнѣжде́ніа исто́ргни мѧ̀ грѣхѡ́въ, Прчⷭ҇таѧ Бгоневѣ́сто, и́же па́дшаго въ ка́лъ страсте́й: и ѡчїсти́ мѧ мл҃тва твои́хъ, ѡмы́вши мѧ̀ ѿ страсте́й скве́рнъ, ри́зою спасе́ніа свѣтови́дною ѡдѣ́ѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Root out the nest of my sins, O Most-pure Bride of God, who have fallen into the mire of passions; and cleanse me by Thy prayers, washing me clean from the defilements of passions, clothing me in the radiant robe of salvation.
items.slavonic_text: Гнѣжде́ніа исто́ргни мѧ̀ грѣхѡ́въ, Прчⷭ҇таѧ Бгоневѣ́сто, и́же па́дшаго въ ка́лъ страсте́й: и ѡчїсти́ мѧ мл҃тва твои́хъ, ѡмы́вши мѧ̀ ѿ страсте́й скве́рнъ, ри́зою спасе́ніа свѣтови́дною ѡдѣ́ѧ.
items.english_text: Root out the nest of my sins, O Most-pure Bride of God, who have fallen into the mire of passions; and cleanse me by Thy prayers, washing me clean from the defilements of passions, clothing me in the radiant robe of salvation.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́же мі́рови смире́ніе и спасе́ніе всѣ́мъ пода́вшаѧ, ꙗ́кѡ боже́ственный ми́ръ поро́жши Дв҃о: настоѧ́щій бра́нь ѡ страсте́й дꙋша̀ моеѧ̀ и тѣ́ла, Чт҃аѧ ѹмири́.
items.english_cohort_translation: O thou who gavest peace and salvation unto all the world, having given birth unto the divine Peace, O Virgin: appease the present warfare of passions of my soul and body, O Pure One.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Стра́хо и любо́вію, Сп҃са Ха̀, толкꙋ́щꙋю дш҃ꙋ мою̀ грѣхми́, Прчⷭ҇таѧ, исцѣли́ твои́мъ милосе́рдіемъ: и сподо́би наста́влѧющи мѧ̀, твори́ти въ смире́ніи, Сн҃а твое́го повелѣ́ніа при́снѡ: ꙗ́кѡ да воспріи́мꙋ его̀ бл҃года́ть.
items.english_cohort_translation: In fear and love of the Savior Christ, heal my soul that is struck with sins, O Most-pure One, by Thy tender-compassion; and grant me, guiding me, ever to perform in humility the commandments of Thy Son, that I may receive His grace.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. Ірмо́съ. Возопи́хъ к тебѣ̀, ви́дѣвъ ста́рець ѻ́чима спасе́ніе: е́же лю́демъ пріи́де ѡ Бг҃а, Хѐ, ты̀ Бг҃ъ мо́й.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 6. Heirmos.* The elder, having seen salvation with his eyes, which came unto the people from God, cried aloud unto Thee: O Christ, Thou art my God!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Во́лею закла́лсѧ еси́ ꙗ́коже А́гнецъ: и́же снѣ́дію дре́ва ѹме́ршаго коа́его: па́ки къ жи́зни, Хр́те, возведя̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Voluntarily wast Thou slaughtered as a Lamb, O Christ, raising up again unto life him who had died through the eating of the tree.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: На Кр́тъ вознесе́нъ бы́въ, и ни́падесѧ бѣ́совскаѧ пре́лесть: вознесе́жесѧ вѣ́рныхъ мно́жество, воспѣва́юще тѧ̀ жизнода́вче.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having been lifted up upon the Cross, the demonic deception fell down; and the multitude of the faithful was exalted, singing of Thee, O Giver of life.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Разумѣ́ти немо́жетъ ѹ́мъ чловѣ́ческій, Отрокови́це, ꙗ́же па́че естества̀, ржтва̀ твоего̀ та́инство, па́че бо ѹма̀, Бг҃а родила̀ еси́.
items.english_cohort_translation: The human mind cannot comprehend, O Maiden, the mystery of thy birth-giving which is beyond nature; for beyond understanding hast thou given birth unto God.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Избавле́ніе прегрѣше́ній, пода́ждь ꙗ́кѡ бл҃га́ѧ, твоемꙋ̀ рабꙋ̀, Пречт҃аѧ, и́же твое́го застꙋпле́ніа просѧ́щемꙋ вѣ́рою: и бꙋ́дꙋщаго мѧ̀ сꙋда̀, исхити́.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бл҃гуе, и Мт҃и изба́вителѧ, ты̀ предста́ни ми въ ча́съ исхо́да моего̀: истазле́мꙋ мнѣ̀ ѿ воздꙋ́шныхъ дꙋхѡ́въ, ѡни́хже несмы́сленною мы́слію содѣ́ѧхъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Good One and Mother of the Deliverer, stand Thou by me at the hour of my departure, when I am examined by the spirits of the air concerning what I have committed with an unreasoning mind.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ока́ѧненъ бы́хъ въ себѣ̀ а́зъ, нечистота́ми всегда̀ ѡбла́гъ: и прозрѧ̀ нн҃ѣ созда́н ногѝ моѧ̀ сме́рть, возыва́ю ти Кц҃е, помози́ ми.
items.english_cohort_translation: Wretched have I become within myself, ever encompassed with uncleannesses; and now beholding death standing before my feet, I cry aloud unto thee, O Mother of God: help me!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Во́лны стра́стныхъ помышле́ній, всегда̀ смꙋща́ютъ, Прчⷭ҇таѧ: и лꙋка́выхъ дꙋхѡ́въ е́два погружа́ютъ мѧ̀: но ѹтверди́ мѧ, на ка́мени безстра́стіа.
items.english_cohort_translation: The waves of passionate thoughts ever agitate me, O Most-pure One, and the crafty spirits barely keep from drowning me; but establish me upon the rock of passionlessness.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, з҃. Ірмо́съ. Тебѐ и́же въ ѻ́гни, ѡроси́вшаго дѣ́ти евге́ньскаѧ: и въ Дв҃у нетлѣ́ннꙋ все́льшасѧ: Кг҃а Сло́во пое́мъ, бл҃гоче́стно хвалѧ́ще: блгвенъ еси́ Гди, Бж҃е ѡ́цъ наши́.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кро́вію чт҃ною Гдⷭ҇и, тва́рь ѡчи́стилъ еси́, ѿ кро́ве приноси́мыѧ ме́рзкимъ бѣ́сѡмъ: и раздрꙋши́лъ еси́ же́ртвы скве́рныѧ, Сло́ве Бж҃ій, поже́рся ꙗ́кѡ незло́бивъ А́гнецъ. Сла́ва держа́вѣ твое́й. М[унк]:

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Зача́тіе чт҃аѧ неизрече́нно, и Рождество̀ неизказа́нно еди́на имѣ́ла еси́, Бг҃а вопло́щши, пло́тію распе́ншагосѧ, емꙋ́же пою́ще, вопіе́мъ: Блгвенъ еси́ Гдⷭ҇и, Бж҃е ѡ́цъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou alone didst have an ineffable conception, O Pure One, and an unutterable birth-giving, having given birth unto the incarnate God Who was crucified in the flesh; singing unto Whom, we cry: Blessed art Thou, O Lord, God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тебѣ̀ Мт҃ри Бж҃ей, чт҃ей, и непоро́чнѣй мл҃вся, ѡскве́рненъ тѣ́ломъ и дш҃ею, и ѡка́ѧнный дѣѧ́ніи нечи́стыми: и надѣ́юсѧ, Влчⷪ҇це, на мл҃ть твою̀: ты́ мѧ ѹще́дри, Прчⷭ҇таѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Another [Canon]. Heirmos: As of old:* Praying unto thee, the pure and immaculate Mother of God, defiled in body and soul, and wretched with unclean deeds: I place my hope in thy mercy, O Lady; do thou have tender-compassion on me, O Most-pure One.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прегрѣше́ніи мои́хъ мно́жество, и злы́хъ исполне́ніе, недоꙋмѣ́ніемъ мѧ̀ преиспо́лнетъ ѕѣ́лѡ, и въ ѹча́ѧніа влече́тъ глубинꙋ̀. Прчⷭ҇таѧ Влчⷪ҇це, спаси́ мѧ погиба́ющаго, и лю́тѣ потопла́ема.
items.english_cohort_translation: The multitude of my transgressions and the fullness of evils fill me with great perplexity, and drag me down into the depth of despair. O Most-pure Lady, save me who am perishing and cruelly submerged.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мно́жество щедро́т твоѧ̑ бл҃гти, грѣхѡ́въ на́шихъ мно́жество пре́зри бл҃га́ѧ: и бл҃гопремѣ́нительна бꙋ́ди, немо́лчно зовꙋ́щымъ: Бл҃гвенъ Прчⷭ҇таѧ пло́дъ твое́го чре́ва.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Good One, overlook the multitude of our sins through the multitude of the compassions of Thy goodness; and be Thou easily reconciled unto those who unceasingly cry: Blessed, O Most-pure One, is the fruit of Thy womb!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Лю́діе непокори́віи и неразꙋ́мніи, тѧ̀ на ло́бномъ бл҃гопоко́рнымъ возхотѣ́вша распѧ́тисѧ, ѡсужда́ютъ ѹмре́ти, ꙗ́кѡ да хотѣ́ніемъ ѹмерщвле́нныхъ, Сло́ве ѡживи́ши, пою́щихъ тѧ̀, и превозносѧ́щихъ вовѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: The disobedient and unreasoning people condemned Thee to die, Who wast pleased to be crucified on the place of the skull of Thine own compliant will, that by Thy will Thou mightest quicken those who were mortified, O Word, who sing of Thee and exalt Thee unto the ages.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Распросте́ръ на Кр́тѣ дла́ни: рꙋцѣ̀, не ѹдержа́нно просте́ртымъ къ дре́ву снѣ́дномꙋ Пе́рвозда́ннаго, исцѣли́лъ Влчⷪ҇ко. И зрѧ́щи тѧ̀ стра́хомъ сл҃нце, лꙋ́ча сокрыва́ше, и всѧ̀ тва́рь поколе́басѧ. М[унк]:
items.english_cohort_translation: Stretching out Thy palms upon the Cross, Thou didst heal, O Master, the hands of the first-formed man unrestrainedly stretched forth unto the tree of eating. And seeing Thee with fear, the sun hid its rays, and all creation was shaken. Martyrion:

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оучамн сщ҃енныи коре́ніи, страстотерпціи, исцѣле́ніа безбо́жіа, изсꙋши́ша страстоте́рпцы, и исто́чники источи́ша исцѣле́ній, скве́рны страсте́й ѡмыва́юще, и вѣ́рныхъ ср́дца напая́юще бога́тно. М[унк]:
items.english_cohort_translation: Having dried up the roots of impiety with sacred healing, the passion-bearers poured forth fountains of healings, washing away the defilements of passions, and richly watering the hearts of the faithful. Martyrion:

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Соверши́ли чт҃ныхъ страсте́й, и бж҃твенныхъ за́повѣдей исполни́теліе, страстоте́рпцы, согра́ждане Безпло́тнымъ: напса́тисѧ нн҃ѣ въ вы́шнемъ гра́дѣ, Бг҃а моли́те, и́же васъ чтꙋ́щымъ вове́ки вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: O passion-bearers, fellow citizens with the Bodiless Hosts, having accomplished the precious sufferings and fulfilled the divine commandments: pray ye unto God that those who honor you may be written in the city on high unto ages of ages.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Рꙋ́чкꙋ тѧ̀ зла́тꙋю и свѧще́нникъ Трапе́зꙋ и Же́злъ, Бж҃твеннꙋю го́рꙋ го́рꙋ и ѡ́блакъ, пала́тꙋ Цр҃евꙋ, и престо́лъ ѻ́гнеѡ́бразенъ: Кц҃е, вси вѣ́рныи име́нꙋемъ, ꙗ́же по рождествѣ̀, Дв҃ою сохран́шасѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The golden urn, the table of the priest, the rod, the divine mountain, the cloud, the royal palace, and the fiery throne do all we the faithful call thee, O Mother of God, who remained a Virgin after childbirth.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Инъ: Ірмо́съ. Въ пла́мень къ дѣ́тем Евре́йски соше́дшаго, бж҃твенною си́лою, ꙗ́вльшагосѧ его̀, чл҃вѣцы всѧ̀ покланѧ́йтесѧ Гдⷭ҇а: сщ҃енницы по́йте, и превозноси́те его̀ вовѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Another [Canon]. Heirmos.* Unto Him Who descended into the flame unto the Hebrew children by divine power, and appeared unto them: all ye men, worship the Lord; ye priests, sing and exalt Him unto the ages.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сласте́й горе́сть, чꙋ́вства всѧ̀ телє́снаѧ проше́дши: дш҃ꙋ мою̀ безмѣ́стно ѡкаллѧ́етъ, и во сме́рть влече́тъ. Клчⷪ҇це мі́рꙋ, бꙋ́ди ми спасе́ніе.
items.english_cohort_translation: The bitterness of pleasures, having passed through all my bodily senses, immeasurably defiles my soul and drags it into death; O Lady of the world, be thou my salvation.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Нѧ́тъ и дш҃ꙋ и тѣ́ло и ср́це возложи́хъ, неи́мамъ бо ино́ѧ наде́жды, ра́звѣ тебѐ Клчⷪ҇це, е́йже полꙋчꙋ мл҃ть, тѣ́мже пода́ждь мѝ бога́тꙋю твою̀ бл҃года́ть.
items.english_cohort_translation: I have committed both soul and body and heart unto thee, for I have no other hope save thee, O Lady, through whom I shall obtain mercy; therefore grant me thy rich grace.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Змíи мнѣ̀ ꙗ́домъ припо́лзе, и пло́тскою сла́стію, ѡка́ѧнную дш҃ꙋ мою̀, лю́тѣ ѹмори́: но ѡживи́ си́ю сопроти́вными лѣчба́ми, чтⷭ҇таѧ твои́ми моли́твами.
items.english_cohort_translation: The serpent crawled near me with venom, and through carnal pleasure cruelly killed my wretched soul; but revive it with contrary remedies, O Pure One, through thy prayers.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Лю́таѧ мѧ̀ но́щь покрыва́етъ прегрѣше́ній, чт҃аѧ Клчⷪ҇це, неи́мамъ бо свѣща̀, дш҃ꙋ просвѣща́юща бл҃года́ніа бл҃го́мъ: тѣ́мже невече́рнїа ѹзрнꙋ́хъсѧ вы́шнаго.
items.english_cohort_translation: The cruel night of transgressions covers me, O Pure Lady, for I have no lamp of good deeds enlightening my soul; therefore I have been deprived of the unwaning light on high.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: На Кр́тѣ пригвожде́ся, Ісѐ, и́же ѡснова́вый ниначе́мъ же всю̀ зе́млю, ѹгла́вльшаго мѧ̀ ѿтлѣ́ніи грѣхо́внемъ, мра́комъ лꙋка́вымъ: ꙗ́кѡ бл҃гъ ѹще́дри Хѐ и изба́ви: и бе́зчестною си сме́ртію, почти́лъ есѝ, многоми́лостиве.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou wast nailed upon the Cross, O Jesus, Who didst establish the whole earth upon nothing, and didst deliver me from the corruption of sin, who was held fast by evil darkness; as Thou art good, show tender mercy and deliver me, O Christ; and by Thy dishonorable death Thou hast honored me, O Plenteous in mercy.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Я́висѧ Бг҃ъ неви́димый естество́, пло́тію распина́емъ: ꙗ́кѡ да ѡвра́га неви́димаго, изба́виши мі́ръ ви́димый: и со́шлъ ни́зꙋ, нб҃ныѧ сотвори́ши Хѐ, сла́во, спокланѧ́ющъ держа́вꙋ, вели́кіѧ вла́сти твоеѧ̀. М[унк]:
items.english_cohort_translation: God, invisible by nature, appeared crucified in the flesh, that Thou mightest deliver the visible world from the invisible enemy; and having descended below, O Christ, Thou madest the heavenly ones fellow worshippers of the dominion of Thy great power. Martyrion:

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Во́инство сщ҃енное ст҃ы́хъ, ст҃ое ѡполче́ніе избра́нное: Гдⷭ҇и, посредѣ̀ имѣ́й живо́тное дре́во, Ха̀: Бгокра́снаѧ Цр҃кви, сосло́віе чт҃ное, всесла́вныи страстоте́рпцы сп҃совы, ꙗ́внѣтесѧ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Свѣти́лнїе, твоѐ зрѧ́щи Сн҃у мо́й распѧ́тіе, зандо́ста: и ка́кѡ Евре́йскій со́нмъ не за́нде невѣ́рный, преда́въ тѧ̀ на сме́рть; нача́лника жи́зни, Кц҃а вопіѧ́ше: ю́же непреста́нно велича́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Seeing Thy crucifixion, O my Son, the two luminaries went down; and how did the faithless Hebrew assembly not sink into darkness, having betrayed Thee unto death, the Prince of life? cried the Mother of God, whom we unceasingly magnify.[^138]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Скве́рнꙋ стра́стныхъ помышле́ній, моего̀ ѹ́ма ѡчи́стивши, Чт҃аѧ: во безстра́стіа свѣ́тлꙋю ри́зꙋ, ѡдєжи́ мѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having cleansed the defilement of passionate thoughts from my mind, O Pure One, clothe me in the radiant garment of passionlessness.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: О́тверзи мѝ бж҃твенныи вхо́ды покаѧ́ніа, Дв҃о: восхо́ды стра́стей и сласте́й мои́хъ загражда́ющи: и возстановлѧ́ющи си́лою свое́ю.
items.english_cohort_translation: Open unto me the divine entrances of repentance, O Virgin, blocking the incursions of my passions and pleasures, and restoring me by thy power.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оуслы́ши гла́съ стена́ніа моего̀, и гла́съ пла́ча моего̀, Дв҃о всенепоро́чнаѧ: и пода́ждь ѡчище́ніе, ще́ніе, и спасе́ніе ѡкаѧ́нней ми дш҃и.
items.english_cohort_translation: Hear the voice of my groaning, and the voice of my weeping, O All-immaculate Virgin, and grant cleansing and salvation unto my wretched soul.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ ве́сь ѹ́ча́ѧхсѧ ѡка́ѧнный, и недоꙋмѣ́хсѧ: помышлѧ́ѧ лука́ваѧ моѧ̀ дѣѧ́ніа, тѣ́не ѹще́дри Влчⷪ҇це, и сп҃си мѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Entirely in despair am I, wretched one, and in perplexity, contemplating my evil deeds; therefore show tender mercy, O Lady, and save me.
items.slavonic_text: Въ ве́сь ѹ́ча́ѧхсѧ ѡка́ѧнный, и недоꙋмѣ́хсѧ: помышлѧ́ѧ лука́ваѧ моѧ̀ дѣѧ́ніа, тѣ́не ѹще́дри Влчⷪ҇це, и сп҃си мѧ̀.
items.english_text: Entirely in despair am I, wretched one, and in perplexity, contemplating my evil deeds; therefore show tender mercy, O Lady, and save me.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дре́во преслꙋша́ніа, мі́рови сме́рть прозѧбѐ: дре́во же Кр́тное, живо́тъ и нетлѣ́ніе, тѣ́мже тебѐ мо́лимъ: распе́ншагосѧ Гдⷭ҇а, да знамена́етсѧ нана́съ свѣ́тъ лица̀ твое́го.
items.english_cohort_translation: The tree of disobedience budded forth death for the world; but the tree of the Cross sprouted life and incorruption; therefore we pray unto Thee, the crucified Lord: let the light of Thy countenance be signed upon us.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Забве́нію пи́ща Ада́мъ бы́хъ, паде́ніемъ падо́хъ сѧ лю́тым: но непрезрѣ́лъ Влчⷪ҇ко, воспріе́мъ мене́ ради е́же поми́лꙋй, распѧ́тіе еси́, и спасе́ши мѧ̀, и въ сла́вꙋ взво́диши: изба́вителю мо́й, сла́ва тебѣ̀. М[унк]:
items.english_cohort_translation: As food for oblivion was I, Adam, having fallen by a cruel fall; but Thou didst not despise me, O Master; taking pity on me, Thou wast crucified for my sake, and Thou savest me and bringest me unto glory: O my Deliverer, glory be to Thee! Martyrion:

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ст҃ы́хъ страстоте́рпецъ па́мѧть, пріидѣ́те лю́діе вси́ почти́мъ: ꙗ́кѡ позо́ръ бы́ша А́гглѡмъ и чл҃кѡмъ, побѣ́ды вѣ́ньца ѿ Ха̀ пріа́ша, и мо́лѧтъ сѧ ѡ дꋋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Come, all ye people, let us honor the memory of the holy passion-bearers; for they became a spectacle unto Angels and men, received crowns of victory from Christ, and pray for our souls.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Зрѧ́щи и́же и́зтебѐ рожде́ннаго, всенепоро́чнаѧ, повѣ́шенна на дре́вѣ: восклица́ше вопію́щи: сла́дкое моѐ ча́до, гдѣ̀ твоѧ̀ за́йде добро́та свѣтоно́снаѧ, до́брое сотвори́вшаго ро́дꙋ чловѣ́ческомꙋ;
items.english_cohort_translation: Seeing Him Who was born of thee, O All-immaculate One, suspended upon the tree, thou didst cry aloud, weeping: O my sweet Child, whither hath thy light-bearing beauty departed, Who didst work good for the human race?

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Отвергшаго Хѐ за́повѣдь твою̀, пра́ѡтца Ада́ма, и́з Раѧ̀ изгна́лъ еси́, разбо́инника же, ще́дре, исповѣ́давша тѧ на Кр́тѣ: во́нь ввели́лъ еси́, зовꋋ́ща: По- мѧни́ мѧ Сп҃се, въ црⷭ҇твіи си.
items.english_cohort_translation: The forefather Adam, who rejected Thy commandment, O Christ, didst Thou cast out of Paradise; but the thief, O Tender-hearted One, who confessed Thee upon the Cross, didst Thou lead therein, crying: Remember me, O Savior, in Thy Kingdom.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Зрѧ́щи тѧ̀ на Кр́тѣ Слн҃ца незаходи́маго, помрачи́ свѣ́та слн҃це: ка́меніѧ распадо́шасѧ, и землѧ̀ поколеба́ласѧ всѧ̀: завѣ́са же Цр҃ко́внаѧ раздра́сѧ посредѣ̀, непра́веднѣ страда́юща видѧ́щи тѧ̀ Сп҃се: всѣ́ми не домы́слимаго.
items.english_cohort_translation: Beholding Thee upon the Cross, the unwaning Sun, the sun of light was darkened; the rocks were rent, and all the earth was shaken; the veil of the Temple was torn in twain in the midst, seeing Thee suffering unjustly, O Savior, Incomprehensible to all.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Забѣхꙋ̀а Ісѐ веде́нъ бы́сть на сме́рть, живы́мъ живо́те: ꙗ́ко да Бж҃твенными свои́ми стра́стьми, и́же дре́внею снѣ́дію ѹмерщвле́ныѧ, спасе́ши ꙗ́кѡ Бг҃ъ: и Гдⷭ҇а пока́жеши жи́телѧ, тѣ́мже, вѣ́рою твоѧ̑ стра̑сти сла́ви.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou wast led unto death as a sheep, O Jesus, the Life of the living, that by Thy divine sufferings Thou mightest save as God those who had been mortified by the ancient eating; and Thou showest them as citizens of the Lord; therefore with faith we glorify Thy passions.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пострада́вшаго во́лею на́съ ра́ди, и поноше́ніа взе́мшаго чл҃кѡ, стра́стемъ ѹподо́бльшемсѧ мꙋ́нцы, многи́ ради мꙋ́къ низложи́сте вра́га: и вы́шнюю сла́вꙋ получи́сте, тѣ́мже, бг҃олѣ́пно сла́вими естѐ. Сла́ва:
items.english_cohort_translation: Having voluntarily suffered for our sake, and taken upon Himself the reproach of men: O martyrs who imitated His passions, through many tortures ye cast down the enemy, and obtained the glory on high; therefore ye are divinely glorified. Glory...

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Стра́сти терпѧ́ща пло́тію хотѣ́ніе, зрѧ́щи на Кр́тѣ своего̀ Сн҃а всенепоро́чнаѧ: смути́сѧ вся̀, и пла́чꙋщи возыва́ше Чт҃аѧ: ѹвы́ мнѣ̀ ча́до моѐ, ка́кѡ ѹмерщвле́нъ еси́, и́же ѡуме́ршыѧ лю́тѣ, ѡживи́ти хотѧ̀;
items.english_cohort_translation: Seeing Her Son voluntarily enduring passions in the flesh upon the Cross, the All-immaculate One was troubled in all Her being, and weeping, the Pure One cried aloud: Woe is me, my Child! How art Thou put to death, Who wishest to quicken those who died cruelly?

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Стра́ждꙋще до́бліи Мꙋ́ченници, крѣ́пко: и ра́ны и ваза́ніа, и разли́чныѧ мꙋ́ки претерпѣ́вше: къ неболѣ́знномꙋ вои́стиннꙋ, и бл҃же́номꙋ наслѣ́дію приведѡ́шасѧ, подостоѧ́ніи болѣ́зней.
items.english_cohort_translation: Suffering bravely, O noble martyrs, and having endured wounds and bonds and diverse tortures, ye have been led unto the painless and blessed inheritance, according to the measure of your sufferings.[^139]

items.section: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.day_or_date: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́же сло́во бл҃гочести́во и бж҃венно ѹмꙋдри́вше, Гдⷭ҇ни Ст҃ліе: и всѧ̀ ерети́ческаѧ съпротивосло́віа разрꙋши́сте: и вѣ́рны всѣ́мъ, первост҃ліе ꙗви́стесѧ, сего́ ра́ди почита́емъ естѐ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having wisely uttered the word of piety and divinity, O Hierarchs of the Lord, ye destroyed all the contradictions of heretics; and ye appeared as chief hierarchs unto all the faithful; therefore ye are honored.

items.day_or_date: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Веще́ственныхъ и безпло́тныхъ ѹподо́бистесѧ, тщи́ Бг҃оносныи, телесе́н веще́ственнѣ, тꙋ́гъ пресла́вно житіѐ показа́вюще: тѣ́мже въ ѡби́телехъ живе́те.
items.english_cohort_translation: Ye imitated the immaterial and bodiless ones, O God-bearing ascetics, having shown forth a glorious life in the material body; therefore ye dwell in celestial mansions.

items.section: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.day_or_date: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ве́ліа Кр́та твое́го Гдⷭ҇и си́ла: водрузи́босѧ намъ Кр́тъ, и дѣ́йствꙋетъ въ мі́рѣ: и показа̀ ѡ рыбаре́й А́плы, и ѡ ꙗ́зыкъ Мꙋ́ченики: да мо́лѧтсѧ ѡ дꋋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Great is the power of Thy Cross, O Lord: for the Cross was planted for us, and works in the world, and made Apostles out of fishermen, and martyrs out of the nations, that they may pray for our souls.

items.section: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.day_or_date: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ве́ліа мꙋ́никъ твои́хъ, Хѐ, си́ла, въ гро́бѣхъ бо лежа́ще, дꙋ́хи прого́нѧтъ: и ѹпраздни́ша вра́жію вла́сть, вѣ́рою Тро́ическою: подви́гшесѧ по бл҃гоче́стіи.
items.english_cohort_translation: Great is the power of Thy martyrs, O Christ: for lying in the tombs, they drive away evil spirits, and have abolished the power of the enemy, through faith in the Trinity, having contended for piety.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прр́ци, А́плн Хв҃ы и мꙋ́нци: наѹчи́ша пѣ́ти Тр҃цꙋ единосꙋ́щнꙋю: и просвѣти́ша ꙗ́зыки прельще́нныѧ: и прича́стники А́гглѡмъ сотвори́ша, сы́ны чл҃вѣческíа.

items.day_or_date: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́нци Гдⷭ҇ни, вѣ́рою ѹтверждьшесѧ, и наде́ждею ѹкрѣ́пльшеесѧ: любо́вію Кр́та твое́го душе́вно соедини́вшасѧ, вра́жіе мꙋчи́телство разрꙋши́ша: и ѹлꙋчи́ша вѣ́нцѧ, съ Безпло́тными мо́лѧтъсѧ, ѡ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The martyrs of the Lord, established in faith and strengthened in hope, united in soul through the love of Thy Cross, destroyed the tyranny of the enemy; and having obtained crowns, they pray with the Bodiless Hosts for our souls.
items.slavonic_text: Мꙋ́нци Гдⷭ҇ни, вѣ́рою ѹтверждьшесѧ, и наде́ждею ѹкрѣ́пльшеесѧ: любо́вію Кр́та твое́го душе́вно соедини́вшасѧ, вра́жіе мꙋчи́телство разрꙋши́ша: и ѹлꙋчи́ша вѣ́нцѧ, съ Безпло́тными мо́лѧтъсѧ, ѡ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_text: The martyrs of the Lord, established in faith and strengthened in hope, united in soul through the love of Thy Cross, destroyed the tyranny of the enemy; and having obtained crowns, they pray with the Bodiless Hosts for our souls.

items.section: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.day_or_date: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Все́ е́стіе чл҃вѣческое, ели́ко не преи́йдетъ посмерти: непребꙋ́детъ бога́тство, ни сни́детъ сла́ва: нашедши бо сме́рть, всѧ̀ сїа̀ погꙋби́тъ, тѣ́мже, Хр́тꙋ, безсме́ртномꙋ, возопіе́мъ: преста́вленнымъ ѡна́съ поко́й, и́деже всѣ́хъ е́стъ весела́щым сѧ жили́ще, ѹ́тѣхе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *For the Departed.* All human existence, howsoever much it may be, passes away after death: riches remain not, nor doth glory descend; for when death comes, it destroys all these things; therefore unto Christ the Immortal let us cry: Unto those translated from among us, grant rest, where the dwelling of all who rejoice is found, O Consolation![^140]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́кцы, что всу́е мѧте́мсѧ; пꙋ́ть кра́токъ е́стъ и́мѧже тече́мъ, ды́мъ е́стъ житїе: па́ра, пе́релъ, и пе́пелъ, въма́лѣ ꙗ́влѧе сѧ, и вско́рѣ погиба́етъ, тѣ́мже, тѣ́мже, Хр́тꙋ безсме́ртномꙋ возопіе́мъ: преста́вленнымъ ѡна́, поко́й: и́деже всѣ́мъ е́стъ весела́щїисѧ жили́ще ѹ́тѣхе.
items.english_cohort_translation: O mortals, why do we trouble ourselves in vain? The path on which we run is brief; life is smoke, vapor, earth, and ash; for a little while it appears, and quickly perishes; therefore therefore unto Christ the Immortal let us cry: Unto those translated from among us, grant rest, where the dwelling of all who rejoice is found, O Consolation!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ жена́хъ ст҃а́ѧ Кц҃е, Мт҃и безневѣ́стнаѧ: моли́ его́же родила̀ еси́, Цр҃ѧ и Бг҃а на́шего: да спасе́ ны, ꙗ́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Holy Mother of God among women, unwedded Mother: pray Thou unto Him Whom Thou didst bear, our King and God, that He may save us, as the Lover of mankind.

items.section: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бл҃году́шне, терпѣ́ніа ва́шего: побѣди́ ко́зни злонача́лнаго врага̀, страстоте́рпцы прехва́лнии, сего́ради вѣ́чномꙋ сподо́бистеся бл҃же́нствꙋ: но моли́тесѧ Гдⷭ҇н, Хр́тоимени́тых люде́й сп҃сти ста́до, Мꙋ́ченицы сꙋ́ще и́стинныи.
items.english_cohort_translation: The noble endurance of your patience overcame the snares of the evil-originating enemy, O all-praised passion-bearers; therefore ye have been accounted worthy of eternal blessedness; but pray ye unto the Lord to save the flock of the people named after Christ, being true martyrs.[^141]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ст҃ете вѣ́рою, пресвѣ́тлаѧ свѣти́ла ст҃íи, бл҃гоче́стіа вра́чеве, стратоте́рпцы прехва́льнии, мꙋчи́телей бо ра́нъ не ѹбоя́стеся, І́дольское злоче́стіе низложи́сте: побѣ́дꙋ имѣ́юще непобѣди́мꙋю, Кр́тъ и́стинный.
items.english_cohort_translation: Ye shine with faith, O holy ones, most radiant luminaries, physicians of piety, all-praised passion-bearers; for ye feared not the wounds of the torturers, and cast down the impiety of idols, having the true Cross as an invincible victory.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Всѐ ходата́йцꙋ сп҃се́нію ро́да на́шего, воспѣва́емъ Кц҃е Дв҃о: пло́тію бо е́нже и́зтебѐ про́шѧ Сн҃ъ тво́й, и Бг҃ъ на́: Кр́тно́е пріе́мъ стра́сть: изба́вилъ е́стъ на́съ и́з нетлѣ́ніа, ꙗ́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: As the advocate of the salvation of our race, we hymn thee, O Virgin Mother of God; for thy Son and our God, having taken flesh from thee, and received the suffering of the Cross, hath delivered us from corruption, as the Lover of mankind.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Взѡрꙋжи́вшеся крѣ́пцѣ ѡрꙋ́жіемъ Хв҃ымъ, и ѡболо́кшеся во ѡрꙋ́жіа вѣ́ры: полкѝ вра́жїа, страдал- чики низложи́сте, ѹсе́рдно бо, ѹпова́ніемъ жи́зни, претерпѣ́сте всѧ̀ мꙋчи́телей, преще́ніа же и ра́ны, тѣ́мже, и вѣ́нца прія́сте, мꙋ́ннци Хв҃ы, терпеливодꙋ́шніи.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having armed yourselves strongly with the weapon of Christ, and clad yourselves in the armor of faith, ye cast down the hosts of the enemy, O sufferers; for fervently, through the hope of life, ye endured all the threats and wounds of the torturers; therefore ye also received crowns, O long-suffering martyrs of Christ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: ON FRIDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Егда̀ сло́во твои́мъ предста́немъ, безме́здному ти сꙋди́щꙋ Гдⷭ҇и: непосрами́ и́же втѧ̀ вѣ́ровавшыи, Сп҃се на́шъ, вси́ бо, согрѣши́хомъ: но тебе́ не ѿстꙋпи́хом, тѣ́мже мо́лимъ тѧ, въ нѣ́дрѣхъ пра́ведныхъ твои́хъ, Хр́те, и́хже прія́тъ, поко́й, еди́не бо еси́ безгрѣ́шенъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *For the Departed.* When we shall stand before Thy word, at Thy free judgment seat, O Lord: put not to shame those who have believed in Thee, O our Savior; for we all have sinned, yet we have not departed from Thee; therefore we pray Thee: in the bosoms of Thy righteous ones, O Christ, whom Thou hast received, give rest, for Thou alone art sinless.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прр́ци проповѣ́даша, А́пли наѹчи́ша, Мꙋ́нци исповѣ́даша: и мы́ вѣ́ровахомъ, Кц҃у тѧ̀ вои́стинꙋ сꙋ́щꙋю, тѣ́мже, и велича́емъ рождество̀ твоѐ Прчⷭ҇таѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The Prophets proclaimed, the Apostles taught, the Martyrs confessed, and we have believed, that Thou art truly the Mother of God; therefore we magnify Thy birth-giving, O Most-pure One.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, а҃. Гл, г҃. Ірмо́съ. Я́веи въ сла́вѣ, творѧ́й чудеса̀ ты́ еси́ Бж҃е: и́же бе́зднꙋ изсуши́вый, и ѡрꙋ́жіе потопи́въ, и лю́ди спасе́ пою́щаѧ тѧ̀, ꙗ́ко изба́вителѧ Бг҃а на́шего.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 1. Tone 3. Heirmos.* Thou art God Who art manifest in glory, working wonders: Who didst dry up the abyss, and didst drown the weapons, and didst save the people who sing unto Thee as the Deliverer, our God.[^142]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́ченичества сла́вꙋ премꙋ́дріи, ѡбрѣто́сте всѝ страда́льцы: мꙋче́ніа многоѡбра́знаѧ, до́блественнѣ претерпѣ́сте страстоте́рпцы, тѣ́мже сла́вими е́стѐ при́снѡ.
items.english_cohort_translation: All ye sufferers, O all-wise ones, have found the glory of martyrdom; bravely did ye endure manifold tortures, O passion-bearers; therefore ye are ever glorified.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Превы́шшіи имѣ́юще живо́тъ, ꙗви́стеся Бж҃твенніи слꙋжи́теліе, премꙋ́дрыи Сщ҃еннота́йнници, вопло́щшагосѧ Сло́ва, ѹпа́сше до́брѣ Гдⷭ҇не ста́до, си́лою Бж҃твенною.
items.english_cohort_translation: Possessing the life on high, ye appeared as divine servants, O all-wise sacred mystics of the incarnate Word, having pastured the Lord's flock well through divine power.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Распеншесѧ мі́рови Прпⷣбніи пло́тію: всѣ́хъ сласте́й ѡ́верго́стеся: и сосꙋ́ды Дх҃а ꙗви́вшеся: дꙋ́хи пре́лестныѧ, Бж҃твенною си́лою погуби́сте вкꙋ́пѣ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having crucified yourselves unto the world in the flesh, O venerable ones, ye cast away all pleasures; and having appeared as vessels of the Spirit, ye destroyed the deceitful spirits together through divine power.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́же ѡ зе́мла повелѣ́ніе твои́мъ Гдⷭ҇и, вѣ́рою бл҃гоче́стною ще́дре, преста́вльшаѧся, жи́зни безконе́чнѣй, и свѣ́тꙋ невече́рнемꙋ сподо́би, поко́й ꙗ́кѡ бл҃гъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *For the Departed:* Those who have been translated from the earth by Thy command, O Lord, in pious faith, O Tender-hearted One: account worthy of endless life and unwaning light, and grant them rest, as Thou art good.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́ко Кг҃а ро́ждшꙋ пло́тію Прчⷭ҇таѧ, нра́вомъ бл҃гоче́стныи чтемъ тѧ̀ непреста́нно: со чт҃ны́ми жена́ми, по́стѡ просіѧ́вшыми: и страда́ніи низложи́вшый врага̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: As having given birth unto God in the flesh, O Most-pure One, we piously honor Thee unceasingly with righteous disposition, together with the venerable women who shone forth in fasting, and by their sufferings cast down the enemy.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Раздѣлѧ́емомꙋ мо́рю жезло̀: и низложи́ а́дово мꙋчи́телско, на нб҃са̀ Прчⷭ҇таѧ на́мъ возше́дъ, страстоте́рпческій ли́къ совозне́слъ еси́, нн҃ѣ же, дш҃а поко́й, преста́вленный к тебѣ̀ Хѐ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Unto the sea divided with a rod: and cast down the tyranny of Hades; having ascended unto the heavens, O Most-pure One, Thou didst raise up the choir of passion-bearers with Thyself; and now give rest unto the souls of those translated unto Thee, O Christ.[^143]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́же Бж҃твенныхъ Мꙋ́нки ѹкрѣплѧ́ѧй, и тѣ́ми пре́лесть попрѣка́лъ еси́: мольба́ми и́, ꙗ́кѡ Бг҃а, сконча́вшалем ꙗ́же ѡ тебѐ Сп҃се, безсме́ртїа, и бл҃же́ннаго наслѣ́діа, ѹлꙋчи́ти бл҃говоли́.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Thou Who dost strengthen the divine martyrs, and by them didst overthrow deception: through their supplications, as God, deign that those who have finished their course in Thee, O Savior, may obtain immortality and the blessed inheritance.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: За рабы̑, Влчⷪ҇ко свою̀ кро́вь, закла́всѧ изліѧ́лъ еси́ ꙗ́ко ще́др: до́лгъ же за ни́хъ возда́лъ, сего̀ ра́ди милосе́рде тебѐ мо́лимъ: преста́вленныѧ рабы̑ твоѧ̑ к тебѣ̀, ѹпоко́й. Ко́. Поко́ин.
items.english_cohort_translation: For the sake of Thy servants, O Master, Thou didst pour forth Thine own Blood, being slaughtered as a compassionate One, and didst pay the debt for them; therefore, O Merciful One, we pray Thee: give rest unto Thy servants who have been translated unto Thee. For the Departed.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Чи́стѡ воспое́мъ Кц҃у, Бг҃а ро́ждшꙋ: и́же сме́ртію свое́ю, сме́рть на́шꙋ испрове́ргшаго: и жи́знь исто́чншаго неста́рѣющꙋюся, и къ вѣ́ки пребыва́ющее блаже́нство.
items.english_cohort_translation: Purely let us hymn the Mother of God, who bare God: Who by His death overthrew our death, and poured forth ageless life, and blessedness enduring unto the ages.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, г҃. Ірмо́съ. Непло́днаѧ дш҃е и безча́днаѧ, стѧжи́ пло́дъ ѡ Ба, и весела́щисѧ возопíй, ѹтверди́хсѧ тобо́ю Бж҃е, нѣ́стъ ст҃ъ, и нѣ́стъ пра́ведна, па́че тебѐ Гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 3. Heirmos.* O barren and childless soul, acquire fruit from God, and rejoicing cry aloud: I am established through Thee, O God; there is none holy, and none righteous, save Thee, O Lord.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Си́лою Бж҃іею ѹкрѣплѧ́еми, Мꙋ́ченици сла́вныи: пагꙋборо́днꙋю си́лꙋ, и́же въ зло́бѣ си́льнаго врага̀, до конца̀ погуби́сте: и побѣ́дныѧ приѧ́сте бж҃твенныѧ вѣ́ньца.
items.english_cohort_translation: Strengthened by the power of God, O glorious martyrs, ye completely destroyed the ruinous power of the enemy who was mighty in wickedness, and received divine crowns of victory.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́же Прпⷣбныхъ, Влчⷪ҇ко, ꙗви́лъ еси́ вра́га побѣди́телей: и Ст҃лей помаза́ніемъ прест҃ы́м, ѡ́снѣ Хѐ, тѣ́хъ мольба́ми ѡ́стнѣ, и́просвѣти́ пою́щій тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou hast shown forth the venerable ones, O Master, as conquerors of the enemy; and with the most-holy anointing of hierarchs, O Christ, through their supplications, enlighten those who sing of Thee.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Съ Прр́ки всѣ́ми, восхва́лимъ тъ же́нъ бж҃твенныхъ ли́къ, ꙗ́же въ по́стѣ просїѧ́вшаѧ, и вѣ́рою пострада́вшаѧ, и многоко́зньнаго ѕмíа попра́вшаѧ. По́:
items.english_cohort_translation: Together with all the Prophets, let us praise the divine choir of women who shone forth in fasting, and suffered through faith, and trampled upon the manifold-wiled serpent. For the Departed:

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́хже ѡ на́ преста́вилъ еси́ Бж҃е, есте́ственною во́лею, Хѐ: съ ст҃ы́ми ѹчини́, ꙗ́же въ жи́тіи пре́зрѣ ще́дре тѣ́хъ прегрѣше́ніа, моли́твами сѧ, мл҃твами ст҃ы̑ твоей.
items.english_cohort_translation: Those whom Thou hast translated from among us, O God, according to Thy natural will, O Christ: number with the saints, overlooking their transgressions in this life, O Tender-hearted One, through the prayers of Thy saints.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́же спасе́нн Прчⷭ҇таѧ, твои́мъ чт҃ны́мъ Ржтво́мъ, глаголо́ливо вопіе́мъ ти вѣ́рнѡ, е́же, Ра́дꙋйсѧ: и мо́лимъ сѧ, твои́ми моли́твами прегрѣше́ніамъ проще́ніе всѣ́м на́мъ испроси́.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having been saved, O Most-pure One, by Thy venerable birth-giving, with eloquent voice we faithfully cry unto Thee: Rejoice! And we pray: through Thy prayers entreat forgiveness of transgressions for us all.

items.english_cohort_translation: Thou Who didst create me from the earth, and when I, wretched one, was returned unto the earth, didst renew me by Thy Cross: give rest unto the souls of the departed, through the prayers of the martyrs.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Страстоте́рпецъ Мꙋ́нкъ бж҃твенными, бл҃зными же, и ра́нами, и мꙋ́ками, ѹмоле́нъ быва́ѧ: дш҃а рабъ свои́хъ, въ ст҃ы́хъ селе́ніи, ѹчини́ ще́дре.
items.english_cohort_translation: Being entreated by the divine wounds, afflictions, and tortures of the passion-bearing martyrs: number the souls of Thy servants in the dwellings of the saints, O Tender-hearted One.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Изба́ви чл҃колю́бче рабы̑ своѧ̀, гее́нскаго ѻ́гнѧ, и мра́чныѧ селе́ніи а́довыхъ: къ тебѣ́же Бл҃го ѹсо́пшаѧ, ѡ твое́й наде́ждѣ, Сщ҃еннѣйшаѧ, ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и содѣ́телю: тва́ри сꙋ́щи, и́же сме́рть разорша́го, Кц҃е всечт҃наѧ, и нетлѣ́ніе на́мъ дарова́вшаго.
items.english_cohort_translation: Deliver Thy servants, O Lover of mankind, from the fire of Gehenna and from the dark dwellings of Hades, who have fallen asleep in Thee, O Good One, in hope of Thee, O Most-venerable One, as Mother of the Creator of creation, Who hast destroyed death, O All-honored Mother of God, and granted us incorruption.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, д҃. Ірмо́съ. Присѣ́ннꙋю го́рꙋ, Авваку́мъ пре́зрѧш, Прчⷭ҇таго ти чре́ва чт҃аѧ, тѣ́мъ и вопіѧ́ше: ѡ ю́га пріи́детъ Бг҃ъ: и Ст҃ы́й изъ горы́ присѣ́нныѧ ча́щи.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́коже ѡ́вчѧта приведе́стесѧ всѝ, закла́вшесѧ ꙗ́коже а́гнци, мꙋ́дріи страда́льцы: А́гнцꙋ и́же на дре́вѣ Кр́тнѣмъ бл҃говоли́вшему Бж҃ію Сло́ву, закла́тисѧ за ро́дъ чл҃ческій.
items.english_cohort_translation: Like sheep were ye all brought, being slaughtered as lambs, O wise sufferers, unto the Lamb, the Word of God, Who deigned to be slaughtered upon the tree of the Cross for the human race.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Съ Прпⷣбными чте́мъ, сла́вныѧ Первосвяще́нники: свѣти́лники бы́вшаѧ вѣ́рнымъ: е́реси же разрꙋши́вшаѧ, и стра́стемъ тмꙋ̀ глубо́кꙋю: и къ незаходи́момꙋ свѣ́тꙋ, вѣ́рою привлѣ́кшихъ сѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Together with the venerable ones we honor the glorious chief hierarchs, who became luminaries unto the faithful, who abolished heresies and the deep darkness of passions, and through faith drew men unto the unwaning Light.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́же житіѐ ѡста́вльшаѧ, премїрней сла́вѣ, прича́стники покажи́, Сло́ве Бж҃ій, прегрѣше́ній избавле́ніе, си́мъ да́рꙋѧ, бл҃же: и́же содѣ́ѧша на земли́, въ вѣ́дѣніи и не вѣ́дѣніи.
items.english_cohort_translation: Make those who have left this life partakers of celestial glory, O Word of God, granting them deliverance from transgressions, O Good One, which they committed upon earth, in knowledge and in ignorance.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́ченикамъ Бж҃твенное ѹдобре́ніе, и крѣ́пкымъ ѹтвержде́ніе, Прр́кѡмъ ѡглаше́ніе: всепѣ́тꙋю воспое́мъ Гдⷭ҇ни мт҃рь.
items.english_cohort_translation: As the divine ornament of martyrs, the steadfast confirmation of the venerable, and the proclamation of the Prophets, let us hymn the all-praised Mother of the Lord.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мт҃и вои́стиннꙋ и Дѣ́ва, ꙗви́ласѧ еси́ всенепоро́чнаѧ, зача́тіе, и рождество̀ нетлѣ́нное, въ дѣ́вствѣ еди́на сочетле́вши: Бг҃а бо родила̀ еси́, сме́рти разоршаго си́лу.
items.english_cohort_translation: Truly hast thou appeared as Mother and Virgin, O All-immaculate One, having uniquely united an incorrupt conception and birth-giving in virginity; for thou gavest birth unto God, Who destroyed the power of death.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Свѣ́томъ си невече́рнимъ, Хѐ, ѡзари́ Бг҃е смире́ннꙋю ми дш҃ꙋ: и наста́ви на стра́ твою̀, зане́ свѣ́тъ повелѣ́ніа твоѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Your wounds and bruises appeared unto the enemy as incurable wounds; and now do ye, O sufferers of the Lord, heal the wounds of all the faithful.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ра́ны ва́ша и ꙗ́звы: врагꙋ̀ ѹ́бо ꙗви́шася, ꙗ́звы неисцѣ́льныѧ, ꙗ́звы же нн҃ѣ исцѣлѧ́й, всѣ́мъ вѣ́рнымъ, страда́льци Гдⷭ҇ни.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кг҃а вопло́щшасѧ на́съ ра́ди, лю́бѧще сла́вныѧ жены́, нра́вомъ пра́вымъ пострада́вше, и по́двигшеся: на нб҃сѣхъ нн҃ѣ пребыва́ютъ. Покой.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ ра́йстей пи́щи, въ стра́нѣ живы́хъ, Хѐ: и́деже сіѧ́етъ тво́й свѣ́тъ: всели́, и́хже преста́вилъ еси́ ѡ земли́, вѣ́рныѧ ти рабы̑.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ Цр҃кви пе́рвенецъ Бл҃же, преше́дшаѧ ѡ на́съ, Мꙋ́нкъ ра́ди, и страда́лецъ мольба́ми, съ пра́ведными причти́.
items.english_cohort_translation: For the deliverance of many transgressions, O Christ, Thou didst pour forth Thy most-holy Blood; and now, through the supplications of Thy martyrs, O Savior, give rest unto those who have piously fallen asleep.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: За избавле́ніе мно́гихъ прегрѣше́ній, прест҃ꙋю кро́вь свою̀ Хѐ, изліѧ́лъ еси́, и нн҃ѣ Мꙋ́нкъ твои́хъ Сп҃се мольба́ми: бл҃гоче́стнѡ ѹсо́пшаѧ поко́й.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. Ірмо́съ. Газе́нна страсте́й воста̀ на́ма, и бꙋ́рѧ проти́вны ми вѣ́трѡ: но предва́ривъ мѧ̀ ты̀, спаси́ Сп҃се, и изба́ви нетлѣ́ніа, ꙗ́коже спа́слъ еси́ ѡ ѕвѣ́ра Прр́ка.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Свѣти́лници ѡ́ страшнаго свѣ́тоꙗвле́ніа, а́гньцы, А́гнца и па́стырѧ сщ҃еннѣйши всесла́вныи Хв҃ы страда́льцы, да почтꙋ́тъся сщ҃енными пѣ́сньми.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вознесе́ся Прпⷣбныхъ собо́ръ, возне́сн Бг҃а въ смире́ніи: и просла́вися мно́жество Первосщ҃енникъ: въ дѣ́лехъ добры́хъ, просла́вивши ст҃ы́и Трꙋ́дъ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Преложи́ на ра́дость вѣ́рѣ ѹсо́пшихъ рыда́ніе, мл҃твами страстоте́рпецъ: преподо́бныхъ бл҃голѣ́пнѣ весе́ліемъ, Хр́те: блгвенный Бг҃ъ, ѹкрѣпи́вый и къ свѣ́тꙋ твое́мꙋ, направлѧ́ѧ ихъ. и наста́влѧѧ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Поко́й, Бж҃е, мно́жествомъ щедро́тъ твои́хъ, Патріа́рхѡвъ въ ло́нѣ, преста́вленыѧ: и́деже свѣ́тъ сїѧ́етъ свѣ́тлый твое́го лица̀, Хѐ: презира́ѧ и всѧ̑ прегрѣше́ніа.

items.slavonic_text: Ме́ртвости и тлѧ̀ и сме́рти изба́вихо́мсѧ, пресла́вным рождество́мъ ти, Бг҃ома́ти: ты́ бо на́мъ чт҃аѧ, родила̀ еси́, нетлѣ́ніа исто́чника: и твои́мъ свѣ́томъ, мі́ра всего̀ просвѣти́ла еси́.
items.english_text: From deadness, corruption, and death have we been delivered through thy glorious birth-giving, O Mother of God; for thou, O Pure One, gavest birth unto the Fountain of incorruption, and hast enlightened the whole world with thy light.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, з҃. Ірмо́съ. Трі́е ѻ́троцы въ пе́щи, Тр҃цꙋ преѡбрази́вша, преще́ніе ѡ́гненное попра́ша: и пою́ще вопія́ху: блгвенъ еси́ Гди, Бж҃е ѡ́цъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 7. Heirmos.* The three children in the furnace prefigured the Trinity; they trampled upon the threat of fire, and singing they cried: Blessed art Thou, O Lord, God of our fathers.[^145]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Стоѧ́ще посредѣ̀ ѻ́гнѧ, пресла́вніи страстоте́рпцы, бж҃твеннꙋю ро́сꙋ пріима́ете: и ѹмертви́вше тѧ мꙋ́ками, многоко́зньнаго врага̀, ме́ртва содѣ́ласте.
items.english_cohort_translation: Standing in the midst of the fire, O all-glorious passion-bearers, ye received divine dew; and having mortified the manifold-wiled enemy by your tortures, ye made him dead.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бж҃твенныи Ст҃ліе, ꙗ́кѡ кора́бль непра́вльше цр҃говъ Хв҃у: непотоплѧ́емꙋ тꙋ соблюдо́ша, пре́лести избѣ́гше вои́стиннꙋ злы́хъ во́лнъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The divine hierarchs, having steered the Church of Christ as a ship, preserved her un-submerged, having truly escaped the evil waves of deception.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оумертви́вше пло́ть сщ҃енными подвиги, по́стници и́стинныи, безстра́стіа наслѣ́довасте живо́ нестарѣ́ющїися, съ ст҃ы́ми Прр́ки: и сщ҃енными жена́ми.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having mortified the flesh through sacred ascetical labors, O true fasters, ye inherited ageless life and passionlessness, together with the holy Prophets and sacred women.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́ченикѡмъ, Прпⷣбнымъ, Прр́комъ же всенепоро́чнаѧ, и ст҃ы́мъ жена́мъ, и всѣ́мъ первосщ҃енникѡмъ, сщ҃енно пожи́вшый: ты̀ еси́ сла́ва вои́стиннꙋ, ѡни́ми же чте́мъ тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Unto the martyrs, venerable ones, and Prophets, O All-immaculate One, and holy women, and all chief hierarchs who lived holily: Thou art truly the glory; therefore with them we honor thee.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѿ тѣле́съ ѹ́бѡ, ꙗ́кѡ тли́телнаѧ, до́блественнѣ неради́ша сла́вніи мꙋ́ннци Хв҃ы: нн҃ѣ же, содерзнове́ніемъ мо́лѧтсѧ к тебѣ̀: дш҃а поко́й преста́вленны рабъ твои́хъ, Бж҃е, ѡ́цъ на́шн.
items.english_cohort_translation: The glorious martyrs of Christ bravely disregarded their bodies as corruptible; and now with boldness they pray unto Thee: give rest unto the souls of Thy departed servants, O God of our fathers.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тро́стію Кр́тного, пописа́лъ еси́ ѡставле́ніе грѣхѡ́въ всѣ́мъ вѣ́рным, его́же, нн҃ѣ дш҃а ꙗ́же преста́ви к тебѣ̀, прича́стнитися сподо́би, и въ весе́ліи пѣ́ти тѧ, Бж҃е, ѡ́цъ на́ши.
items.english_cohort_translation: With the rod of the Cross Thou didst write forgiveness of sins for all the faithful; account the souls whom Thou hast now translated unto Thee worthy to partake thereof, and to sing of Thee in gladness, O God of our fathers.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сло́во Ѿч҃ее, и́же всѧ̀ во́лею содѣва́ѧй: естество̀ чл҃вѣческое погребе́нное страстьми, ꙗ́ко Бг҃ъ ѡбнови́, бл҃гвенъ Прчⷭ҇таѧ, пло́дъ твое́го чре́ва.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Word of the Father, Who of Thine own will dost accomplish all things: as God Thou didst renew human nature which was buried in passions; blessed, O Most-pure One, is the fruit of Thy womb!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, и҃. Ірмо́съ. И́же ѡ А́гг҃лъ немо́лчно, вовы́шнихъ сла́вимаго Кг҃а, нб҃са̀, землѧ̀, го́ры, и хо́лми, и глубина̀, и ꙗ́вленна, и ве́сь ро́дъ чловѣ́ческіи, пѣ́сньми ꙗ́ко, ꙗ́ко Тво́рца и изба́вителѧ, бл҃гвте.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 8. Heirmos.* Bless the Lord, Who is unceasingly glorified in the highest by the Angels: the heavens, the earth, the mountains, the hills, the deep, and all that is manifest, and all the race of mankind, with hymns bless Him as Creator and Deliverer.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Нанесе́ніемъ ра́нъ, и болѣ́зней приложе́ньми, прогнѣва́вшесѧ ѕѣло̀, не ѿверго́стеся и́стиннаго живота̀, Гдⷭ҇ни стратоте́рпцы, ни истꙋка́ннымъ пода́сте лꙋка́вꙋю по́честь.
items.english_cohort_translation: Inflicted with wounds and subjected to diseases, being exceedingly afflicted, ye did not deny the true Life, O passion-bearers of the Lord, nor did ye offer deceitful honor unto idols.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Свѣти́ла, ꙗ́коже насвѣ́щницѣхъ поло́женни, чт҃ныхъ добро́дѣтелеи: всѣ́хъ ѡзаря́ете страстоте́рпцы, сщ҃еннодѣ́йственнїи: не́нымъ ѹ́мѡви сожи́теліе.
items.english_cohort_translation: As lamps set upon candlesticks of venerable virtues, ye enlighten all men, O sacred passion-bearers, fellow citizens with the heavenly minds.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Достохва́лніи Прр́ци, и Прпⷣбніи бгосло́віе, и же́ны всѣ́хъ бл҃го́дѣтельнаѧ мно́жество достосла́вное: да воспои́мъ досто́йнѡ, ѡна́ моля́щееся, Сп҃су и Кг҃у.
items.english_cohort_translation: Let us worthily hymn the praiseworthy Prophets, and the theological discourse of the venerable, and the praiseworthy multitude of all beneficent women, who pray for us unto the Savior and God.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Та́йне живы́ми ѡблада́ѧй, и́хже ѡ землѧ̀ преста́ви еси́ вѣ́рныхъ, со ст҃ы́ми въ свѣ́тѣ лица̀ твое́го ѹчини́: проще́ніе прегрѣше́ніамъ, мно́гаго ра́ди Сп҃се, мл҃рдіа подаѧ̀ еи́.
items.english_cohort_translation: *For the Departed:* O Thou Who mystically rulest over the living: number those faithful whom Thou hast translated from the earth with the saints in the light of Thy countenance, granting forgiveness of transgressions for the sake of Thy great tender-compassion, O Savior.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Многопѣ́таѧ Дв҃а, Прр́кѡмъ ѡглаше́ніе, Ст҃лемъ, и страдалцемъ, и Прпⷣнымъ, ѹдобре́ніе, и жена́ ст҃ы́мъ ра́дость: да пое́тъся во вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Let the much-hymned Virgin, the proclamation of the Prophets, the ornament of hierarchs, sufferers, and venerable ones, and the joy of holy women, be sung unto the ages.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Инъ: Ірмо́съ. Служи́ти живо́му Кг҃у, и́же во Вавѵло́нѣ дѣ́ти претерпѣ́вш: ѡ мꙋси́кійскихъ ѻрга́нехъ неради́ша: и посредѣ̀ пла́мене стоѧ́ще, бг҃окра́снꙋ пѣ́снь воспѣва́юще, глаго́: бл҃гвте всѧ̑ дѣла Гдⷭ҇а Гдⷭ҇а, по́йте и превозноси́:
items.english_cohort_translation: *Another [Canon]. Heirmos.* The children in Babylon, having endured to serve the living God, disregarded the musical instruments; and standing in the midst of the flame, singing a hymn of divine beauty, they said: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him:

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Са́й сокро́вище безсме́ртїа, ты́ жизнонача́лниче, ме́ртвымъ нетлѣ́ніе прозяба́ти еси́, е́же твои́ ѹч҃никѡмъ, Хѐ, бл҃гоче́стно тебѣ̀ пою́щымъ дарова̀: блгвте всѧ̑ дѣла Гдⷭ҇на, Гдⷭ҇а, по́йте и превозноси́те его̀ вовѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou Thyself art the Treasure of immortality, O Prince of life; Thou didst cause incorruption to bud forth for the dead, which Thou didst grant unto Thy disciples, O Christ, who piously sing unto Thee: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him unto the ages.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́дростію дх҃овною, и терпѣ́ніемъ дѣ́лъ крѣпці́и страда́льцы, ѡ мꙋ́кахъ неради́ша: душа́мъ преставле́нымъ ѡ Ха̀ ѡслабле́ніа про́сѧтъ, зовꙋ́ще: блгвте всѧ̑ дѣла Гдⷭ҇на, Гдⷭ҇а, по́йте и превозноси́те его̀ вовѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: Through spiritual wisdom and patient endurance of works, the strong sufferers disregarded tortures; they ask refreshment from Christ for the souls that have been translated, crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him unto the ages.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Очи́сти бла́же: ко́піемъ ребра̀ твое́го, растерза́въ рꙋкописа́ніе: к тебѣ́ преста́вльшихся: и срѣдогра́діе ше́мъ прегрѣше́ніи: пѣсносло́вити тѧ ти́хъ Сп҃се бл҃говоли́: блгвте всѧ̑ дѣла Гдⷭ҇на, Гдⷭ҇а, по́йте и превозносите его̀ вовѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: Cleanse, O Good One, through the lance of Thy side, tearing up the handwriting of those translated unto Thee, and the partition-wall of their transgressions; deign that they may softly hymn Thee, O Savior: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him unto the ages.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: О́блакъ тѧ̀ мы́сленый, претѣ́чъшимъ сѧ жа́ждею ѹмерщвле́ніа, Дв҃о, чт҃аѧ ꙗви́ еси́, во́дꙋ живꙋ ѡставле́ніа, источа́ющꙋю ме́ртвы безсме́ртіе: всѣ́м и́же вѣ́рою пою́ зовꙋ́щым: блгвте всѧ̑ дѣла Гдⷭ҇на, Гдⷭ҇а, по́йте и превозноси́те его̀ вовѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Thou hast appeared as a mystical cloud, O pure Virgin, unto those who are parched with the thirst of mortification, pouring forth living water of forgiveness and immortality for the dead, unto all who sing with faith, crying: Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him unto the ages.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. Ірмо́съ. На Сина́йстеи горѣ̀ ви́дѣхъ тѧ̀, въ Кꙋпи́нѣ Мѡѷсе́й: неѡпа́лно ѻ́гнь Бж҃тва заче́ншꙋ во чре́вѣ: Даніи́лъ же тѧ̀ ви́дѣ, го́рꙋ непросѣко́мꙋю. Иса́іа, же́злъ прозѧ́бшій, возыва́ше: и́ско́рене Давы́дова.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 9. Heirmos.* Moses saw Thee upon Mount Sinai in the Bush, who didst unburnt conceive the fire of the Godhead in Thy womb; and Daniel saw Thee as the unhewn mountain; and Isaiah cried aloud, calling Thee the rod that sprouted from the root of David.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́коже ѡвча́та приведе́стесѧ, закла́вшемꙋсѧ на́съ ра́ди, и Бж҃твенны ли́ки А́гглъ испо́лните ра́дости, страстоте́рпци Хв҃ы: тѣ́мже, мл҃твами вы́шни всѣ́хъ ѹтверди́те: и ѡ вра́га вре́дныѧ пре́лести, изба́вѣте.
items.english_cohort_translation: Like sheep were ye brought unto Him Who was slaughtered for our sake, and ye filled the divine choirs of Angels with joy, O passion-bearers of Christ; therefore, by your prayers on high, establish all men, and deliver them from the harmful deception of the enemy.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́кѡ свѣти́лници, живо́тное Сло́во имꙋ́ще: просвѣти́те дꙋша̀, Первосвѧще́нници Хв҃ы сщ҃еннѣйшіи: ꙗ́кѡ ѡ́гнь пріе́мше Дх҃а. Пре́лести: стра́сти попали́сте, и І́долское ражда́жаніе погуби́сте.
items.english_cohort_translation: As luminaries possessing the living Word, enlighten our souls, O most-sacred High Priests of Christ, having received the fire of the Spirit; ye consumed the passions of deception and destroyed the generation of idols.[^146]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Съ Цр҃кви ст҃ы́ми, почти́мъ Прпⷣбныхъ мно́жество: пре́же зако́на и въ зако́нѣ вопію́щій, жи́тіемъ чи́стымъ. Же́нъ же ст҃ы́хъ ли́къ восхвалимъ, и возопіе́мъ: Гдⷭ҇и, моли́твами и́хъ, спасѝ всѣ́хъ на́съ.
items.english_cohort_translation: With the holy members of the Church let us honor the multitude of the Venerable, who cried aloud before the Law and under the Law through pure life; and let us praise the choir of holy women, crying aloud: O Lord, by their prayers save us all.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Погребе́ніе ти, Хѐ, и Воскресе́ніе, всѣ́мъ бы́сть живо́тъ. Сего́ ра́ди дерза́юще, вопіе́мъ тѝ: советми избра́нными, вѣ́рныѧ и́хже приѧ́лъ рабы̑ своѧ̀, поко́й: и си́хъ согрѣше́ніа, всѧ̀ простѝ ꙗ́кѡ Бг҃ъ пребл҃гíи.
items.english_cohort_translation: *For the Departed:* Thy burial, O Christ, and Thy Resurrection became life unto all. Therefore, taking courage, we cry aloud unto Thee: together with Thine elect servants, give rest unto the faithful servants whom Thou hast received, and forgive all their transgressions, as the all-good God.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Стра́шно мѣ́сто сїѐ, возопѝ: егда̀ Іа́кѡвъ твоѐ воѡбраже́ніе въ Лѣ́ствици видѣ̀ Бц҃е: нело́жнаѧ Мꙋ́никѡмъ сла́во. И Прпⷣбны похвало̀, ѡглаше́ніе всѣ́мъ Прр́кѡмъ, и вѣ́рнымъ спасеніе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Dreadful is this place! cried Jacob aloud when he beheld thy prefiguration in the Ladder, O Mother of God, un-deceiving glory of the martyrs, praise of the venerable, proclamation of all the Prophets, and salvation of the faithful.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Инъ: Ірмо́съ. И́же кꙋпи́ною и ѡ́гнемъ прописа́ннꙋю въ Сина́и, законополо́жнику Мѡѷсе́ю: и Бж҃твенный въ чре́вѣ неѡпа́лно заче́ншꙋю ѡ́гнь: всесвѣ́тлꙋю, и не ѹгаса́емꙋю свѣщꙋ̀, сꙋ́щꙋю Бц҃ꙋ, въ пѣ́сне чтем, велича́юще.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Another [Canon]. Heirmos.* Her who was prefigured by the bush and by fire on Sinai unto Moses the lawgiver, and who without being burned conceived the divine Fire in her womb: the all-radiant and unquenchable lamp, the true Mother of God, we honor in hymns, magnifying her.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Нн҃ѣ ꙗ́кѡ еди́нъ бл҃гъ, и чл҃колю́бецъ Бг҃ъ, преста́вленныѧ к тебѣ̀, Мꙋ́нкъ мольба́ми, въ стра́нѣ кро́ткихъ землѧ̀ весе́ліа: раздрѣше́ніе прѣгрѣше́ній пода́ждь да́ждь милостиве, непреста́нно пѣ́сньми тѧ̀ велича́ющій.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Now as the only good and mankind-loving God, by the supplications of the martyrs, give forgiveness of transgressions unto those who have been translated unto Thee, O Merciful One, in the land of the meek, the land of gladness, unto those who unceasingly magnify Thee with hymns.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ ст҃ы́хъ селе́ніихъ, въ ло́нѣхъ Авраа́ма, и́хже приѧ́тъ, Хѐ, причтѝ съ пра́ведными кои́ми: и́деже сїѧ́етъ свѣ́тъ лица̀ твое́го, неизрече́нныѧ неи́зтвенны, и пребыва́ющее къ вѣ́ки вои́стинꙋ, присносꙋ́щное радова́ніе.
items.english_cohort_translation: In the holy tabernacles, in the bosom of Abraham, number those whom Thou hast received, O Christ, with the righteous, where the light of Thy countenance shines, the ineffable and divine, and true everlasting joy that abides unto the ages.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Блаже́ннѣй ти жи́зни, и вѣ́чный бл҃гъ, непреста́нней пи́щи, весе́лію и́стинномꙋ, сподо́би рабы̑ своѧ̀, и́хже преста́ви во́лею жизнода́вче, на мѣ́стѣ зла́чнѣ, на вода́хъ поко́ина.
items.english_cohort_translation: Make Thy servants whom Thou hast translated by Thy will worthy of Thy blessed life, eternal good things, unceasing delight, and true gladness, O Giver of life, in a place of pasture, beside the waters of rest.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́кѡ ст҃ый Ковче́гъ, и свѣ́щникъ Ски́нію законода́вца Бл҃, приѧ́тъ въ ѹтро́бѣ всенепоро́чнаѧ, зижди́телѧ своего̀, и́же ѡрꙋ́жіе ѡбрѣ́тша древнаѧ, и зако́нъ сме́рти: свое́ю сме́ртію испрове́ргшаго.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* As the holy Ark and candlestick of the Tabernacle of the Lawgiver, O all-immaculate Lady, Thou didst receive in Thy womb Thy Creator, Who by His death overthrew the ancient weapon found against us and the law of death.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ст҃ы́хъ страстоте́рпецъ па́мѧть, прїидѣ́те лю́діе всѝ почти́мъ: ꙗ́кѡ позо́ръ бы́ша, А́гглѡмъ и чл҃кѡмъ, и побѣ́дѣ вѣ́ньца ѡ Хр́та пріа́ша: и мо́лѧтъсѧ ѡ дꋋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Come, all ye peoples, let us honor the memory of the holy passion-bearers; for they became a spectacle unto Angels and men, and received crowns of victory from Christ; and they pray for our souls.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Царе́й и мꙋчи́телей стра́хъ ѿри́нꙋша, Хв҃ы во́инни: и бл҃годерзнове́нно и мꙋ́жески того̀ исповѣ́даша, всѣ́ческихъ Гдⷭ҇а Бг҃а и Цр҃ѧ на́шего: и мо́лѧтъ сѧ за дꙋша на́ша.
items.english_cohort_translation: The soldiers of Christ cast away the fear of kings and tyrants, and with holy boldness and courage confessed Him, the Lord God of all and our King; and they pray for our souls.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Си́лы ст҃ы́хъ А́гг҃лъ ѹди́вишасѧ, Мꙋ́ническіи стра́даніам, ꙗ́ко пло́тію ѡбложе́ни, ѡ мꙋ́кахъ неради́ша: подо́бници бы́вше стра́стемъ Сп҃са Хр́та: и мо́лѧт сѧ ѡ дꙋша́хъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The powers of the holy Angels were astonished at the contests of the martyrs, how being clothed in flesh they disregarded tortures, having become imitators of the passions of Christ the Savior; and they pray for our souls.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́кѡ свѣти́ла, въ мі́рѣ сїѧ́ете: и посме́рти ст҃ы́и Мꙋ́ннци: по́двигомъ добры́мъ подви́гшесѧ, имѣ́юще дерзнове́ніе, Хр́та моли́те: поми́ловатися дꙋша́мъ на́шимъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Ye shine as luminaries in the world, and even after death, O holy martyrs, having fought the good fight and possessing boldness, pray unto Christ that our souls may find mercy.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Безсѣ́менн зачала̀ есѝ ѡ ст҃го Дх҃а: и славосло́вѧще, воспѣва́емъ тѧ: Ра́дуйсѧ прест҃а́ѧ Дв҃о.
items.english_cohort_translation: Without seed Thou didst conceive of the Holy Spirit; and glorifying Thee, we sing: Rejoice, O most-holy Virgin!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: НА СТІХОВНА, СТИХИРЫ Покоины. Гласъ, г҃. По: Ве́ліа Кр́та твое́го Гди:
items.english_cohort_translation: *For the Departed. Tone 3. To: Great is the power of Thy Cross, O Lord:[^148]* I glorify Thy precious Cross, by which life was bestowed and the enjoyment of delight unto those who sing of Thee in faith and love, O only abundant in mercy; therefore we cry unto Thee, O Christ God: Give rest unto those translated from among us, where there is a dwelling of all who rejoice in Thee.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Еди́не ми́лостиве и бл҃гоѹтро́бне, имѣ́ѧй непостижи́мꙋю бл҃гости пꙋчи́нꙋ, свѣ́дый естество̀ чл҃чкое, е́же содѣ́лалъ еси́, тѧ̀ мо́лимъ, Хѐ Бж҃е, преста́вленныѧ ѡ на́ поко́й: и́деже всѣ́мъ е́сть веселя́щїисѧ житіе́ оу тебѐ.
items.english_cohort_translation: O only Merciful and Tender-compassionate One, Who possessest an unfathomable abyss of goodness, and knowest human nature which Thou didst fashion: we pray Thee, O Christ God, give rest unto those translated from among us, where there is a dwelling of all who rejoice in Thee.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Свѣщꙋ̀ разꙋмнꙋю тѧ, нося́щꙋю свѣ́тъ Бж҃тва, совокоу́пльша ся дебелостїи чл҃чскаго сꙋще́ства, Бц҃е, вси свѣ́кмы: своего̀ молѝ Сн҃а и Бг҃а, преста́вленныѧ ѡ на́ поко́ити: и́деже всѣ́мъ е́стъ веселя́щымъ ся радова́ніе.
items.english_cohort_translation: We all know thee, O Mother of God, as an intelligible lamp bearing the light of the Godhead united unto the coarseness of human nature; pray thou unto thy Son and God to give rest unto those translated from among us, where there is gladness for all who rejoice.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Отвергшаго Хѐ за́повѣдь твою̀, пра́ѡтца Ада́ма, и́з Раѧ̀ изгна́лъ еси́, разбо́инника же, ще́дре, исповѣ́давша тѧ̀ на Кр́тѣ: во́нь ввели́лъ еси́, зовꋋ́ща: Помѧни́ мя Сп҃се, въ црⷭ҇твіи си.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst cast out our forefather Adam from Paradise when he set aside Thy commandment, O Christ; but the thief who confessed Thee upon the cross Thou didst bring into it, O Compassionate One, as he cried: Remember me, O Savior, in Thy kingdom.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Огньны̑ ра́намъ примѣша́вшеся, страстоте́рпци Хв҃ы: ро́сꙋ нб҃нꙋю ѡбрѣто́сте, прохлажда́ющꙋю же и ѡкрѣплѧ́ющꙋю ва́съ, терпѣ́ти плотскїа го́ркіа болѣ́зни, тѣ́мже, ѡбеле́гаете всѧ́ку болѣ́знь, пр́но ѡ дш҃ъ на́шн.
items.english_cohort_translation: Mingling yourselves with fiery wounds, O passion-bearers of Christ, ye found heavenly dew which refreshed and strengthened you to endure the bitter bodily pains; therefore ye ease every pain continually for our souls.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ст҃лїе сщ҃енніи, Прр́цы сла́вніи, и Прпⷣбныхъ мно́жество, и же́нъ Бж҃твенныхъ собо́ръ, по́стѡмъ пре́лесть вра́жію: же́нвнꙋю сла́вꙋ получи́ша, и́хже моли́твами, Сп҃се, ѡуще́дри рабы̑ своѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: O sacred hierarchs, glorious Prophets, multitude of the venerable, and choir of divine women, through fasting ye received heavenly glory, trampling down the deception of the enemy; by their prayers, O Savior, have mercy upon Thy servants.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́деже сїя́етъ тво́й свѣ́тъ ко хра́мѣхъ избра́нныхъ ти, Бж҃е, и́деже пи́ща приснотекꙋ́щая, ꙗ́же ѡ на́съ вѣ́рою преставленныѧ ѡучини́ Ісѐ: презира́ѧ и́хъ Сп҃се согрѣше́ніа: да тѧ̀, ꙗ́ко приле́жно сла́вимъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *For the Departed:* Where Thy light shines in the mansions of Thine elect, O God, where delight flows evermore, establish those who have been translated from among us in faith, O Jesus, overlooking their transgressions, O Savior, that we may diligently glorify Thee.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Животворѧ́щемꙋ твое́мꙋ Кр́тꙋ, непреста́нно кла́нѧющеся, Хѐ: тридне́вное ти Воскресе́ніе, сла́вимъ, тѣ́мъ бо ѡбнови́лъ есѝ, истлѣ́вшее чл҃чческое естество̀, всеси́льне, и е́же на нб҃са восхо́дъ, ѡбнови́ есѝ на́мъ: ꙗ́кѡ еди́нъ бл҃гъ и чл҃колю́бецъ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.day_or_date: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дре́ва преслꙋша́ніа, запрѣще́ніе разрѣши́лъ есѝ Сп҃се, на дре́вѣ Кр́тнѣмъ, во́лею пригвожде́ся: и въ адъ соше́дъ си́лне: сме́ртныѧ ѹ́зы, ꙗ́кѡ Бг҃ъ, расто́ргалъ еси́, сегора́ди, кла́нѧемся е́же и́з мертвы́хъ твое́мꙋ Воскресе́нію, ра́достію вопію́ще: всеси́льне Гдⷭ҇и, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst loose the condemnation of the tree of disobedience, O Savior, by willingly being nailed to the wood of the Cross; and descending into hades, O Mighty One, Thou didst tear apart the bonds of death as God; therefore we bow down before Thy Resurrection from the dead, crying aloud with joy: O Almighty Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вра́та а́дова, сокрꙋши́лъ есѝ Гдⷭ҇и: и свое́ю сме́ртію, сме́ртное ца́рство разрꙋши́лъ еси́, ро́дъ же чл҃чческій, и́з нетлѣ́ніа свобо́ди: живо́тъ и нетлѣ́ніе мі́рꙋ дарова̀, и ве́лїю мл҃ть.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst shatter the gates of hades, O Lord, and by Thy death didst destroy the kingdom of death; and Thou didst set free the human race from corruption, granting life, incorruption, and great mercy unto the world.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ве́ліе и пресла́вное, е́же на тебѣ̀ бы́вшее чꙋ́до, и кто̀ дово́ленъ и́з гла́ти, си́лы Гдⷭ҇нѧ; ꙗ́же ѡ тебѣ̀ бы́вшаѧ Бц҃е, ѹ́ставиша бо ѹ́мъ на́шъ, вели́ка ѹдивле́ніа досто́йнїе, ꙗ́кѡ непостижи́маго ти та́инства гла́ти немогꙋ́ще, кто̀ бо слы́ша ѡ вѣ́ка, Дв҃ꙋ сꙋ́щи пита́ющꙋю, и Мт҃рь без мꙋ́жа, ꙗ́вльшꙋюся на земли́; и своего̀ содѣ́телѧ, ꙗ́кѡ младе́нца на рꙋкꙋ̀ носи́вшꙋю; тѣ́мже тѧ̀, вси ро́ди, непреста́нно ѹблажа́емъ.

items.day_or_date: ON SATURDAY EVENING, AT LITTLE VESPERS
items.english_cohort_translation: O Mother of God, surpass our understanding, being worthy of great astonishment; for being unable to speak of Thy mystery which cannot be comprehended, who hath ever heard from the ages of a Virgin nursing, and a Mother appearing on earth without a man, and carrying her Creator as an infant upon her arms? Therefore, O Lady, all generations unceasingly bless Thee.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Гдⷭ҇и, возше́дъ на Кр́тъ: прароди́тельнꙋю на́шꙋ клѧ́твꙋ ѡчи́стилъ есѝ, и соше́дъ въ адъ: вѣ́чныѧ ѹ́знники свободи́ есѝ, нетлѣ́ніе дарова̀, чл҃вѣческомꙋ ро́дꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Ascending the Cross, O Lord, Thou didst wipe away our ancestral curse; and descending into hades, Thou didst set free the eternal prisoners, granting incorruption unto the human race. Therefore, singing we glorify Thy life-creating and saving Resurrection.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́же бл҃гоче́стно покланѧ́ющїися твое́мꙋ рождествꙋ̀, всѧ́каго спасѝ спасѝ навѣ́та вра́жїа, Бгороди́тельнице Всенепоро́чнаѧ, ꙗ́кѡ предста́телница ро́дꙋ на́шемꙋ, полꙋчи́вше тѧ̀ ѹ́бѡ нн҃ѣ по́мощь, всѝ стѧжа́хомъ прибѣ́жище и ѹтвержде́ніе, и хода́таицꙋ къ Влⷪ҇цѣ, Хр́тꙋ Бг҃ꙋ, его́же молѝ, ми́рови дарова́ти, мо́лимся: и прегрѣше́ній раздрѣше́ніе, прибѣга́ющимъ къ покро́вꙋ твое́мꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Save everyone who piously bows down down before Thy birth-giving, save from the assault of the enemy, O all-immaculate Mother of God, as the Protectress of our race; having now obtained Thee as our helper, we all possess a refuge and confirmation, and an advocate before the Master, Christ God; whom pray Thou to grant peace unto the world, we beseech Thee, and forgiveness of transgressions unto those who flee unto Thy protection.
