items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дв҃о всенепоро́чнаѧ, ꙗ́же пресꙋ́щнаго, Бг҃а ро́ждши, со Безпло́тными, непреста́нно того̀ мл҃и, ѡставле́ніе прегрѣше́нїамъ, и исправле́ніе житїю̀, да́ти на́м пре́жде конца̀: и́же вѣ́рою и любо́вїю пою́щымъ тѧ по до́лгꙋ, еди́на всепѣ́тая.
items.english_cohort_translation: O all-immaculate Virgin, who didst bear the transcendent God: together with the Bodiless Powers unceasingly pray unto Him to grant us remission of transgressions and amendment of life before the end, unto us who faithfully and lovingly praise thee as is meet, O only all-praised one!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Триста́ты крѣ́пкїѧ, рожде́нся ѡ Дв҃ы, безстра́стїя вогледвенѐ, дꙋ́ша трїчастное потопѝ мл҃тва, да ти ꙗ́кѡ въ тѷмпа́нѣ, во ѹмерщвле́нїемъ телесѝ, побѣ́дное пою̀ воспева́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: The three mighty captains: He Who was born of the Virgin hath drowned the tripartite soul in the deep of impassibility; by prayer, as upon a timbrel, in the mortification of the body, let me sing a hymn of victory unto Thee!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сп҃се мо́й, Ісѐ, и́же блꙋ́днаго спасы́й, и́ и́же блꙋ́дници пла́ч прїе́мый, и́же мытаря̀ воздꙋ́хъ прїе́мый, манове́нїемъ свои́мъ ѡправда́въ, безчи́сла согрѣши́вшаго, и ѡ́бращающася прїими́ и спаси́ мя.
items.english_cohort_translation: O my Savior Jesus, Who didst save the prodigal, and didst receive the weeping of the harlot, and the sigh of the publican, justifying him by Thy nod who had sinned without number: receive also me who turn, and save me.

items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́кѡ ве́щъ снѣда́етъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ зло́бный ѻ́гнь, и пла́менно гнѣ́тѣнїе твои́хъ бꙋ́дꙋщемꙋ, чл҃колю́бче, ѹгасѝ того̀, ѡроше́нїемъ ка́пель ми́лостей долготерпѣли́ве: покаѧ́нїа пода́въ мѝ сле́зы.
items.english_cohort_translation: Like combustible material, the malignant fire devours my soul, and the flame of the torment to come: O Lover of mankind, extinguish it with the dewing drops of Thy mercies, O Long-suffering One, granting me tears of repentance.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ра́зꙋма мно́га испо́лненъ, ли́къ Ст҃ы́хъ Стра́далчецъ, неразꙋ́менъ совѣ́тъ и сопроти́внꙋю мꙋ́дрость, всѣ́хъ законопрестꙋ́пный чл҃комꙋ́дрено ѹклонѝ, и поче́сть ѡ Бг҃а полꙋчѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* Filled with great understanding, the choir of holy Sufferers wisely rejected the foolish counsel and contrary wisdom of all the lawless, and received honor from God.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́же мі́ра ѡста́вльше кра́снаѧ те́рпци прехва́льнии, всѧ́каго слѣ́довасте кончи́ннꙋ ст҃го те́рпїи прехва́льныи, всѧ́каго мѧ̀ ѹ́бѡ изба́вѣте мі́рскаго смꙋще́нїа, и́же при́сносно васъ блажа́щаго.
items.english_cohort_translation: Leaving the fair things of the world, O all-lauded and patient sufferers, ye followed the holy end of every struggle; therefore deliver me, who ever call you blessed, from every worldly confusion.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Преквѣ́тлая свѣ́ще Сл҃нца сла́вы: дꙋ́ша моѧ̀ ѻ́гнь ѹгаси́вшаи ѡ́гньне́ніемъ, возжезѝ, Бж҃твенныхъ дѣ́лъ бл҃го́смъ Пречт҃аѧ напая́ющи, да вѣ́рою и любѡ́вїю, сла́влю тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* O most-radiant Lamp of the Sun of glory: rekindle my soul, which hath quenched its fire through slothfulness, watering it with the sweetness of divine deeds, O Most-pure One, that with faith and love I may glorify Thee.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сы́нꙋ въ кр҃ѣ прикло́ншагося любо́вію: и Бж҃твенными добро́тами воѡбража́еми нб҃ѣ, ѡ А́рхаггли сла́внїи, столѣ́нїемъ прине́жнымъ ѡбито́внтѣ, зовꙋ́ще: побѣ́днꙋю пѣ́снь зижди́телю.
items.english_cohort_translation: Incline with love unto the Son on high, and fashioned in the heavens with divine beauties, O glorious Archangels, ye stand in tenderest dwellings, crying: "A song of victory unto the Creator!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́же еди́на во чре́вѣ прїе́мши Сло́во, его́же А́ггльскїя во́инства сла́вѧтъ пр́но, дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ исцѣлѝ, рѣши́щи грѣхо́вный стꙋ́дъ всенепоро́чнаѧ, и просвѣща́ющи ра́зꙋмомъ рожде́нства ти.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* O thou who alone didst receive in thy womb the Word Whom the angelic hosts ever glorify: heal my soul, loose the shame of sin, O all-immaculate one, and enlighten me with understanding of thy childbearing.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, г҃. Ірмо́съ. С высоты̀ сни́де во́лею на́землю, и́же превы́шше вся́каго нача́льства и вла́сти: и смире́ное вознесе́лъ есѝ, из ада преиспо́дняго естество̀ чл҃ческое, нѣ́сть бо ст҃ъ, па́че тебѐ Гди.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* From on high He descended willingly upon the earth, He Who is exalted above every principality and power, and hath lifted up from nethermost hades the humble nature of mankind; for there is none holy save Thee, O Lord!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Но́щи жите́йскїа, тма̀ страсте́й ѡбъя́ла мя е́стъ, Хѐ Бж҃е, свѣ́тъ сы́й не захо́димый, лꙋча́ми покая́нїа ѡзари́ мя, Спасѝ: ꙗ́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ, да сла́влю тѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The darkness of passions of the night of this life hath encompassed me, O Christ God; O Thou Who art the Unwaning Light, illumine me with the rays of repentance, and save me, as Thou art the Lover of mankind, that I may glorify Thee.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ча́сти мя́ покажѝ, Хѐ, избра́нныхъ: сопроти́вныѧ ча́сти ѡлꙋчи́въ, Сп҃се, слеза́ми и ми́лостынею ѡчище́нна, ꙗ́кѡ да въхвале́нїи тѧ сла́влю всегда̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Show me to be of the portion of Thine elect, O Christ, having separated me from the adversary's part, O Savior, cleansed by tears and almsgiving, that in praise I may glorify Thee evermore.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Червлени́шася кро́вїю ва́шею ноги́ вои́стиннꙋ, и быстꙋ́пше ко нб҃си потеко́ша: согрѣхо́мъ зе́млю ѡста́вльше мꙋ́чницы: собесѣ́дницы Бж҃твенныѧ сла́вꙋ рꙋчи́мо тѣ́ло ва́ше ра́нами, растаѧ́шеся, Хвы̑ страда́льцы:
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* Your feet were truly reddened with blood, and having stepped forth, they ran unto heaven; having forsaken the earth together with sin, O Martyrs, companions of divine glory, while your body dissolved under wounds, O Sufferers of Christ, the power of your soul was strengthened, being joined inseparably with love unto Him Who created all things by His will.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́нъ: Ірмо́съ то́йже. И́же преми́рными ли́ки воспѣва́емый, чи́нѡми тѣ́хъ, Хѐ, вѣ́рныхъ соста́вленіѧ, подо́битїеся сгомоꙋ́дрзно сотворѝ Сло́ве, нѣ́сть бо ст҃ъ, па́че тебѐ чл҃колю́бче.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Word of God, Who art praised by heavenly choirs: make the assemblies of the faithful to resemble them in harmony of mind; for there is none holy save Thee, O Lover of mankind!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Любо́вїю те́плою, привяза́нїемъ рачи́телнымъ, причаща́ющеся пе́рвомꙋ исто́чникꙋ, слꙋжи́тельнѣ предстоятѣ: пою́ще немо́лчно: еди́но сꙋщество̀ Бж҃тва̀ безнача́льнаго: Бж҃твенныи Арха́ггли.
items.english_cohort_translation: With warm love and zealous affection, partaking of the primal Source, the divine Archangels stand ministrant before Him, unceasingly singing: "One is the essence of the beginningless Godhead!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оуви́нꙋ дре́внюю кля́твꙋ, Хв҃а ро́жши Мт҃и чт҃ая, пресвѣ́тло разори́ла есѝ, и́же всѣ́хъ вѣнча́ющаго бл҃гослове́ньми, нѣ́сть бо Прчт҃ая, ра́звѣ тебе́ помо́щницы.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́кѡ сꙋдїи пра́веднѣйшемꙋ нн҃ѣ припада́ю ти, Гди: ѡсꙋжде́ный ѿ ча́лнаго мя ѡсꙋжде́нїя: и пра́веднаго си изба́ви ѡсꙋжде́нїя, исто́чнїи изсра́нный сподо́би.
items.english_cohort_translation: As before the most righteous Judge, I now fall down before Thee, O Lord: deliver me who am condemned from condemnation of despair, and free me from Thy righteous judgment, making me worthy of the fountain of Thine elect.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ разбо́йники впа́дша не ѹ́зри́тъ ѻни́тъ, чл҃колю́бче: и́ ѹязве́нна ѕлы́ми исцѣлѝ, Хѐ: возанїая на́ма покая́нїа винѡ̀ и́ єле́й: и́ ѡблецы̀ мя ѡ́деждею спасенїа.
items.english_cohort_translation: Look upon me, O Lover of mankind, who have fallen among thieves; and heal me who am wounded by evil deeds, O Christ, pouring out for me the wine and oil of repentance, and clothe me with the garment of salvation.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: ...ѡбликова́втеся съвы́шше ри́зою зна́менїа, въ совлече́ніи телесе́м, прихва́лныи Мꙋ́нцїи, и говле́юшаго пре́жде пра́ѡтца ѡбнажи́сте, въздыха́нїа ме́ртва сотво́ривше.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* Clothed from on high with the robe of distinction in the stripping off of your bodies, O praiseworthy Martyrs, ye stripped bare him who of old puffed up our forefather, making his sighs dead.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вѣ́твꙋюще пре́бъзако́ннымъ мꙋ́ченници Бж҃їѧ Сло́ва ра́зꙋмомъ бл҃гоче́стїѧ ѹкраша́еми, мꙋ́дрецѣ и въсѣ́тѧх погрази́сте, нечести́вющїя и враго́в ѹглажда́ющї.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* Flourishing before the lawless, O Martyrs, adorned with the understanding of the Word of God and with piety, ye wise ones submerged the ungodly in snares and silenced the enemies.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Па́тъ ꙗ́коже до́ждь премо́рсти бе́здна, Іс҃ сни́де, еди́нꙋ чт҃ꙋю тебѐ ѡбрѣ́тъ, Кгороди́тельнице, Дв҃о, и заградѝ нече́стїа пото́ки лю́тыѧ, Бж҃твенною бл҃года́тїю.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Like rain dropping into the deep of wisdom, Jesus descended, finding Thee alone pure, O Virgin Mother of God, and by divine grace He stemmed the fierce torrents of impiety.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́нъ: Ірмо́съ то́йже. Непостижи́мом си́лою, ѡ невѣ́стїа приклѣ̀ есѝ не́мныѧ ѹ́мы, Сло́ве Бж҃їи пребл҃гїи: и неизрече́нною сла́вою просвѣти́ есѝ, тебѣ̀ зовꙋ́щих: сла́ва, Хѐ, си́лѣ твое́й.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Another Canon. Same Heirmos.* By Thine incomprehensible power, O Word of God, All-good One, Thou didst incline the celestial minds from non-existence, and didst enlighten them with ineffable glory, as they cry unto Thee: "Glory to Thy power, O Christ!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оправлѧ́еми вы́шшаѧ си́лы дх҃о́мъ, и бл҃года́ми его̀, и Бж҃твенными заря́ми шелестя́еми, не ѡпада́ющїа чи́ны наслѣ́доваша, єди́но чт҃ꙋще всѣ́хъ начало и Бж҃тво.
items.english_cohort_translation: Guided by the Spirit and His grace, and rustling with divine rays, the exalted Powers inherited non-falling ranks, honoring the one Principle and Godhead of all.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Лица̀ твое́го добротꙋ̀ преяснꙋю зрѣ́ти сподо́бишася, слꙋжи́тельнаѧ ти свѣ́тлости, и ѡ ѻ́нюдꙋ разꙋмѣ́нїѧ прїемлюще, тебѣ̀ вопїютъ: сла́ва, Хр́те, си́лѣ твое́й.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thy ministrant radiances were accounted worthy to behold the most-clear beauty of Thy face, and receiving understanding from thence, they cry unto Thee: "Glory to Thy power, O Christ!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, є҃. Ірмо́съ: Нн҃ѣ воста́нꙋ, прр́чески речѐ, Бг҃: нн҃ѣ просла́влюся, нн҃ѣ вознесу́ся, па́дшаго воспрїи́мъ ѡдѣ́вы: и къ свѣ́тꙋ чꙋ́дному вознесу̀ моего̀ Бж҃тва̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* "Now will I arise," prophetically says God; "now will I be glorified; now will I be exalted, taking up him who fell from the Virgin, and I will lift him up unto the marvelous light of My Godhead."

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́кѡ ѡ́сꙋжде́нъ, тебѣ̀ еди́номꙋ сꙋдїи, сп҃се, и́мам предста́ти: и ше́лче бы́ти ѡ всѣ́хъ злы́хъ, и́же ве́сьма согрѣши́хъ во́лею, и всего̀ себѐ ѡскверни́хъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: As one condemned, I must stand before Thee, the only Judge, O Savior, and give an account of all the evil things wherein I have sinned utterly of my own will, and defiled myself entirely.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Спаси́ мя, Гди, ꙗ́кѡ ѕѡлъ, испо́лнихъся мно́гих: исцѣли́ молюся, неможе́нїа моѧ̀, и гнѣ́вїа лю́таѧ, и неѡста́ви по гнѣ́вꙋ ти мя єдина́го, Ісѐ мо́й, мно́гѡ ти согрѣши́вшаго.
items.english_cohort_translation: Save me, O Lord, for I am filled with many evils; heal, I pray Thee, my infirmities and fierce wrath, and do not abandon me alone according to Thy wrath, O my Jesus, who have sinned greatly against Thee.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кончи́нꙋ бл҃же́ннꙋю, страда́лци ѡбрѣто́ша нб҃ѣ, сла́вꙋ ѹлꙋчи́ша, Хр́та̀ прославля́юще свои́ми ѹ́ды, страстополо́жника, ра́намъ и ꙗ́звамъ причаща́тїеся мꙋ́жески предразсужда́юще.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* The Martyrs found a blessed end and obtained glory in heaven, glorifying Christ their combat-master with their limbs, courageously partaking beforehand in wounds and stripes.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бога́тство не́ное, житїемъ Боже́ственнымъ и кра́снымъ, вѣ́нцемъ не ѹвѧда́емымъ, и свѣ́тъ невече́рнїй, и жили́ще ника́коже ѡбещава́емое, не рꙋкотворе́нно наслѣ́довасте: стра́да́лци, Хвы̑ бл҃же́ннїи.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* O blessed Sufferers of Christ: by your divine and fair life, with the unfading crown, the unwaning light, and the dwelling not made with hands, which cannot be shaken, ye have inherited the heavenly riches.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Твоя̀ чꙋдеса̀, Прр́честїи прореко́ша гла́сы, го́рꙋ нарица́юще тѧ, Прчт҃ая, и две́рь, и свѣти́лника свѣ́телъ: и́з него́же вои́стиннꙋ, свѣ́тъ чꙋ́дный просвѣща́етъ, чт҃ая, мі́ръ ве́сь.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Prophetic voices foretold thy wonders, calling thee, O Most-pure One, the Mountain, the Gate, and the luminous Candlestick, from whence in truth the marvelous Light enlightens the whole world, O pure Lady!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́нъ: Ірмо́съ то́йже. Трїпе́тно сла́вятъ Херꙋві́ми, и Серафі́ми со Престо́лы: и Бже́ственнїи Арха́ггли, и Гдⷭ҇ьствїа, и Си́лы, и Нача́ла, и Вла́сти со А́гглы: че́стное єди́но и Тро́ическое Бж҃тво.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Another Canon. Same Heirmos.* With trembling the Cherubim and Seraphim together with the Thrones glorify Thee, and the divine Archangels, Dominions, Powers, Principalities, and Authorities together with the Angels: the honorable, single, and Triune Godhead.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вы́шша А́ггли свѣтовидно ꙗ́вльше, Хѐ, твоѐ Воскресе́ніе, проповѣ́дающе Прпⷣбнымъ жена́м, и вра́га ко́й сокруша́юще ѹ́мъ, блиста́нїями твое́го Бж҃тва̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: The most-exalted Angels, having appeared in radiant form, O Christ, proclaiming Thy Resurrection unto the venerable women, and crushing the mind of the enemy with the flashes of Thy Godhead.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Нн҃ѣ сохрани́ ѡполче́нїем Арха́нгелскымъ цр҃ковь свою̀, тебѣ̀ сла́вящꙋ праводѣ́льными гла́сы, и́же ѡ Дв҃ы неизрече́нно рожде́нся, и чл҃вки ѡ зла̀ избавле́ѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Now preserve Thy Church by the encampment of the Archangels, as she glorifies Thee with orthodox voices, O Thou Who wast ineffably born of the Virgin, and deliverest mankind from evil.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. Ірмо́съ. Прїидо́хъ во глубинꙋ морскꙋю, и потопѝ мя бꙋ́ря мно́гихъ прегрѣше́нїй: но ꙗ́кѡ, Бг҃ъ, ѡ нетлѣ́нїя возведѝ жи́знь мою̀, многомлⷭ҇тиве.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* I came into the deep of the sea, and the tempest of many transgressions overwhelmed me; but as God, lead up my life from corruption, O Plenteous in mercy!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ме́ртвъ сы́й неразꙋ́мїю, нечꙋ́вствꙋх ѡкая́нный, и́ совѣ́тъ ѡскверни́хъ ногъ пр́но. Бже, созда́выи мя, да не до конца̀ погꙋ́биши мя.
items.english_cohort_translation: Being dead in mind and unfeeling, wretch that I am, I ever defiled the counsel of my feet. O God Who didst create me, destroy me not utterly!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дѣ́янїа моѧ̀ хотя́тъ ще́дре, младе́нцы твое́м ꙗ́коже врази, ѡ́клевета́ти мя, ѡ ни́хъ же Хѐ, ско́рѡ изба́ви мя: наста́вляѧ мя къ покая́нїю.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Compassionate One, my deeds are ready to slander me like enemies before Thy child; therefore, O Christ, deliver me swiftly from them, guiding me unto repentance.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сокрꙋши́ ко́сти страстоно́сецъ, собо́ръ законопрестꙋ́пный: но не сокрушѝ тѣ́хъ вѣ́рꙋ. Е́яже ра́ди наслѣ́дници ꙗви́шася, Бг҃ꙋ, и сп҃сꙋ дꙋ́шъ на́ши.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* The lawless assembly crushed the bones of the Passion-bearers, but crushed not their faith, for the sake whereof they appeared as heirs unto God and the Savior of our souls.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́кѡ че́стное ка́менїе, на ка́мени непоколе́блемѣ, Бг҃омꙋ́дренно назда́шася страстоно́сцы. И ꙗ́ко хра́мы Ст҃а́го Дх҃а, въ цр҃ко Бг҃ꙋ, водврꙋзи́шася.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* Like precious stones upon an immovable rock, the Passion-bearers were divinely built up, and were established as temples of the Holy Spirit in the Church of God.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Премꙋ́дростїю свое́ю сотвори́въ А́ггльскїа ли́ки, Гдⷭ҇тва же и Си́лы и Серафі́мы, ꙗ́кѡ Влⷪ҇ка, показа́лъ есѝ, хва́лими тѧ въ чꙋдесѣ́хъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having created the angelic choirs by Thy wisdom, the Dominions, Powers, and Seraphim, Thou hast shown them forth as Master, praised in wonders.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́кѡ на престо́лѣхъ превознесе́нныхъ, Хѐ, почива́юща маннꙋ: и вся́ческая Бж҃твеннымъ про́мысло соблюдаѧ, нару́кꙋ Влчⷪ҇ко Дѣ́вческою почи́лъ есѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* O Master Christ, resting upon exalted thrones, and preserving all things by divine providence: Thou didst rest as manna upon the virgin arms of the Maiden.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, з҃. Ірмо́съ: Ю́ноша трїе ко Вавѵло́нѣ, повелѣ́нїе мꙋчи́телево, на ѹби́йство преложи́ша, и посредѣ̀ ѻ́гня вопїя́хꙋ: бл҃гвенъ есѝ, Гди, Бже, ѡ́цъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 7. Heirmos:* The three children in Babylon turned the tyrant's command into foolishness, and in the midst of the fire they cried aloud: "Blessed art Thou, O Lord, God of our fathers!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Комꙋ тѧ̀ ѹподо́блю, ѹ́вы̀ мнѣ̀, дꙋше ѡкая́нная, лю́бѧщи бѣзомѣ́стнаѧ, а́ не добраѧ возлю́бдющи, тѣ́мже, пре́жде конца̀ потщи́ся, ѡ́бразы бл҃гїя показа́вати.
items.english_cohort_translation: Unto whom shall I liken thee, woe is me, O wretched soul, loving unbecoming things and not loving the good? Therefore, before the end, hasten to show forth good examples.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тꙋчꙋ ми, Хѐ, сле́зъ да́жд, ꙗ́кѡ да ѡ лю́тыхъ мои́хъ измы́юся: и неѡста́ви менѐ, Сп҃се, поги́бнꙋти, согрѣши́вша тѝ мно́го па́че чл҃ка.
items.english_cohort_translation: Grant me a shower of tears, O Christ, that I may wash away my fierce offenses; and leave me not to perish, O Savior, who have sinned against Thee far more than any man.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ме́ртвость ѹмерщвле́ннаго сло́ва нося́ще на тѣ́лѣ свое́мъ, прелесть ѹ́мертви́сте, живѣ́те же и́ ѹме́рше, сла́внїи: и́ ѡ́умерщвле́ныя страстьми страда́льци врачꙋ́ете.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* Bearing in your body the mortification of the slain Word, ye put deceit to death; and though dead, O glorious ones, ye live, and heal those slain by passions, O Martyrs!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ко́е мѣ́сто нн҃ѣ неи́ма Мꙋ́нцїи, просвѣти́телеи ва́съ, и́ предра́дїе; ка́я страна́ не ѡ́сщ҃е́етъся ва́шими страда́ньми сла́вныи, и́ во́токами исцѣле́нїй;
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* What place doth not now possess you as enlighteners and protectors, O Martyrs? What land is not sanctified by your sufferings, O glorious ones, and by the torrents of your healings?

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Єди́на пребыва́еши и́ по рождествѣ̀ Блчⷪ҇це, дѣ́вственною добро́тою сїя́ющи: еди́на ма́терскихъ не вѣ́де болѣ́зней, Бг҃а бо еди́на роди́ла есѝ, изба́вителя дꙋша́мъ на́шимъ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́нъ. Ірмо́съ то́йже. Свѣти́телѧ содѣ́ланны имꙋ́щи, мы́сльныѧ А́гглы, изверго́мъ чи́сто житїѐ, вопїю́ще: бл҃женъ есѝ Гди, Бже ѡ́цъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having been made lights, the spiritual Angels led a pure life, crying aloud: "Blessed art Thou, O Lord, God of our fathers!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: О́глемъ ѡчꙋще́на, Прⷭ҇то́лъ твое́мꙋ Серафі́ми зря́тъ предстоя́ща, Бж҃твенный вопїя́ше Исїа́а: бл҃гвенъ есѝ Гди, Бже ѡ́цъ на́шихъ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Чи́ны безпло́тныхъ Дв҃о, ꙗ́ко превосхо́диши, Сн҃а бо тво́рца ро́жши и Гда, бл҃гвена Прчт҃ая пло́дъ твое́го чре́ва.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* As Thou surpassest the ranks of the Bodiless Powers, O Virgin, having given birth unto the Son and Lord the Creator: blessed art Thou, O Most-pure Lady, and blessed is the Fruit of Thy womb!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, и҃. Ірмо́съ: Изба́вителю всѣ́хъ всеси́лне, посредѣ̀ пла́мене бл҃гоче́ствова́вшаѧ, соше́дъ ѡ́роси́лъ есѝ, и научѝ пѣ́ти: вся̑ дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇ня Гдⷭ҇а по́йте, и превозноси́те его̀ въ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 8. Heirmos:[^174]* O Almighty Deliverer of all: descending into the midst of the flame, Thou didst bedew the pious ones, and didst teach them to sing: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him unto all ages!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вкꙋ́пѣ со ско́тѡмъ ѹподо́бле́н, покори́въся безслове́снымъ стра́стемъ, Сло́ве Бж҃їй пребезна́чалне, ѡ́брати́въ мя̀ спасѝ, вопїю́ща: бл҃гвте вся̑ дѣла̀ Гдⷭ҇ня Гдⷭ҇а, по́йте и превозноси́те его̀ въвся вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: Lassoed together with beasts, having submitted to irrational passions, O Word of God, transcendent and beginningless: turn me and save me as I cry: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him unto all ages!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ зо́лъ ве́прь, позоба̀ єди́нокъ мя, Сп҃се, ꙗ́коже виногра́дъ воздѣ́ланный Дх҃омъ, шни́хъ же избави́ мя Сло́ве, и пло́доно́сна добродѣ́тельми мя покажѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The wild boar of evils hath devoured me alone, O Savior, like a vineyard cultivated by the Spirit; deliver me from it, O Word, and show me forth fruitful in virtues.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сщ҃е́нное Мꙋ́нникѡвъ сосло́вїе, не сщ҃енное раздра́ши собра́нїе, беззаконо́вати повелѣва́ющее, и зако́нно пострада́въ, ѡ Влⷪ҇ки всѣ́хъ зако́нно вѣнча́ся.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* The holy company of the Martyrs dissolved the unholy gathering that commanded them to act lawlessly; and having suffered lawfully, they were lawfully crowned by the Master of all.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́нъ: Ірмо́съ то́йже. Ꙗ́кѡ сі́и живо́тъ всесме́ртный, безсме́ртномꙋ живо́тꙋ причаща́тїеся зижди́телеве сотвори́лъ есѝ А́гглы, и́ навꙋчѝ пѣ́ти: вся̑ дѣла̀ Гна Гда по́йте, и́ превозноси́те его̀ вове́кї въ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: As partakers of immortal life, O Creator, Thou didst make the Angels to share in this deathless life, and didst teach them to sing: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him unto all ages!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ми́лно всепою́ще тѧ Арха́ггли, непреста́нными гла́сы возыва́ю, Бг҃олѣ́пно чтꙋ́ще тѧ ꙗ́ко Влⷪ҇кꙋ всѣ́х: вся̑ дѣла̀ Гна Гда по́йте, и́ превозноси́те его̀ вове́кї въ вѣ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Lovingly chanting hymns unto Thee, the Archangels cry with unceasing voices, divinely honoring Thee as Master of all: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him unto all ages!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Зако́нныѧ проѡбража́хꙋ тѧ ѡ́бразы, ро́ждшꙋю Бг҃а всебл҃же́ннаѧ, ве́щи плотетстѣй соединя́ема, и́же пре́жде невеще́ственное сꙋ́щество Бж҃твенное, бл҃гви Дв҃о, ржтво̀ твоѐ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. Ірмо́съ. Еѵ́ва ѹ́бо недꙋ́го преслꙋша́нїа, кля́твꙋ всели́ла е́стъ: ты́же, Дво Бц҃е, рожде́нства твое́го прозябе́нїемъ, мі́рови бл҃гве́нїе процвѣла̀ есѝ. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ всѝ велича́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 9. Heirmos:[^175]* Eve indeed, through the disease of disobedience, brought in the curse; but thou, O Virgin Theotokos, through the blossoming of thy childbearing, didst bud forth blessing unto the world. Therefore we all magnify thee.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѐ покая́нїа вре́мѧ, дꙋше моя̀, что̀ лѣни́шися; что̀ сно́мъ ѡ́тягча́ешися; ѹ́ны́нїа да ѡстꙋ́пимъ, ѹ́кра́симъ свѣщꙋ̀, ꙗ́коже пи́шетъ, є́леомъ бл҃готворе́нїа, да не ста́немъ внѣ̀ ѹ́дꙋ двере́й, рыда́юще.
items.english_cohort_translation: Behold, the time of repentance, O my soul! Why art thou idle? Why art thou weighed down with sleep? Let us cast off despondency, let us adorn our lamp with the oil of good deeds, as it is written, lest we stand outside the doors weeping!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: До́ндеже е́стъ вре́мѧ пока́ятисѧ, ѡ́брати́ся ѡ зо́лъ свои́хъ и́хже содѣ́яла есѝ, вѣ́дѣнїемъ, дꙋ́ше моя̀, и невѣ́дѣнїемъ, и возопїй, къ и́же вся̑ вѣ́дꙋщемꙋ: Согрѣши́хъ простѝ, Влⷪ҇ко, и́ негнѣва́ися менѐ недосто́йнаго.
items.english_cohort_translation: While there is yet time to repent, turn away from the evils thou hast committed, knowingly and unknowingly, O my soul, and cry aloud unto Him Who knows all things: "I have sinned! Forgive me, O Master, and be not angry with me, who am unworthy!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Собра̀ Хс҃, страда́вшїа ст҃ы́я ꙗвле́ннѣйше, ѡ вся́кїа страны́ и гра́да намѣ́стїа сла́внаѧ, и во че́стнаѧ поко́ищи, и́ нн҃ѣ перво ро́дныхъ Цр҃ковь просвѣща́ютъ веселя́щеся.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* Christ gathered the holy Sufferers from every land and glorious city into honorable resting-places, and now they joyfully enlighten the Church of the firstborn.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Всече́стнаѧ ра́ка чт҃ныхъ мꙋ́нк твои́хъ, лꙋча́ми Бж҃твеннаго Дх҃а ѡ́заря́ема пресла́внѣ, исцѣле́нїа нескꙋ́днетъ свѣ́тло: и́ ра́зарѧ́етъ недꙋ́гѡмъ помраче́нїе: Гди, єди́не многомлⷭ҇тиве.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* The all-honorable shrine of Thy precious Martyrs, being gloriously irradiated with the rays of the Holy Spirit, beams forth healings abundantly and dispels the darkness of disease, O Lord, only Plenteous in mercy!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́нъ, Ірмо́съ: Та́йна Бж҃твенная, Прчт҃ая въ тебѣ̀, соверша́етъся, ꙗ́вленно та́инство, Дв҃о прчт҃ая. И́бо Бг҃а и́стебѐ вопло́тїел за милосе́рдїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: A divine mystery is accomplished in Thee, O most-pure Virgin; for God was incarnate of Thee through tender mercy. Therefore we magnify Thee as the Mother of God.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кра́сно ѹдобра́еми, нетлѣ́нїа да́ромъ и́ бл҃года́тїю, Бж҃твенныи Арха́ггли: тебѣ̀ исто́чникꙋ Хѐ, принотекꙋ́ща Бгонача́лїа, пою́ще ꙗ́кѡ бл҃года́теля, велича́ютъ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кто̀ не ѹ́дивле́етъ ся зря́ ст҃ы́и Мꙋ́нци, подви́га добра́го и́мже подвиза́стеся, ка́кѡ во пло́ти сꙋ́ще, безпло́тнаго вра́га побѣди́сте; Ха̀, исповѣ́дающе, и́ Кр́томъ воѡрꙋжи́вшеся. Тѣ́мже досто́йно ꙗ́ви́стеся, бѣсѡ́въ прогони́телїе, и́ ва́рварѡ побѣди́тели, непреста́нно моля́щеся, спасти́ся дꙋша́ на́ши.
items.english_cohort_translation: Who would not marvel, beholding the good fight wherein ye contended, O holy Martyrs? How, being in the flesh, did ye vanquish the bodiless foe, confessing Christ and arming yourselves with the Cross? Therefore ye were worthily revealed as expellers of demons and conquerors of barbarians, unceasingly praying that our souls may be saved.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дре́ва ра́ди, Ада́м, рая бы́сть изгна́нъ: дре́ва же ра́ди Кр́тнаго, разбо́йникъ въ Ра́и всели́ся. Ѻ́въ ѹ́бѡ вкꙋ́шъ, за́повѣдь престꙋпѝ сотво́ршаго ѝ: Ѻ́вже, сраспина́яся, Бг҃а тѧ исповѣ́да та́ющагося, Помянѝ мя вопїя̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Through the tree Adam was cast out of Paradise; but through the tree of the Cross the thief dwelt in Paradise. For the one, having tasted, transgressed the commandment of Him Who made him; but the other, being crucified with Thee, confessed Thee as the hidden God, crying aloud: "Remember me in Thy kingdom!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Егда̀ прїи́деши въсꙋди́ти си́це, па́че всѣ́хъ чл҃къ на зе́мли а́зъ согрѣши́хъ: и́ бо́яся та́мѡ нелицемѣ́рнаго сꙋди́ща, на не́мже, неосꙋжде́нна мя соблюдѝ тогда̀ пребл҃гїи: и́ ѡ мꙋ́ки изба́ви, пода́й мѝ покаѧ́нїе, ѡмыва́ющее вели́кїя скве́рны, ꙗ́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: When Thou comest to judge thus, I who have sinned on earth more than all men, and fear the unbribable judgment-seat there: preserve me then uncondemned, O All-good One, and deliver me from torment, granting me repentance that washes away great defilements, as Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Херꙋві́ми, и́ Серафі́ми, Вла́сти, Престо́ли, Арха́ггли, Гдⷭ҇ьства всякꙋ́ю и́ Си́лы, Ст҃їи А́ггли, Нача́ла высоча́йшая: Блч҃кꙋ, всѣ́хъ нн҃ѣ пре́стоѧ́ще: согрѣше́нїй ѡставле́нїа, и́ житїю̀ направле́нїа, испроси́те всѣ́мъ вопїю́щимъ вѣ́рно: Помянѝ на́съ въ црⷭ҇твїи си.
items.english_cohort_translation: Cherubim and Seraphim, Authorities, Thrones, Archangels, Dominions, and all Powers, holy Angels, and most exalted Principalities: now standing before the Master of all, entreat remission of transgressions and direction of life for all who faithfully cry: "Remember us in Thy kingdom!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Приме́кшающїисѧ ѻ́гню, хвра́стїю пре́лесть попали́сте, ст҃рто- но́сци Хвы̑, и́ мно́жествомъ ва́шея кро́ве, главна́го ѕмїя шни́дъ всехва́лныи ѹдави́сте: побѣ́дꙋ взе́мше, съвы́шними во́инстваи ра́дꙋетеся, моля́щеся приле́жно, спасти́ся на́м.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having approached the fire, ye burned up deceit as brushwood, O holy Passion-bearers of Christ; and with the multitude of your blood, O all-lauded ones, ye choked the ancient serpent; having taken the victory, ye rejoice with the hosts on high, praying earnestly that we may be saved.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Трисли́чнаѧ за́ре, и́же въ мі́рскїи сїя́ющаѧ испо́лненїяхъ, дꙋ́ша мое́ѧ лю́таѧ ѡгна́вши стра́сти: низпосли́ мнѣ̀ свѣ́та сїя́нїе и́ ѡчище́нїе, и́же вѣ́рою нн҃ѣ зовꙋ́щꙋ: безнача́льномꙋ роди́телю, Сн҃ꙋ сопресто́льнꙋ, и́ Дх҃ꙋ. Тро́ице вседѣ́телнаѧ си́ло, спаси́ на.
items.english_cohort_translation: O three-sunned Radiance shining in the fullness of the world: having driven away the fierce passions of my soul, send down upon me the illumination of light and cleansing, unto me who now cry in faith: Unto the beginningless Father, the co-enthroned Son, and the Spirit: O Trinity, all-creating Power, save us!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Согрѣша́ющаго пр́но, и́ лѣ́ностїю всего̀ содерж́има: ѡ́чи́сти рн чт҃ая, и́ покаѧ́нїя ѡ́бразы ѹдо́бри, да́ющи ѹмиле́нїе, недовѣ́ннѣи дꙋ́ши мое́и, Пречт҃ая, наде́жде непосты́днаѧ, и́же любо́вїю пою́щихъ тѧ, и́ вопїю́щихъ вѣ́рно: Помянѝ и́ на́съ Дв҃о всепѣ́тая.
items.english_cohort_translation: Cleanse me who sin evermore and am wholly held fast by slothfulness, O pure Lady, and adorn me with forms of repentance, granting compunction unto my humble soul, O Most-pure One, unashamed hope of those who lovingly praise thee, and who faithfully cry aloud: Remember us also, O all-hymned Virgin!

items.section: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.day_or_date: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":[^176]
items.english_cohort_translation: I ought ever to remember the last hour of my departure, and the coming of the Angels, and the assaults of demonic thoughts; but the enemy, casting into my mind the fall of my intellect, ever entices me deceitfully unto worse things. O Lord, before I perish utterly, save me!

items.section: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.day_or_date: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":[^176]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: До́лженъ е́смь всегда̀ помина́ти, послѣ́днїи ча́съ исхо́да моего́, и́ А́гглѡвъ прише́ствїе, и́ бѣ́вскаго же помышле́нїи нахожде́нїа: но вра́гъ паде́нїе ѹма̀ моего̀ е́мꙋ вълага́я, всегда̀ на го́ршая привлека́етъ мя льсти́внѣ. Гди, да́же въ коне́цъ не поги́бнꙋ, спаси́ мя.
items.english_cohort_translation: It behooves me ever to keep in mind the fearful judgment-seat to keep in mind, O Lord, Thy judgment-seat: how shall I stand before Thy throne, having not kept Thy commandments, nor a single ordinance, and unable to tear away evil thoughts? But as Thou Thyself knowest, grant me amendment, and save me!

items.section: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.day_or_date: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":[^176]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мгла̀ покрыва́етъ мя грѣхо́внаѧ: волна̀ скве́рныхъ бы́ко помышле́нїй: бꙋ́ря смꙋща́етъ мя страсте́й, и́ поги́бели предае́тъ: но ꙗ́кѡ тво́рецъ мо́й и́ содѣ́тель, и́ млⷭ҇тивый Бг҃ъ мо́й и́ Гдⷭ҇ь: изба́ви мя бꙋ́дꙋщыѧ бѣды̀ и́ ско́рбїи.
items.english_cohort_translation: The gloom of sin covers me, a wave of vile thoughts, a tempest of passions troubles me and betrays me to destruction; but as my Creator and Maker, and my merciful God and Lord, deliver me from future calamity and affliction!

items.section: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.day_or_date: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":[^176]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Имѣ́яй къ Гдⷭ҇ꙋ дерзнове́ніе, рожде́нныхъ жена́ми всѣ́хъ Пре́ди́тече превосходя́й: того̀ мл҃и непреста́нно, ѡ и́же вѣ́рою молѧ́щихъ тѧ ся. Ѡбраще́нїе на́ да́ти, ѡ́бразы покая́нїа, ꙗ́ко да тѧ̀ воспѣва́е спаса́еми всегда̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having boldness toward the Lord, O Forerunner who surpassest all born of women: unceasingly pray unto Him for those who in faith entreat thee, to give us conversion and forms of repentance, that being ever saved, we may praise thee.

provenance.verbatim_source: Having boldness toward the Lord, O Forerunner who surpassest all born of women: unceasingly pray unto Him for those who in faith entreat thee, to give us conversion and forms of repentance, that being ever saved, we may praise thee.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.day_or_date: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":[^176]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Нарече́нъ бы́стъ Прр́къ ѡ ложесн, и́ ѡ ѹтро́бы проповѣ́дникъ, Прт҃че и́ А́пле прише́ствїя Гн҃я. Бѣсѡ́м ѹ́бо преда́нна мя сꙋ́ща: и грѣхꙋ̀ раба̀ многодѣ́нственна: ѡ ѡ́бои́хъ мя испра́ви, ꙗ́кѡ крⷭ҇ти́ти конꙋ́ъ, да твоѐ ско́рое проповѣ́дꙋю застꙋпле́ніе.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou wast named a Prophet from the womb, and a preacher from the belly, O Forerunner and Apostle of the Lord's coming. Unto demons am I surrendered, and a slave unto many sins: set me upright from both, as thou didst baptize the Lord, that I may proclaim Thy swift protection.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.day_or_date: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":[^176]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Лопа́та сы́й, Дх҃а Бж҃твеннаго, плевелови́днаѧ нра́вы, развѣ́й ѡ срца моего̀, дѣѧ́нїа Бж҃твеннаѧ ѡ менѐ собира́я, ꙗ́коже пшени́цꙋ въ жи́тницꙋ Бж҃їю. ꙗ́кѡ да пи́ща Влч҃цѣ бл҃гопотрѣ́бна бꙋ́дꙋ, поко́и хо́дотлѣ̀ ѡ́богаща́емъ, Хв҃ъ Крⷭ҇ти́телю бл҃же́нне.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou art the winnowing-fan of the Divine Spirit: blow away the tare-like manners from my heart, gathering the divine deeds from me, as wheat into the granary of God, that I may be acceptable food unto the Master, enriched with eternal rest, O blessed Baptist of Christ!

items.section: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED"
items.day_or_date: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":[^176]
items.english_cohort_translation: Grant me tears from the heart, and sighing from the deep, O Maiden, and contrition of soul, and the forgiveness of transgressions committed by me in life, that by thy help I may pass through this life in peace, and attain everlasting rejoicing.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.day_or_date: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":[^176]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Хотѣ́хъ слеза́ми, ѡмы́ти мои́хъ согрѣше́нїй, Гди, рꙋкописа́нїе, и́ про́чее живота̀ моего̀, покая́нїемъ бл҃гоꙋгоди́ти тебѣ̀: но вра́гъ льсти́тъ мя, и́ бо́ретъ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀: Гди, пре́ждеда́же до конца̀ не поги́бнꙋ, спаси́ мя.
items.english_cohort_translation: With tears I desired to wash away the handwriting of my transgressions, O Lord, and for the rest of my life to be well-pleasing unto Thee through repentance; but the enemy beguiles me, and battles against my soul. O Lord, before I perish utterly, save me!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.day_or_date: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":[^176]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кто̀ ѡ́бꙋрева́емъ, и́ притѣка́ѧ къ приста́нищꙋ семꙋ, не спасе́тся; илѝ кто̀ болѣ́знꙋѧ, и́ припада́я къ враче́вствꙋ семꙋ, неисцѣлѣва́етъ; содѣ́телю всѧ́ческимъ, и́ врачꙋ недꙋ́жнымъ: Гди, пре́ждеда́же до конца̀ не поги́бнꙋ, спаси́ мя.
items.english_cohort_translation: Who that is tempest-tossed and flees unto this harbor is not saved? Or who that is sick and falls down before this remedy is not healed? O Creator of all, and Physician of the sick: O Lord, before I perish utterly, save me!

items.day_or_date: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":[^176]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́же ст҃ы́хъ Мꙋ́ннкъ прїе́мый терпѣ́ніе: и́ ѡ на́съ прїими́ пѣ́нїе, чл҃колю́бче: и́ да́рꙋй на́мъ тѣ́хъ мл҃твами, ве́лїю мл҃ть.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Thou Who didst accept the endurance of the holy Martyrs: receive from us also our singing, O Lover of mankind, and grant us their prayers and great mercy.

items.day_or_date: ON MONDAY EVENING, AT "LORD, I HAVE CRIED":[^176]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Изба́ви на́съ ѡ бѣ́дъ на́шихъ, Мт҃и Ха̀ Бг҃а: ро́ждшаѧ всѣмъ тво́рца, да всѝ вопїемъ тѝ: Ра́дꙋйся, еди́на предста́телнице дꙋша́мъ на́шимъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Deliver us from our afflictions, O Mother of Christ God, who didst bear the Creator of all, that we all may cry unto Thee: Rejoice, the only protectress of our souls!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Смире́ннꙋю дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀ посѣтѝ Гди, Гди, и́же въ грѣсѣ́хъ житїѐ всѐ ижди́вшꙋ, ꙗ́коже блꙋ́дницꙋ прїими́ и́ мене́, и́ сп҃си́ мя.
items.english_cohort_translation: Visit my humble soul, O Lord, which hath spent its whole life in sins; receive me as the harlot, and save me.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Преплава́я пꙋчи́нꙋ настоя́щаго житїѧ: помышля́ю бе́зднꙋ мно́гихъ мои́хъ зо́лъ, и́ неимы́я ко́рмчаго помышле́нїямъ: Петро́въ привѣ́щева́ю ти гла́съ: спаси́ мя, Хѐ, спаси́ мя, ꙗ́кѡ чл҃колю́бецъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Crossing the deep of the present life, I contemplate the abyss of my many evils, and having no helmsman for my thoughts, with the voice of Peter I cry unto Thee: Save me, O Christ, save me, as Thou art the Lover of mankind!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́коже всѣ́мъ вои́стиннꙋ, Бца, моля́щи ся содерзнове́нїе Сн҃ꙋ своему, и́ Бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ, ꙗ́кѡ Мт҃и: сохрани́ти гра́, изря́дно къ покро́вꙋ твое́мꙋ притѣка́ющїи, ѡ тебѣ́ держа́вꙋ имꙋ́щїи: и́ ктебѣ́ прибѣга́ющїи, пристанни́щꙋ и́ стѣнѣ́, еди́но предста́телницїи ро́дꙋ чл҃вѣческомꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: As Thou art truly the Mother of God, praying with boldness unto Thy Son and our God, as His Mother: preserve the city, especially those who run unto Thy protection, who have Thee as their dominion, and who flee unto Thee, the harbor and rampart, the only protectress of the human race.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мгло́ю страсте́й, и́ жите́йскими блѧдьми, помрача́емъ ѹ́мъ ѡкая́ныя мѝ дꙋшї, и́ помы́сла покаѧ́нїа нѣ́стъ въ мнѣ̀: но ѹ́щедри Сп҃се и́ менѐ ѡкая́наго, и́ да́ждъ мѝ по́мыслъ ѹмиле́нїя, да́на́хъ спаса́ем, пре́жде конца̀ вопїю̀, бл҃гоꙋтро́бїю твое́мꙋ, Гди, Хѐ, Сп҃се мо́й, ѹѿча́ннаго спаси́ мя, и́ недосто́йнаго.
items.english_cohort_translation: My mind is darkened by the gloom of passions and worldly vanities, wretch that I am, and there is no thought of repentance in me; but have compassion, O Savior, on me the wretched, and grant me thoughts of compunction, that being saved, before the end I may cry unto Thy tender mercy: O Lord, Christ, my Savior, save me who am despairing and unworthy!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ско́рѡ совни́демъ въ невѣ́стни Хв҃ъ, да всѝ ѹслы́шимъ блаже́нный гла́съ, Ха̀ Бг҃а на́шегѡ: Прїидѣ́те лю́бѧщїи нбⷭ҇нꙋю сла́вꙋ: и́ прїими́те сїю̀ вкꙋ́пѣ съ мꙋ́дрыми Дѣ́вами: просвѣти́вше свѣ́ща ваша вѣ́рою.
items.english_cohort_translation: Let us swiftly enter into the Bridal Chamber of Christ, that we all may hear the blessed voice of Christ our God: "Come, ye who love heavenly glory, and receive it together with the wise virgins, having enlightened your lamps with faith!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кр́томъ воѡрꙋже́нни ст҃ртоно́сци твоѝ, побѣди́ша козно́ванїа началозло́бнаго вра́га, Хѐ Бж҃е на́шъ, прогна́ша ꙗ́кѡ свѣти́ла, земны́хъ наста́вляющи: и́ даю́тъ исцѣле́нїа, и́же вѣ́рою прося́щимъ. Тѣ́хъ мл҃твами, спаси́ дꙋша́ на́ша.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* Armed with the Cross, Thy holy Passion-bearers conquered the wiles of the primal-evil enemy, O Christ our God; they shone forth as luminaries, guiding those on earth, and they grant healings unto those who ask in faith. By their prayers, save our souls!

items.english_cohort_translation: The Word of the Father, Christ our God, incarnate of Thee have we known, O Virgin Theotokos, only pure, only blessed one! Therefore unceasingly praising Thee, we magnify Thee.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сло́во Ѿч҃ее Ха̀ Бг҃а на́шего, и́стебѣ̀ воплоти́вшееся позна́хомъ Бц҃е Дв҃о, еди́на чт҃ая, еди́на бл҃гве́нная. Тѣ́мже непреста́нно, тебѣ̀ воспѣва́юще велича́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Repent, O soul, before thy departure: judgment is inexorable for those who sin, and unstable; cry aloud unto the Lord with compunction of heart: "I have sinned knowingly and unknowingly, O Compassionate One: by the prayers of Thy Baptist, have mercy and save me!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дꙋшѐ, пока́ися пре́жде исхо́да твое́го, сꙋдъ неꙋмы́тный согрѣша́ющымъ е́стъ, и́ непостоя́нный, возопи́й къ Гдⷭ҇у, ѹмиле́нїемъ ср́ца: согрѣши́хъ въ ра́зꙋмѣ и́ невѣ́дѣнїи ще́дре, мл҃твами Крⷭ҇тля твое́го, ѡ́щедри́ и́ спаси́ мя.
items.english_cohort_translation: The turtledove loving song, the sacred Baptist, who preached repentance and showed forth Christ to be the Son of man, became an advocate for all who sin, and an ever-present helper unto all the tempest-tossed. By his prayers, O Christ, save Thy world!

items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Го́рлица пѣснолю́безная сщ҃енный Крⷭ҇ти́тель, проповѣ́давый покая́нїе: и́ показа́вый Ха̀ сы́кш чл҃ка: всѣ́мъ согрѣша́ющымъ бы́сть предста́тель: и́ всѣ́мъ ѡ́бꙋрева́емымъ помо́щникъ быва́я при́сный. Того̀ мл҃твами Хѐ, спаси́ мі́ръ тво́й.
items.english_cohort_translation: By thy divine childbearing, O pure Lady, thou hast renewed the mortal nature of earthborn men that had decayed in passions, and hast raised all up from death unto the life of incorruption. Therefore as is meet, we all call thee blessed, O all-glorified Virgin, even as thou didst foretell.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Порази́й Е́гѵпта, и́ Фараѡ́на мꙋчи́теля погрузи́вый въ мо́ри: и́ лю́ди спасы́й ѡ рабо́ты, Мѡѷсе́йски пою́ще пѣ́снь побѣ́днꙋю: ꙗ́кѡ просла́вися.
items.english_cohort_translation: He Who smote Egypt and drowned the tyrant Pharaoh in the sea, and saved the people from bondage, as Moses sang a hymn of victory: for He is glorified!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сокрове́нно дѣ́лающаго дѣла̀ тмѣ̀, Гди: да не ꙗ́вѣ ѡбличи́ши мя: ни посрамѝ предъ всѣ́ми: но свѣ́томъ просвѣти́ и́стиннаго покая́нїа, Сп҃се, и́ спаси́ мя.
items.english_cohort_translation: To me who secretly commit deeds of darkness, O Lord: do not rebuke me openly, nor put me to shame before all; but enlighten me with the light of true repentance, O Savior, and save me.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Грѣхѝ всегда̀ согрѣхꙋ̀ блꙋ́дный сово́кꙋпля́ю, и́ нечꙋ́вствꙋю стра́ха твое́го никогда́же, Гди. Тѣ́мже пре́жде конца̀ спаси́ и́ ѡ́щедри́ мя.
items.english_cohort_translation: I, the prodigal, ever add sins unto sins, and never feel Thy fear, O Lord. Therefore before the end save me and have mercy on me!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Щи́томъ бл҃гоче́стїа покрыва́еми Ст҃їи, и́ нося́ще ꙗ́кѡ копі́а Кр́тное ѡрꙋ́жїе, ко коре́нію вра́га сла́вныи изыдо́сте, и́ того̀ низложи́сте.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* Protected by the shield of piety, O holy ones, and carrying the weapon of the Cross like a spear, ye went forth against the root of the enemy, O glorious ones, and cast him down.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кровопи́вцъ львѡ́въ, и́ меча̀ сѣкꙋ́щаго, и́ варе́нїа коно́бнаго, ѡтсѣка́нїа ногте́й, терза́нїа же и́ болѣ́зненнаѧ мꙋче́нїа: мꙋ́ченници Бж҃твенніи не ѹбоя́шася.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* Blood-drinking lions, the cutting sword, boiling cauldrons, tearing out of nails, rending and painful torments: the divine Martyrs feared none of these.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ковче́гъ Дх҃омъ Бж҃тве́ннымъ позлаще́нный, Прчт҃ая, показа́ся: несвры́жали нося́щи зако́на, но Ха̀ Гда, его́же зако́ и́ Прр́цы дре́вле превосказа́ша.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* An Ark gilded with the Holy Spirit wast Thou revealed, O Most-pure One: carrying not the tables of the law, but Christ the Lord, Whom the law and the Prophets foretold of old.

items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́нъ кано́нъ, ст҃омꙋ Іѡа́ннꙋ Прт҃чи. Гла́съ, д҃. Ірмо́съ: Триста́ты крѣ́пки: Ꙗ́кѡ вели́каѧ ѕвѣзда̀ слн҃цꙋ Пре́ди́тече, просвѣтѝ есѝ зе́млю: свѣ́тлостьми твои́ми Крⷭ҇телю. Тѣ́мже зовꙋ́ ти: просвѣти́ моѐ ср́це лю́тыми ѡ́мраче́нїи ѡ безчи́сленныхъ прегрѣше́нїй ѡ́слепле́нное.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Heirmos: The three mighty captains:* *Another Canon, to the Holy Forerunner John. Tone 4.* As a great star unto the sun, O Forerunner, thou didst enlighten the earth with thy radiances, O Baptist. Therefore I cry unto thee: Enlighten my heart, blinded by fierce darkness from countless transgressions!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Раздрѣши́вый иногда̀, въ не́гда ражда́шеся бл҃же́не, непло́дствїя ѹ́зы. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ молю̀, безпло́дїе за́повѣ́тей ѡ́стра́ми дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀, покажѝ мл҃твами си плодови́тельнꙋ, добродѣ́телей бл҃года́тїе принося́щꙋю.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst once loose the bonds of barrenness when thou wast born, O blessed one. Therefore I pray thee: show my soul, barren of commandments, to be fruitful through thy prayers, bearing the grace of virtues.

items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: О́гото́влаѧ есѝ пꙋ́ть, въ си́лѣ И́лїинѣ преходя̀ Изба́вителю, кънемꙋ́же моѧ̑ дꙋша движе́нїа напра́ви, собла́зна вся́каго и́ ка́мень ѡ́траче́н, пр́носла́вный Крⷭ҇телю, и́знима́я мл҃твами си.
items.english_cohort_translation: Preparing the way, going forth in the power of Elijah unto the Deliverer: direct the movements of my soul unto Him, O ever-glorious Baptist, removing every stumbling-block and stone of offense by thy prayers.

items.section: After the 3rd Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 4.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ́блаче свѣ́тлый, дꙋша̀ моя̀, ѡ́блаки мно́гїя и́ те́мныѧ, ко́ими свѣ́тлыми хода́танїемъ разорвѝ, ꙗ́кѡ да ви́ждꙋ за́рѧ, и́же но́чтсе во́зїявшаго, и́ свѣ́томъ свѣ́тъ, прїимꙋ̀ незаходи́мым.
items.english_cohort_translation: O luminous cloud, disperse the many and dark clouds of my soul by thy radiant intercession, that I may see the radiance of Him Who shone forth from the Virgin, and receive unwaning light through light.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, г҃. Ірмо́съ: Оутвержда́й гро́ма, и́ зижда́й дх҃а, ѹтверди́ мя, Гди, да пою́ тѧ во и́стинѣ, и́ творю̀ во́лю твою̀, ꙗ́кѡ нѣ́сть ст҃ъ, ꙗ́коже ты̀ Бже на́шъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* Thou Who dost establish the thunder and create the spirit: establish me, O Lord, that I may sing unto Thee in truth, and do Thy will; for there is none holy as Thou, our God!

Thou Who dost establish the thunder and create the spirit: establish me, O Lord, that I may sing unto Thee in truth, and do Thy will; for there is none holy as Thou, our God!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́же слѣпце́м ѻ́чи просвѣти́вый, Хѐ: ѻ́чи моѝ просвѣти́ ѡ́мраче́нныѧ сла́стьми, и́ жите́йскими печа́льми: и́ ника́коже къ сꙋде́и твои́ възи́рающа.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Thou Who didst enlighten the eyes of the blind, O Christ: enlighten my eyes darkened by pleasures and worldly cares, which look not at all upon Thy judgments.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѐ вре́мя, возникнѝ дꙋ́ше моя̀ ѡ зо́лъ, и́хже содѣ́яла есѝ, и́ клꙋ́ч Изба́вителю возопій состра́хомъ: покая́нїя две́ри мѝ ѡ́верзѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Behold the time: arise, O my soul, from the evils thou hast committed, and cry with fear unto the Key, the Deliverer: "Open unto me the doors of repentance!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́ченически тече́нїе соверши́вше, Ст҃ы́хъ сосло́вїе, и́ тмы̀ мы́сленныхъ мꙋчи́нѡкъ Бж҃твенною си́лою, ꙗ́кѡ коне́чнꙋю низложи́сте, и́ сла́вꙋ полꙋчи́сте.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ра́дꙋїемъ раздрѣши́ла есѝ печа́ль: ра́дость на́мъ ро́жши, жизнода́вца и́ изба́вителя, Прчт҃ая Бце, его́же приле́жно молѝ, спастѝ дꙋша́ на́ша.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́нъ: Ірмо́съ то́йже. Лꙋ́къ си́лныхъ изнемо́же, а́ немощні́и препоя́сашася си́лою, сего̀ ра́ди, возвели́чися ѡ Гдѣ̀, ср́це моѐ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The bow of the mighty is broken, and the weak have girded themselves with strength; therefore my heart is magnified in the Lord.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вся́кꙋ добродѣ́тель исполни́лъ есѝ, вся́кꙋ же зло́бꙋ ѿвръгль есѝ нена́виднѣ, и́ стезю̀ покая́нїа ѹ́зкꙋю, бл҃же́нне показа́лъ есѝ: ло́ба вопло́щшагося, Прⷯ҇тча вели́кїи показа́лъ есѝ, сего̀ра́ди молю́тися, безслове́сныхъ мя ѡ страсте́й изба́ви, наста́вляя мя къ бл҃гостра́стїю.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou hast fulfilled every virtue, and every malice hast thou hated and cast away, and shown forth the narrow path of repentance, O blessed one; thou hast shown forth the Word incarnate, O great Forerunner: therefore I pray thee, deliver me from irrational passions, guiding me unto good passionlessness.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сщ҃е́нножи́тельствова въ телесѝ, житїѐ безпло́тныхъ показа̀ Прт҃че, емꙋ́же ѹподо́битися, моли́твами свои́ми, Бгоно́се ѹтвердѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having lived sacredly in the body, thou didst show forth the life of the Bodiless Powers, O Forerunner: establish me by thy prayers to become like unto him, O God-bearer!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Препла́вая мі́рскаго мо́ря, Сло́ве, во́дꙋ: лѣ́ностїю въ бѣ́дꙋ впадо́хся сладостьми теле́сными, къ покая́нїа приста́нищꙋ мя ѹпра́ви.
items.english_cohort_translation: Sailing across the water of the worldly sea, O Word: through slothfulness I fell into danger by bodily pleasures; guide me unto the harbor of repentance!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оучисти́вше вои́стиннꙋ гно́й ве́сь безбо́жїа, терпѣ́нїа Бж҃твеною си́лою до́блїи мꙋ́нцїи, и́ спасенїе всѣ́мъ пода́ша.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* Having truly cleansed all the filth of godlessness, the noble Martyrs, by the divine power of endurance, granted salvation unto all.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ва́ляеми по землѝ ꙗ́коже ка́менїе, Ст҃ртоте́рпцы: пре́лести тве́рдыня, доконца̀ низве́рго́ша, и́ къ вы́шнемꙋ гра́дꙋ дости́го́ша.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* Being rolled upon the ground like stones, O Passion-bearers, ye utterly overthrew the strongholds of deceit, and attained the city on high.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Спасенїе тѧ, на вся́ко вре́мя и́ мѣ́сто, призыва́ю: непре́зри менѐ всенепоро́чнаѧ, ꙗ́же Бг҃а ро́жши, изба́вителѧ вкꙋ́пѣ и́ сп҃са моего̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Thee, our salvation, at every time and place do I invoke: despise me not, O all-immaculate one, who didst bear God, the Deliverer and Savior of us all.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́ко го́рлицꙋ тѧ, всенꙋ и́стинны, всече́стнѣишими словесы̀, предвозвѣща́ющꙋ мі́рови, позна́вше ѡ́блжа́емъ пр́но, сла́вне Прт҃че.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having known thee as a turtledove, announcing the springtime of truth unto the world with most honorable words, we ever call thee blessed, O glorious Forerunner!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сокрꙋше́ннаго мя, ле́стнїи́ми сокрꙋше́ньми: вꙋ́тхомꙋ и́ Но́вомꙋ ꙗ́кѡ хода́таи сы́й, всего̀ ѡ́бновѝ пою́щаго тѧ Прт҃че.
items.english_cohort_translation: Renew me who am crushed by deceitful crushings, O Forerunner, as thou art the mediator between the Old and the New, who sing of thee!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́же въ пꙋсты́ни всели́выйся, непоро́чнымъ житїе́мъ: ѡ́пꙋстѣ́вшаго вся́кими престꙋпле́ньми ѹ́ма моего̀, Бж҃твенными ѡ́бновѝ, моли́твами си Прт҃че.
items.english_cohort_translation: O thou who didst dwell in the desert with blameless life: renew my mind, desolated by all manner of transgressions, with divine prayers, O Forerunner!

items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Thy Son, O Virgin, was known as cleansing and deliverance for us: pray unto Him to save those who glorify thee with compunction of soul.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, є҃. Ірмо́съ: Восіѧ́й ми, Гди, свѣ́тъ повелѣ́нїй твои́хъ: ꙗ́кѡ ктебѣ̀, Хѐ, ѹ́тренюетъ дꙋ́хъ мо́й, и́ пое́тъ тѧ. Ты́ бо есѝ Бг҃ъ на́, и́ ктебѣ̀ прибѣго́, цр҃ю ми́рный.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 5. Heirmos:* Shine forth upon me, O Lord, the light of Thy commandments; for early in the morning my spirit seeks Thee, O Christ, and sings unto Thee. For Thou art our God, and unto Thee have I fled, O King of peace!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ́бнаже́нїемъ прише́дшаго житїѐ чл҃вѣ́ющее, и́ ле́стьми пре́лестника, помрача́ема мя повелѣ́нїи, Ісѐ, ѡ́щедри́: и́ къ свѣ́тꙋ наста́ви покая́нїа жи́зни.
items.english_cohort_translation: I who have come naked into human life, and am darkened by the deceitful commandments of the deceiver: O Jesus, have compassion on me, and guide me unto the light of the life of repentance!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вознесе́ся ср́це моѐ прило́гъми ѕмїа̀: и́ ниспаде́ся паде́нїемъ ве́лїим, и́же низверже́ннымъ, Ісѐ, исправле́нїе, возставѝ и́ спаси́ мя, мно́гихъ ти ра́ди щедро́тъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: My heart was lifted up by the assaults of the serpent, and fell with a great fall; O Jesus, the restoration of the fallen, raise me up and save me, for the sake of Thy many compassions!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ка́плями кро́вей, ѹгаси́сте многобо́жїа пре́лести пе́щь блаже́нни, и́ тꙋ́чами исцѣле́нїй, пла́мень ѹстави́те страсте́й всегда̀, сп҃совы страда́лци.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* With drops of blood ye extinguished the furnace of the deceit of polytheism, O blessed ones, and with showers of healings ye ever quench the flame of passions, O Sufferers of the Savior!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Стоя́ще предсꙋди́ще, и́ ногтьмѝ стро́жеми, и́ каме́нїемъ побива́еми Мꙋ́нци: и́ множествꙋ примекша́ющеся лю́тыхъ мꙋ́къ, непрекло́нни пребы́сте ма́нїем Бж҃твеннымъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* Standing before the judgment-seat, scraped with claws, and pelted with stones, O Martyrs: though a multitude of fierce torments drew near, ye remained unbent by divine beckoning.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Восіѧ́й ми, Блч҃це, лꙋчꙋ млⷭ҇рдїа твое́го, и́же въ мра́цѣ прегрѣше́нїй мои́хъ сꙋ́щꙋ, Дво: и́ къ свѣ́тꙋ покая́нїа наста́ви, Пречт҃ая: да вѣ́рою тѧ пою̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Shine forth upon me, O Lady, the ray of thy tender mercy, who am in the darkness of my transgressions, O Virgin, and guide me unto the light of repentance, O Most-pure One, that in faith I may sing of thee.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пꙋсты́ннымъ ма ѻ́у́гльмъ, и́ стра́стными нахо́ды распала́ема, пꙋсты́нное воспит́анїе, ѡ́росѝ твои́ми мл҃твами, и́ ѡ вре́да соблюдѝ неврежде́нꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Burnt with the coal of the desert, and inflamed by the assaults of passions, O child of the desert: bedew me with thy prayers, and keep me unharmed by injury.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: По̀ твое́ю креще́нїя ст҃о́ю десни́цею, Ѽц҃а Бж҃твеннаѧ все- блаже́нне десни́ца, спаса́ющїа на́съ ѡ рꙋкѝ ле́стнаго, сщ҃енными хода́таиствы вонмѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: By the holy right hand of thy baptism, O divine and all-blessed right hand of the Father, which saves us from the hand of the deceiver: give ear through holy intercessions!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прибѣ́жище тѧ Прт҃че, и́ покро́въ держа́венъ, и́ вели́кꙋю стѣ́нꙋ ве́сь мі́ръ и́матъ, изба́ви ны̀ твои́ми мл҃твами, ѡ вся́кїа тѣсноты̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: As a refuge, a mighty protection, and a great rampart doth the whole world possess thee, O Forerunner: deliver us by thy prayers from every distress!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Добро́тꙋ тѧ Іа́ковлю возлюбѝ Бг҃ъ, Дв҃о Ѻтрокови́це: ѹкраси́вшаго вся̀ тобо́ю, ѡ́мрачившаѧся престꙋпле́нїе пе́рвѣе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* God loved the beauty of Jacob, O Virgin Maiden, Who through thee adorned all things that of old were darkened by transgression.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. Ірмо́съ: Во пꙋчи́нѣ жите́йстѣи, дꙋше́вными мои́ми ездя́хъ волнамѝ: но ꙗ́кѡ ѡ кита Іѡ́на, си́це вопїю̀: и́з глубины̀ зо́лъ мои́хъ возведѝ мя, молюся, Сп҃се Бжи́й, и́ Сло́ве.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* In the deep of life I tossed upon the waves of my soul; but like Jonah from the whale, thus I cry: "From the depth of my evils lead me up, I pray, O Savior God, and Word!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дрѣма́нїемъ небреже́нїа, ѡ́тѧготи́хъ ѡкая́нныѧ дꙋ́шꙋ: и́ грѣхо́внымъ низложи́хся: къ свѣ́тꙋ покая́нїа воздви́гни мя Гди, и́ свои́м милосе́рдїе, спаси́ мя.
items.english_cohort_translation: Through the slumber of neglect I have weighed down my wretched soul, and have fallen into sin: raise me up unto the light of repentance, O Lord, and by Thy tender mercy save me!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ка́кѡ падо́хъ ѡкая́нный; ка́кѡ ѡ́уда́лихъ ся Кг҃а пребл҃гаго; ка́кѡ неприемлю̀ въ чꙋ́вствѣ гро́зное сꙋди́ще ѻ́но, нане́мже и́мам ѡ́сꙋди́тися, тво́рче мо́й ѡ́щедри́ мя.
items.english_cohort_translation: How did I fall, wretch that I am? How did I depart from the All-good God? How do I not grasp in feeling that terrible judgment-seat whereon I must be condemned? O my Creator, have compassion on me!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Цѣвни́ца ꙗви́стеся, гла́съ возглаша́ющи на́мъ спаси́телный: и́ наслажда́юще вѣ́рныхъ ср́ца: и́ пїа́нство пре́лести до конца̀ ѡ́гоня́юще: страда́лци просвѣще́нныи.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* Ye were revealed as citharas, sounding forth a saving voice unto us, delighting the hearts of the faithful, and utterly driving away the drunkenness of deceit, O enlightened Sufferers!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Превозше́дше предѣ́лы чл҃вѣческїа, Мꙋ́нци Хвы̑, и́же къ зижди́телю воззре́нїемъ че́стныимъ: мꙋче́нїа болѣ́зни претерпѣ́ша ра́дꙋющеся, ꙗ́кѡ въ телесе́хъ чꙋждыхъ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́нъ, Ірмо́съ: Прїидо́хъ во глубины морскїа, и́ потопѝ мя бꙋ́ря мно́гихъ мѝ прегрѣше́нїй: но ꙗ́кѡ Бг҃ъ и́з тла̀ возведѝ жи́знь мою̀, многомлⷭ҇тиве.
items.english_cohort_translation: I came into the deep of the sea, and the tempest of my many transgressions overwhelmed me; but as God, lead up my life from corruption, O Plenteous in mercy!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Стоя́ше креща́я въ бꙋ́етнна́хъ, и́же грѣхѝ чл҃кѡмъ взе́млющаго Бг҃а, его́же моли́ти непреста́й Прт҃че, ѡ́щедри́ти и́ спастѝ дꙋша́ на́ша.
items.english_cohort_translation: Standing and baptizing in the streams Him Who takes away the sins of men: cease not to pray unto Him, O Forerunner, to have compassion and save our souls!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Проповѣ́дникъ показа́лся есѝ покая́нїа, взнемлю́же соблюдѝ моѐ ср́це, ѡ́скверне́нное вре́дными грѣхы̀, Прт҃че, и́ возни́кнове́нїа неимꙋ́щее.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou wast revealed as a preacher of repentance: keep my heart from being defiled by harmful sins, O Forerunner, having no uprising!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Возгласи́лъ есѝ бл҃же́нне къ пꙋсты́няхъ неплодоно́сныхъ дꙋ́шъ, Сло́ва прише́ствїе хотя́щее бы́ти. Тѣ́мже гла́сы немо́лчными, всѧ́ка Цр҃кви блажи́ тѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst cry aloud, O blessed one, unto the deserts of unfruitful souls, concerning the coming of the Word: therefore with unceasing voices every Church calls thee blessed.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Зако́на измѣни́вша ѡ́бразы, твои́мъ стра́шнымъ Ржтво́, Бгоневѣ́сто: ѹ́же сокры́тїе мы̀ нн҃ѣ зря́ще Блч҃це: по досто́инїю тѧ̀ чте́мъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The law changed types by thy fearful childbearing, O Bride of God: beholding now its concealment, O Lady, we honor thee as is meet.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, з҃. Ірмо́съ: Тѣ́лꙋ зла́томꙋ, непоклони́вшася, ѻ́троци Авраа́мстїи, неисꙋ́шени бы́вше ꙗ́коже зла́то въ горни́лѣ: въ пе́щи ѻ́гненнѣи ꙗ́ко въ черто́зѣ свѣ́тлѣ, ликова́хꙋ пою́ще: бл҃гвенъ Бг҃ъ ѡ́цъ на́ши.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 7. Heirmos:[^180]* The children of Abraham, having not bowed down unto the golden image, being unconsumed like gold in the furnace, danced in the fiery furnace as in a radiant bridal chamber, singing: "Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ю́но ѻ́троча̀ ꙗви́лася есѝ: ве́тхаго ѡ́сужде́нїа изба́вити хотя́ мі́ра, Хѐ: ꙗ́ки бл҃гоꙋтро́бен. Тѣ́мже вопїю̀, ѡ́ветша́вшаго мя грѣхмѝ мно́гими, нн҃ѣ ѡ́бновѝ ще́дре, и́ спаси́ мя пою́ща: бл҃гвенъ Бг҃ъ ѡ́цъ на́ши.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst appear as a young child, willing to deliver the world from ancient condemnation, O Christ, as Thou art tender-hearted. Therefore I cry: Renew me now, who have grown old through many sins, O Compassionate One, and save me as I sing: "Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́же иногда̀ Манассі́ю покаѧ́вшася спасы́й: ѡ́щедри́вы блꙋ́дницꙋ слезо́ю ѡправда́вый, мно́гая и́ лю́тая согрѣши́вшаго менѐ спасѝ, и́ вопїю́ща прїимѝ: бл҃гвенъ Бг҃ъ ѡ́цъ на́ши.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Thou Who didst once save Manasseh when he repented, and didst show compassion on the harlot and justify her through tears: save me who have committed many and fierce sins, and receive me as I cry: "Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!"

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бꙋ́ри лю́той многобо́жїа ѡ́бедержа́щи вселе́ннꙋю: кора́бль сотво́рше бл҃гоче́стїа, страстоте́рпци: ѡ́кормле́нїе же Хв҃ымъ, къ приста́нищꙋ ѹлучи́ша, вопїю́ще: бл҃гвенъ Бг҃ъ ѡ́цъ на́ши.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* When the fierce tempest of polytheism held the universe, making piety your ship, O Passion-bearers, steered by Christ, ye reached the harbor, crying: "Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Процвѣ́тши бы́вше ꙗ́вѣ, ꙗ́коже зла́то въ горни́лѣ: мꙋ́ками нескꙋ́дными страда́лци, и́ показа́вшеся запеча́тлѣніа чт҃наѧ Стрⷭ҇темъ Хв҃ымъ, въ сокро́вищницїи небе́снїи, на ѹтверже́нїи мно́зѣ сокрове́нни бы́сте нн҃ѣ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having blossomed openly like gold in the furnace through unsparing torments, O Sufferers, and appeared as precious seals of the Sufferings of Christ: ye are now hidden in heavenly treasuries for much confirmation.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сн҃а и́ Бг҃а и́ изба́вителѧ и́ Блч҃кꙋ, пло́тїю ро́жши Прчт҃ая Блч҃це, томꙋ̀ при́сно, Прчт҃ая моли́ся, ꙗ́кѡ да разрѣше́нїе лю́ты́и и́ мно́гимъ грѣхѡ́м ѡ́ставле́нїе прїи́мемъ: славосло́вящїй того̀, и́же па́че ѹ́ма̀ щедро́ты.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Having borne the Son and God, the Deliverer and Master in the flesh, O Most-pure Lady: ever pray unto Him, O Most-pure One, that we may receive deliverance from fierce deeds and remission of our many sins, who glorify His mercies that are beyond mind.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бо́льшїи всѣ́хъ рожде́нныхъ, ꙗви́лся есѝ Прт҃че, Ба́н велмѝ согрѣша́юща мя: велича́йшею мл҃твою си пла́мене вели́каго изба́ви, и́ вѣ́чныѧ тмы̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Greater than all born of women wast thou revealed, O Forerunner: deliver me who sin greatly from the great flame and eternal darkness, through thy greatest prayer!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Непло́дная ꙗви́ся смоко́вница, и́ посѣче́нїа бо́яся: ѹтверди́ мя хода́таиством си, Прт҃че Сло́ва: и́ плодоно́сна сотворѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The barren fig tree was revealed, and fearing cutting down: establish me by thine intercession, O Forerunner of the Word, and make me fruitful! that I may call thee blessed.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу́спи вся́кꙋ вра́жїю подви́жнымꙋ бꙋ́рю, на и́же вѣ́рою притѣка́ющаго ктебѣ̀: бо́дрыми си моли́твами, къ Изба́вителю всѣ́хъ Прт҃че Ісоа́не.
items.english_cohort_translation: Put to sleep every tempest of the enemy stirred up against him who flees unto thee in faith, by thy vigilant prayers unto the Deliverer of all, O Forerunner John!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Нахожде́нїа лꙋка́ваго, и́ ча́сти Дв҃це, и́ рабо́ты бѣ́совскїа, рабы̀ своя̀ изба́ви: и́же дꙋ́шею тѧ и́ ꙗ́зы́комъ при́сно славосло́вящихъ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, и҃. Ірмо́съ: Въ ѻ́гни пла́меннѣ пре́стоѧ́тъ тебѣ̀, Херꙋві́ми, и́ Серафі́ми, Гди: и́ вся̀ тва́рь пое́тъ тебѣ̀ пѣ́снь кра́снꙋю. По́йте бл҃гвте, лю́дїе превозноси́те, Ха̀, еди́наго содѣ́теля, въвся̀ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 8. Heirmos:* In fiery flame the Cherubim and Seraphim stand before Thee, O Lord, and all creation sings unto Thee a fair song: Sing, bless, and exalt Christ, the only Creator, unto all ages, ye people!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Непребы́хъ въ стра́сѣ твое́мъ: непослꙋ́шахъ за́повѣдей твои́: и́ во́лю твою̀ некори́хъ никогда́же. Что̀ бꙋ́дꙋ ѡкая́нный; чл҃колю́биче сы́и, ѡ́щедри́ мя тꙋ́не, Сп҃се: и́ не ѡве́рзи менѐ.
items.english_cohort_translation: I remained not in Thy fear, I listened not unto Thy commandments, and I never submitted unto Thy will. What shall become of me, wretch that I am? O Thou Who art the Lover of mankind, have compassion on me freely, O Savior, and cast me not away!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дѣ́лателю до́брый, вопїю̀ тѝ: стра́ха твое́го серпо́мъ пожнѝ и́скорене, вся̀ те́рновная помышле́нїа, дꙋ́ша моѧ̀ ѡкая́нныѧ: и́ сѣ́ма покая́нїа прозяба́ти мя сподо́би, Хр́те, спасе́нный кла́съ.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Good Husbandman, I cry unto Thee: with the sickle of Thy fear reap from the roots all the thorny thoughts of my wretched soul, and grant me to sprout the seed of repentance, O Christ, a saved wheat-ear!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Распространи́шася бл҃года́тїю, ѹтѣсне́нїи въ я́звахъ Ст҃ртоно́сци: и́ сътѣсни́ша вра́гꙋ пꙋ́ти про́плети испо́лненны: и́ нн҃ѣ наста́вляютъ на́съ къ пꙋте́мъ Бж҃їимъ въ вѣ́рѣ и́ любвѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Martyricon:* Widened by grace, the Passion-bearers distressed in wounds narrowed the paths full of snares for the enemy; and now they guide us unto the paths of God in faith and love.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу́рко твоѐ всенепоро́чная, ѡ то́чѣстнаго гꙋ́мна ꙗ́вися: мі́рови нося̀ пшени́цꙋ живота̀, пита́ющи вся́ческая. Тѣ́мже тѧ, вѣ́рнїи подостоѧ́нїю ѹблажа́е.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Thy womb, O all-immaculate one, was shown to be from the honorable threshing-floor, bearing unto the world the Wheat of life, which feeds all things. Therefore we, the faithful, call thee blessed as is meet.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́нъ, Ірмо́съ: Изба́вителю всѣ́хъ всеси́лне. Посредѣ̀ пла́мене бл҃гоче́ствова́вшаѧ, соше́дъ ѡ́роси́лъ есѝ, и́ научѝ пѣ́ти: вся̑кала дѣла̀ бл҃гвте Гдна, Гда, и́ превозноси́те его̀ въ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Almighty Deliverer of all: descending into the midst of the flame, Thou didst bedew the pious ones, and didst teach them to sing: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, and exalt Him unto all ages!"

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сно́мїя мя сно́мъ ѡ́держима, и́ мгло́ю зло́бы помрача́ема: свѣ́тлою мл҃твою си испра́ви Прт҃че, и́ да́ждъ ꙗ́кѡ въ дне́ добродѣ́телей бл҃говаре́зно ходи́ти.
items.english_cohort_translation: Held fast by the sleep of despondency, and darkened by the gloom of malice: set me upright by thy radiant prayer, O Forerunner, and grant me to walk decorously in virtues as in the day!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И́скꙋше́нїй мя зима̀ ѡ́держи́т, и́ стра́стей бꙋ́ря смꙋща́ет мя: рꙋ́кꙋ ми пода́жд Прт҃че: возводя́щꙋю къ приста́нищꙋ покая́нїа, дꙋ́ша моѧ̀ кора́бль, моли́твами си.
items.english_cohort_translation: The winter of temptations holds me, and the tempest of passions troubles me: stretch forth thy hand unto me, O Forerunner, guiding the ship of my soul unto the harbor of repentance by thy prayers!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Възе́млющаго мі́рꙋ прегрѣше́нїа, въ рѣ́чныхъ крⷭ҇тилъ есѝ вода́: ѕѡ́лъ мои́хъ бе́зднꙋ изсушѝ, стра́дми мл҃твъ твои́хъ, блаже́нне Іѡа́нне Прт҃че.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst baptize in the streams of the river Him Who takes away the sins of the world: dry up the abyss of my evils through the efforts of thy prayers, O blessed John the Forerunner!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *After the Third Kathisma, Sessional Hymns, Tone 3:*
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ви́дѣвъ Дх҃а Ст҃а́го: слы́шалъ есѝ гла́съ Роди́телевъ, свѣдѣтелство́юща Прт҃че, ѡ тебѣ̀ неизрече́нно крща́емомꙋ, Іс҃ꙋ: его́же моли, спастѝ на́.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having seen the Holy Spirit, thou didst hear the Father's voice bearing witness, O Forerunner, unto Jesus ineffably baptized by thee: Whom pray to save us!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ́кѡ исто́чникъ на́шего ѡ́бновле́нїа, сокрꙋше́ннаго мя прираже́ньми ѕмїиными, всего̀ ѡ́бновѝ: ꙗ́ко да вѣ́рою и́ любо́вїю тѧ ѹблажа́ю, Бце Дв҃о всенепоро́чная.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* As the fountain of our renewal, renew me wholly who am crushed by the assaults of the serpent, that with faith and love I may call thee blessed, O all-immaculate Virgin Theotokos!
